name.zh: 肝脏影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Liver Imaging Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于符合适用条件的肝细胞癌高危人群。下列类别仅概述 CT/MRI v2018 未治疗病灶的诊断分类；超声监测及治疗反应评估采用各自算法。
summary.en: Applies to eligible populations at risk for hepatocellular carcinoma. Categories below summarize CT/MRI v2018 diagnosis of untreated observations; ultrasound surveillance and treatment response use separate algorithms.

domain.zh: 肝细胞癌高危人群的影像评估
domain.en: Imaging in populations at risk for hepatocellular carcinoma

meaning.zh: 可明确判断为良性。
meaning.en: A benign observation with diagnostic confidence.

meaning.zh: 倾向良性。
meaning.en: Benignity is favored.

meaning.zh: 恶性可能性居中。
meaning.en: Malignancy remains indeterminate.

meaning.zh: 倾向肝细胞癌。
meaning.en: Hepatocellular carcinoma is favored.

meaning.zh: 在适用人群中满足肝细胞癌影像诊断标准。
meaning.en: Meets imaging criteria for HCC in the eligible population.

categories.original: Probably or definitely malignant, not HCC specific

meaning.zh: 高度疑恶性，但表现不特异于肝细胞癌；仍可能为肝细胞癌。
meaning.en: Malignancy is strongly suspected without HCC-specific features; HCC remains possible.

meaning.zh: 静脉内见肿瘤组织。
meaning.en: Tumor tissue is identified within a vein.

meaning.zh: 图像缺失或质量受限，无法可靠分类。
meaning.en: Missing or degraded images prevent reliable categorization.

explanation.zh: 治疗反应评估，需选择与治疗方式匹配的专用算法。
explanation.en: Treatment response assessment uses an algorithm matched to the treatment type.

sources.title: LI-RADS CT/MRI v2018 Core

scope.zh: 用于成人肝细胞癌高危人群的未治疗、无病理证实病灶：肝硬化、慢性乙肝或当前／既往 HCC，包括符合条件的移植候选者和受者。不用于无上述危险因素、未满18岁、先天性肝纤维化或血管性疾病所致肝硬化。本节不展开超声监测、CEUS 或治疗反应算法。
scope.en: Use for untreated observations without pathologic proof in adults at high risk for HCC: cirrhosis, chronic hepatitis B, or current/prior HCC, including eligible transplant candidates and recipients. Exclude patients without these risks, children under 18, congenital hepatic fibrosis, and cirrhosis from vascular disorders. US surveillance, CEUS and treatment-response algorithms are outside this section.

purpose.zh: 使用合格的多期增强CT或MRI。MRI可用细胞外或肝胆特异性对比剂；充分的动脉期、门静脉期及相应延迟期是判断强化模式的基础。
purpose.en: Use diagnostic multiphase contrast-enhanced CT or MRI. Extracellular or hepatobiliary MRI agents are supported; adequate arterial, portal venous and appropriate delayed acquisitions underpin enhancement assessment.

purpose.zh: 在边界最清楚的期相、序列和平面测最大外缘到外缘径，包膜计入。其他期相能清楚显示时避免用动脉期或DWI测量。增长与足够质量的既往CT/MRI比较，尽量采用相同期相、序列和平面。
purpose.en: Measure the largest outer-edge-to-outer-edge diameter, including the capsule, on the phase/sequence/plane with the clearest border. Avoid arterial-phase or DWI measurements when another phase shows the margin well. Compare growth with adequate prior CT/MRI using matching technique where possible.

zh: 动脉期病灶全部或部分明确高于肝实质，且不是仅周边环状强化。
en: Unequivocal arterial hyperenhancement relative to liver in all or part of the observation, excluding rim-only enhancement.

zh: 由早期到晚期相对肝实质强化降低，并在细胞外期低强化。细胞外对比剂或钆贝葡胺可用门静脉／延迟期；钆塞酸（gadoxetate）仅用门静脉期。
en: Temporal loss of enhancement relative to liver with extracellular-phase hypoenhancement. Use portal venous/delayed phases with extracellular agents or gadobenate; with gadoxetate use the portal venous phase only.

zh: 门静脉、延迟或过渡期见光滑、均匀、清楚的强化边缘，环绕大部分或全部病灶，较背景结节周围纤维组织更厚或更明显。
en: A smooth, uniform, sharp enhancing border around most/all of the observation in portal venous, delayed or transitional phase, thicker or more conspicuous than fibrosis around background nodules.

zh: ≤6个月内肿块直径增加≥50%；不能以灌注假病灶或与既往超声比较代替。
en: A mass increases in diameter by ≥50% within ≤6 months; do not apply to a possible perfusion pseudolesion or use prior US to establish this feature.

title.zh: 诊断组合表：附加主要征象为包膜、洗脱和阈值增长
title.en: Diagnostic matrix: additional major features are capsule, washout and threshold growth

zh: 仅强化包膜：LR-4；非周边洗脱或阈值增长：LR-5
en: Capsule alone: LR-4; nonperipheral washout or threshold growth: LR-5

title.zh: 优先识别的类别与辅助征象

zh: 因图像缺失或质量下降不能可靠分类；不是普通“不确定病灶”的替代类别。
en: Image omission or degradation prevents reliable categorization; it is not a substitute for an otherwise indeterminate observation.

zh: 静脉内明确强化软组织，无论能否显示肝实质肿块；单纯血栓或疑似静脉侵犯不够。
en: Unequivocal enhancing soft tissue in a vein, whether or not a parenchymal mass is visible; bland thrombus or uncertain invasion is insufficient.

zh: 明确／倾向良性的病灶，先于诊断组合表处理。
en: Definitely/probably benign observations are identified before using the diagnostic matrix.

zh: 恶性但不具有HCC特异性：如环状APHE、周边洗脱、延迟中央强化或靶样弥散／肝胆期表现；非靶样病灶可由浸润生长、显著受限扩散、坏死／严重缺血等提示。
en: Probably/definitely malignant but not HCC-specific: rim APHE, peripheral washout, delayed central enhancement or targetoid diffusion/hepatobiliary appearances; non-targetoid lesions may show infiltrative growth, marked diffusion restriction or necrosis/severe ischemia.

zh: ≥1项支持恶性征象可升级一级，最高LR-4；支持良性可降一级；良恶性辅助征象同时存在不调整。缺少辅助征象不反向推断。
en: At least one malignancy-favoring feature permits a one-category upgrade, at most LR-4; benignity-favoring features permit a one-category downgrade. Opposing features cancel adjustment. Absence of a feature is not evidence for the opposite.

steps.zh: 先核对人群和图像质量，再识别LR-NC、LR-TIV、LR-1、LR-2、LR-M。其余病灶按APHE、大小与附加主要征象进入诊断表。
steps.en: Check eligibility and image adequacy, then identify LR-NC, LR-TIV, LR-1, LR-2 or LR-M. Use APHE, size and additional major features for remaining observations.

steps.zh: 辅助征象可包括受限扩散、轻中度T2高信号、亚阈值增长、肝胆期低信号、结中结／马赛克等；良性征象包括稳定超过2年、缩小、明显T2高信号或与血池同步等。可选择应用，但不能靠辅助征象升至LR-5。
steps.en: Examples of ancillary malignancy features include diffusion restriction, mild/moderate T2 hyperintensity, subthreshold growth, hepatobiliary hypointensity and nodule-in-nodule/mosaic architecture. Benignity features include stability over two years, reduction, marked T2 hyperintensity and enhancement paralleling blood pool. Use is optional and cannot produce LR-5.

steps.zh: 主要或辅助征象不确定时按缺如处理；两个类别难分时选诊断确定性较低者。疑似TIV但不确定时不分LR-TIV，最后复核类别是否合理。
steps.en: Treat uncertain major/ancillary features as absent. If two categories remain possible, choose the one with lower diagnostic certainty. Do not assign LR-TIV when TIV is uncertain; perform a final reasonableness check.

management.zh: 原文第14页建议：LR-1／LR-2通常继续6个月监测，LR-2也可考虑≤6个月重复诊断影像；LR-3考虑3–6个月重复或替代诊断影像；LR-4多学科讨论制定个体化检查，可包括活检；LR-M及LR-TIV需多学科制定诊断与处理；LR-5进入HCC分期和治疗规划。
management.en: Printed page 14 suggests six-month surveillance for LR-1/2, with diagnostic imaging within six months also an option for LR-2; repeat/alternative diagnostic imaging in 3–6 months for LR-3; tailored multidisciplinary workup, possibly biopsy, for LR-4; multidisciplinary planning for LR-M/TIV; and HCC staging/treatment planning for LR-5.

management.zh: LR-NC考虑3个月内补充或替代检查。活检及治疗由临床团队综合决定；本节描述的是2018版原文建议。
management.en: For LR-NC consider repeat/alternative diagnostic imaging within three months. Biopsy and treatment decisions require clinical-team assessment; the suggestions here describe the 2018 source.

cautions.zh: 肝胆期或过渡期低信号不能直接当作钆塞酸MRI的主要洗脱征象；环状APHE不能代替非环状APHE。
cautions.en: Hepatobiliary/transitional hypointensity is not major washout on gadoxetate MRI; rim APHE is not interchangeable with nonrim APHE.

cautions.zh: LR-M也可能是HCC；LR-TIV也不等于一定由HCC引起。已治疗病灶需使用相应治疗反应算法。
cautions.en: LR-M can still represent HCC, and LR-TIV is not necessarily due to HCC. Treated observations need the appropriate treatment-response algorithm.

name.zh: 肺部 CT 筛查报告和数据系统
name.en: Lung CT Screening Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于肺癌筛查 CT 的结节评估与报告。以下为类别含义摘要，不涵盖测量规则或处理时限，也不作为偶发肺结节的通用规则。
summary.en: Supports nodule assessment and reporting in lung cancer screening CT. This overview omits measurement rules and management intervals and is not a general incidental-nodule guideline.

domain.zh: 肺癌低剂量 CT 筛查
domain.en: Lung cancer screening with low-dose CT

meaning.zh: 筛查评估暂未完成。
meaning.en: Screening assessment is not yet complete.

meaning.zh: 无肺结节，或结节具有明确良性征象。
meaning.en: No nodules, or nodules with definite benign features.

meaning.zh: 结节的表现或变化过程支持良性。
meaning.en: Nodule appearance or behavior supports benignity.

meaning.zh: 结节倾向良性。
meaning.en: Nodule findings favor benignity.

meaning.zh: 结节具有可疑表现。
meaning.en: Nodule findings raise concern for cancer.

meaning.zh: 结节疑恶性程度较高。
meaning.en: Nodule findings raise greater concern for cancer.

meaning.zh: 3 类或 4 类结节伴进一步增加肺癌疑虑的影像表现；4X 为独立类别。
meaning.en: Category 3 or 4 nodules have further concerning findings; 4X is a distinct category.

meaning.zh: 附加修饰符，标记与肺癌无关但具有或可能具有临床意义的发现。
meaning.en: A modifier for other findings that may matter clinically, unrelated to lung cancer.

explanation.zh: 低剂量胸部 CT，用于肺癌筛查。
explanation.en: Low-dose chest CT used for lung cancer screening.

explanation.zh: 附加标记，不代表结节恶性风险等级。
explanation.en: An added flag, not a nodule cancer-risk grade.

sources.title: Lung CT Screening Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 用于肺癌筛查CT，以最可疑病灶决定本次检查类别。先区分基线、新发及既有病灶增长，再按实性、部分实性、非实性、气道或非典型囊肿分支判定；不是偶发肺结节的通用规则。
scope.en: For lung cancer screening CT. Assign the examination category from its most suspicious finding after distinguishing baseline, new and growing lesions and identifying solid, part-solid, ground-glass, airway and atypical-cyst pathways. This is not a general incidental-nodule algorithm.

sourcePages.zh: 本地论文第3–4、6–7、9–14页：表1–4及增长、阶梯随访章节；大小阈值另核对论文所引ACR v2022官方分类表第1–2页
sourcePages.en: Local article pages 3–4, 6–7 and 9–14: Tables 1–4, growth and stepped management; size thresholds additionally checked against pages 1–2 of the ACR v2022 category table cited by the article

purpose.zh: 薄层CT评估结节类型、平均径和实性成分；对照最早及最近可用的胸部CT，不只对照前一次。明确随访间隔和扫描技术变化。
purpose.en: Evaluate nodule type, mean diameter and solid component on thin-section CT. Compare both the oldest and most recent available chest CT, documenting intervals and technique changes.

purpose.zh: ≤12个月内平均径增加>1.5 mm符合增长。连续多次检查缓慢增长的实性／部分实性结节仍可进入4B；PET不摄取不能排除这类结节的恶性。
purpose.en: Growth is a >1.5 mm mean-diameter increase within ≤12 months. Solid/part-solid nodules growing slowly over multiple examinations may still merit 4B; absent PET avidity does not exclude malignancy.

title.zh: 结节大小速查（mm；补充来源：ACR v2022分类表）
title.en: Nodule size quick reference (mm; supplement: ACR v2022 category table)

zh: 按当前大小及行为重评
出现实性成分后按部分实性重评
按新类型及可疑征象重评
基线或新发<10 mm、实性、边缘光滑且呈卵圆／透镜／三角形可归2；圆形、不规则或达阈值者按常规结节重评。
en: Baseline/new <10 mm, solid, smooth and oval/lentiform/triangular qualifies for 2. Round, irregular or larger nodules follow the usual nodule criteria.

zh: 亚段支气管基线／新发／稳定通常2；段支气管及更近端基线／新发4A，3个月仍持续或增长升4B。提示分泌物的气泡／管状多发灶应结合形态。
en: Subsegmental baseline/new/stable nodules generally qualify for 2. Segmental/proximal baseline/new nodules merit 4A, escalating to 4B if persistent/growing at three months. Air-containing or multiple tubular opacities may favor secretions.

zh: 单房壁<2 mm不按囊肿算法分级；厚壁≥2 mm、多房基线或转为多房：4A；厚壁囊肿囊腔增长：3；壁厚／结节增长、多房囊肿增长或新发／增加房隔及阴影：4B。
en: Unilocular wall <2 mm is outside the atypical-cyst pathway. Wall ≥2 mm, baseline multiloculation or newly multilocular appearance: 4A. Growing cystic component of a thick-walled cyst: 3. Growing wall/nodularity, multilocular growth or increasing loculation/opacity: 4B.

zh: 0用于不完整检查或疑感染／炎症；1为无结节或明确良性钙化／脂肪；4X为3／4类附加可疑征象；S标记与肺癌无关的重要发现。
en: 0: incomplete or suspected infection/inflammation; 1: no nodules or unequivocal benign calcification/fat; 4X: category 3/4 plus suspicious features; S: significant non-lung-cancer finding.

steps.zh: 先判断检查是否完整及有无感染／炎症，再识别结节成分；按基线、新发或增长的对应列判定。总径与实性成分径不能互换。
steps.en: First check completeness and infection/inflammation, then nodule composition. Apply the baseline/new/growing pathway; total and solid-component diameters are not interchangeable.

steps.zh: 跨入新的大小类别即使未满足>1.5 mm增长定义，也按新的大小类别重评。纯磨玻璃缓慢增长可保留2，直到出现其他类别标准；实性／部分实性持续缓慢增长可为4B。
steps.en: Crossing a category size threshold warrants reassessment even without meeting the >1.5 mm growth definition. Slow-growing pure GGN can remain 2 until another criterion develops, whereas persistent slow solid/part-solid growth can merit 4B.

steps.zh: 用最可疑病灶确定检查类别；气道结节的持续存在应走气道分支，不能机械套用稳定4A的普通降级规则。
steps.en: Use the most suspicious finding for the examination category. Persistent airway nodules retain their airway pathway rather than the generic stable-4A downgrade.

management.zh: 通常1／2：12个月筛查；3：6个月LDCT；4A：3个月LDCT。实性结节或实性成分≥8 mm时可考虑PET/CT。4B／4X转入诊断性胸部CT、组织取样或专科评估，按具体风险及患者情况决定。
management.en: Usual intervals are 12 months for 1/2, six months for 3 and three months for 4A. Consider PET/CT for a solid nodule/component ≥8 mm. 4B/4X prompt diagnostic CT, sampling or specialist assessment tailored to risk and patient circumstances.

management.zh: 阶梯随访：普通4A在3个月稳定／缩小→3，从当前检查起6个月复查；3在6个月稳定／缩小→2，从当前检查起12个月筛查。完全消退或4B经诊断证明良性，可归1／2，视剩余所见而定。
management.en: Stepped follow-up: a non-airway 4A lesion stable/decreased at three months becomes 3 with six-month LDCT from the current study; a 3 lesion stable/decreased at six months becomes 2 with 12-month screening from the current study. Resolution or proven benign 4B permits 1/2 depending on remaining findings.

management.zh: 疑感染／炎症可归0并在1–3个月LDCT重评；后续间隔通常从当前判读检查日计算。例外：当前为PET/CT且其CT不符合筛查吸气／薄层要求时，应从最近一次LDCT日计时。
management.en: Suspected infection/inflammation may merit 0 with LDCT in 1–3 months. Subsequent intervals usually start at the interpreted study. Exception: if current PET/CT does not meet screening inspiration/thin-section requirements, use the date of the most recent LDCT.

cautions.zh: v2022中的人群类别比例不是单个患者的恶性概率；不要直接沿用v1.1的百分比或“稳定3个月即降2”规则。
cautions.en: Category population prevalence in v2022 is not an individual malignancy probability. Do not import v1.1 percentages or the old automatic downgrade to 2 after three-month stability.

cautions.zh: 伴结节的囊肿按最可疑部分判定；单纯薄壁囊肿和弥漫囊性肺病不直接纳入这一算法。
cautions.en: For a cyst with an associated nodule, manage the most suspicious component. Simple thin-walled cysts and diffuse cystic lung disease are outside this pathway.

title.zh: ACR Lung-RADS v2022 官方分类表（大小阈值）
title.en: ACR Lung-RADS v2022 category table (size thresholds)

name.zh: 卵巢及附件影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Ovarian-Adnexal Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 本条目仅收录超声系统，以附件病变的超声表现描述恶性风险。MRI 使用独立体系，不能直接套用下列超声类别。
summary.en: This entry covers the ultrasound system only, describing malignancy risk from adnexal lesion appearances. MRI has a separate system; these ultrasound categories are not interchangeable with MRI scores.

domain.zh: 卵巢及附件病变的超声风险评估
domain.en: Ultrasound risk assessment of ovarian and adnexal lesions

meaning.zh: 技术因素限制了病变特征的判断。
meaning.en: Technical limitations prevent adequate lesion characterization.

meaning.zh: 正常卵巢或生理性表现。
meaning.en: Normal ovarian appearance or physiologic findings.

meaning.zh: 恶性风险极低。
meaning.en: Malignancy is considered exceptionally unlikely.

meaning.zh: 恶性风险较低。
meaning.en: Findings fall in a lower malignancy-risk group.

meaning.zh: 恶性风险居中。
meaning.en: Findings fall in an intermediate malignancy-risk group.

meaning.zh: 恶性风险较高。
meaning.en: Findings fall in a higher malignancy-risk group.

explanation.zh: 附件区域病变，范围不限于卵巢本身。
explanation.en: A lesion in the adnexal region, not limited to the ovary itself.

explanation.zh: 基于超声的体系；请与 O-RADS MRI 区分。
explanation.en: The ultrasound framework, distinct from O-RADS MRI.

sources.title: O-RADS US v2022
O-RADS MRI Risk Stratification System

scope.zh: 用于卵巢／附件病灶的超声形态风险分层。先确认病灶起源，区分生理性所见、典型良性病变、无实性成分囊肿、含实性成分囊肿和实性病灶。风险描述可用于不同临床背景，但常规处理建议主要针对无急性症状、平均风险患者。
scope.en: Ultrasound morphologic risk stratification of ovarian/adnexal lesions. Establish lesion origin, then distinguish physiology, classic benign lesions, cysts without solid components, cysts with solid components and solid lesions. Risk descriptors may be used in different clinical settings; routine management primarily concerns average-risk patients without acute symptoms.

sourcePages.zh: 第3–5页图1，第7–8页术语及血流，第12–19页分级与处理
sourcePages.en: Pages 3–5, Figure 1; pages 7–8, lexicon/color score; pages 12–19, categories and management

purpose.zh: 使用灰阶和优化后的彩色多普勒，记录最大径、单／双／多房、内壁和间隔、实性成分／乳头状突起数、声影及腹水／腹膜结节。
purpose.en: Use gray-scale and optimized color Doppler. Record maximum size, locules, wall/septal contour, solid components/papillary count, acoustic shadowing and ascites/peritoneal nodules.

purpose.zh: 双房=2房，多房≥3房；实性成分为壁／间隔向腔内突出≥3 mm，乳头状突起三面被液体包围。实性病灶实性组织占≥80%。CS 1无、2少、3中等、4很丰富血流；声影须为弥漫或较宽声影而非折射伪影。
purpose.en: Bilocular means two locules; multilocular means at least three. A solid component protrudes ≥3 mm from wall/septum; a papillary projection is surrounded by fluid on three sides. A solid lesion is ≥80% solid. CS 1/2/3/4 indicates absent/minimal/moderate/very strong flow. Shadowing must be diffuse/broad, not refractive artifact.

title.en: US risk categories and morphologic pathways

zh: 技术因素使风险所需征象不能准确判定；复查US或MRI。
en: Technical limitations prevent assessment of risk features; repeat US or MRI.

zh: 无卵巢病灶；绝经前卵泡≤3 cm或黄体通常≤3 cm属于生理所见。
en: No ovarian lesion; a premenopausal follicle ≤3 cm or corpus luteum typically ≤3 cm is physiologic.

zh: 单纯囊肿<10 cm；光滑单房非单纯囊肿<10 cm；光滑双房囊肿<10 cm；典型良性卵巢病变<10 cm；典型良性卵巢外病变不限大小。
en: Simple cyst <10 cm; smooth unilocular nonsimple cyst <10 cm; smooth bilocular cyst <10 cm; classic benign ovarian lesion <10 cm; classic benign extraovarian lesion of any size.

zh: 典型良性卵巢病变≥10 cm；光滑单／双房囊肿≥10 cm；无实性成分的单房内壁不规则囊肿（<3 mm不规则）；光滑多房<10 cm且CS<4。
en: Classic benign ovarian lesion ≥10 cm; smooth uni/bilocular cyst ≥10 cm; unilocular cyst with irregular wall <3 mm but no solid component; smooth multilocular cyst <10 cm with CS <4.

zh: 光滑实性病灶CS 1（有无声影）；或光滑、有声影实性病灶CS 2–3；不限大小。
en: Smooth solid lesion with CS 1 regardless of shadowing, or smooth shadowing solid lesion with CS 2–3; any size.

zh: 双房囊肿内壁／间隔不规则；光滑多房≥10 cm且CS<4；光滑多房任何大小且CS 4；不规则多房任何大小和CS。
en: Irregular bilocular cyst; smooth multilocular cyst ≥10 cm with CS <4; smooth multilocular cyst of any size with CS 4; irregular multilocular cyst of any size/CS.

zh: 单房含实性成分且乳头状突起<4个，或不是乳头状突起的实性成分；双／多房含实性成分且CS 1–2；光滑无声影实性病灶CS 2–3。
en: Unilocular cyst with a solid component and fewer than four papillary projections, or a solid component not considered papillary; bi/multilocular cyst with solid component and CS 1–2; smooth nonshadowing solid lesion with CS 2–3.

zh: 单房囊肿≥4个乳头状突起；双／多房含实性成分且CS 3–4；光滑实性病灶CS 4（有无声影）；轮廓不规则实性病灶；不能以其他原因解释的腹水／腹膜结节。
en: Unilocular cyst with ≥4 papillary projections; bi/multilocular cyst with solid component and CS 3–4; smooth solid lesion with CS 4 regardless of shadowing; irregular solid lesion; ascites/peritoneal nodules not explained by another cause.

title.zh: 典型良性病变：满足典型征象后使用该分支
title.en: Classic benign lesions: use only when characteristic findings are present

zh: 单房、内部无血流，细网状纤维条或回缩血凝块（凹面／棱角边）；绝经前≤5 cm无需影像随访，>5且<10 cm复查2–3个月；早期绝经后<10 cm可2–3个月复查、专家US或MRI；晚期绝经后应改按一般形态重评。
en: Unilocular, no internal flow, reticular fibrin or retractile clot with concave/angular edges. Premenopausal ≤5 cm: no imaging follow-up; >5 and <10 cm: 2–3 months. Early postmenopausal <10 cm: short follow-up, specialist US or MRI. Late postmenopausal: reassess using general morphology.

zh: ≤3房、内部无血流，强回声伴声影、强回声线点或漂浮球状结构；≤3 cm可考虑12个月US，>3且<10 cm未切除者12个月US。
en: At most three locules, no internal flow, echogenic shadowing components, lines/dots or floating spheres. ≤3 cm: optional 12-month US; >3 and <10 cm: 12-month US if not excised.

zh: ≤3房、内部无血流、均匀低水平／磨玻璃回声且内壁／间隔光滑，可见周边壁点状强回声。绝经前<10 cm未切除者12个月US；绝经后初诊可先2–3个月复查、专家US或MRI确认。
en: At most three locules, no internal flow, homogeneous low-level/ground-glass echoes and smooth wall/septa, sometimes peripheral punctate wall foci. Premenopausal <10 cm: 12-month US if not excised. Postmenopausal initial assessment: short follow-up, specialist US or MRI to confirm.

zh: 与卵巢分离的单纯囊肿；典型者不需影像随访。
en: Simple cyst separate from ovary; no imaging follow-up when typical.

zh: 积液包绕／悬吊卵巢并顺应邻近盆腔器官，可有粘连形成的间隔；典型者不需影像随访。
en: Fluid surrounds/suspends the ovary and conforms to pelvic organs, sometimes with adhesion-related septa; no imaging follow-up when typical.

zh: 无回声管状结构、不完整间隔／内输卵管皱襞；典型者不需影像随访，症状由妇科处理。
en: Anechoic tubular structure with incomplete septa/endosalpingeal folds; no imaging follow-up when typical, with clinical gynecologic care as needed.

steps.zh: 先排除子宫或其他非附件起源病灶；技术不充分为0，正常／生理为1。识别典型良性病变后，再进入其大小和绝经状态分支。
steps.en: Exclude uterine or other nonadnexal origin. Inadequate imaging is 0 and normal/physiologic findings are 1. Identify classic benign lesions before applying size/menopausal pathways.

steps.zh: 非典型病变按房数→内壁／间隔→实性成分→乳头状突起数／CS／声影逐步判定。典型皮样或内膜异位囊肿出现非典型征象时，不继续套用典型良性分支。
steps.en: For other lesions assess locules, walls/septa, solid components, papillary count, CS and shadowing in sequence. A dermoid or endometrioma with atypical features leaves the classic-benign pathway.

steps.zh: 双侧或多病灶分别描述，各自评分；整体处理依据最高风险病灶。腹水需要排除肝硬化等其他原因，尤其在本来1／2类时。
steps.en: Describe and score bilateral/multiple lesions separately; management follows the highest-risk lesion. Consider alternative causes of ascites, particularly with otherwise category 1/2 findings.

management.zh: 2类单纯囊肿：绝经后≤3 cm无需随访，>3且<10 cm于12个月US；绝经前>3至5 cm无需随访，>5且<10 cm于12个月US。光滑非单纯单房或光滑双房≤3 cm绝经前无需随访、绝经后12个月US；>3且<10 cm者6个月US。
management.en: For category 2 simple cysts: postmenopausal ≤3 cm needs no follow-up, >3 and <10 cm gets 12-month US; premenopausal >3 to 5 cm needs none, >5 and <10 cm gets 12-month US. Smooth nonsimple unilocular or smooth bilocular ≤3 cm needs no premenopausal follow-up and 12-month postmenopausal US; >3 and <10 cm gets six-month US.

management.zh: 3类未手术者考虑6个月内US；实性病灶可专家US或MRI提高特异性。4类由妇科联合妇科肿瘤专科或妇科肿瘤专科评估，可专家US／MRI；5类由妇科肿瘤专科按方案处理。
management.en: Unexcised category 3 lesions may undergo US within six months; solid lesions benefit from specialist US/MRI. Category 4 warrants gynecologic care with gynecologic-oncology consultation or direct oncology care, with specialist US/MRI as appropriate. Category 5 proceeds under gynecologic oncology.

management.zh: 随访用平均线性径（长+宽+高）/3比较，约10%–15%变化帮助评估增长；稳定者可在初诊12和／或24个月复查，形态变化则重新评分，不只延长随访。
management.en: Compare average linear dimension (length + width + height)/3; approximately 10%–15% change informs growth assessment. Stable findings may be checked at 12 and/or 24 months from initial assessment; altered morphology requires rescoring.

cautions.zh: 急腹症、高遗传风险、妊娠及生育治疗等可能改变处理；不能把常规随访表直接用于这些情境。
cautions.en: Acute symptoms, genetic risk, pregnancy or fertility treatment can change management; routine intervals are not automatically transferable.

cautions.zh: O-RADS US与MRI的风险阈值不同；US的双房不能当作≥3房的多房。未显示卵巢在一般绝经后检查中不自动等于0，应结合检查目的。
cautions.en: US and MRI risk thresholds differ. Bilocular is not equivalent to multilocular. Nonvisualization of an ovary, especially after menopause, is not automatically 0; consider examination intent.

scope.zh: 用于无急性症状、平均风险患者的卵巢／附件病灶MRI风险分层，常用于超声不能确定的病灶。先确认附件来源；非附件病灶不套用此评分。MRI类别的恶性阳性预测值与US风险区间不能互换。
scope.en: MRI risk assessment of ovarian/adnexal lesions in average-risk patients without acute symptoms, often to characterize indeterminate US findings. Confirm adnexal origin; exclude nonadnexal masses. MRI category PPVs are not interchangeable with US risk ranges.

sourcePages.zh: 第3页图1，第4–5页术语／表2／强化曲线，第7–11页各评分解释
sourcePages.en: Page 3, Figure 1; pages 4–5, lexicon/Table 2/curves; pages 7–11, category explanations

purpose.zh: T1同反相位及脂肪抑制区分脂肪与血性／蛋白液体；T2评估房数、壁和组织；高b值DWI通常≥1000 s/mm²。图像须覆盖全部病灶。
purpose.en: Use in/opposed-phase and fat-suppressed T1 imaging to separate fat from blood/proteinaceous fluid, T2 imaging for locules/walls/tissue, and high-b DWI generally ≥1000 s/mm². Cover the entire lesion.

purpose.zh: 首选DCE（时间分辨率≤15秒，约4分钟），在最早强化的实性组织和外层子宫肌层放ROI。实性组织必须强化并有乳头状突起、壁结节、不规则壁／间隔或较大实性部分；光滑壁／间隔、血凝块和不强化碎屑不是该定义的实性组织。
purpose.en: Prefer DCE with ≤15-second temporal resolution for about four minutes, comparing early-enhancing tissue with outer myometrium. Solid tissue must enhance and have papillary projections, mural nodules, irregular wall/septa or a larger solid portion. Smooth walls/septa, clot and nonenhancing debris do not meet this definition.

zh: 技术不足或病灶未完整覆盖，不能完成风险评估。
en: Technically inadequate or incompletely imaged lesion prevents risk assessment.

zh: 正常卵巢；绝经前≤3 cm生理卵泡、出血性囊肿或黄体。
en: Normal ovaries; premenopausal physiologic follicles, hemorrhagic cysts or corpus luteum ≤3 cm.

zh: 无壁强化且无实性组织的单房囊肿（各种液体）；或单房单纯／内膜异位液体、光滑强化壁而无实性组织。典型含脂肪病灶（少量Rokitansky结节可强化）；均匀T2 dark/DWI dark实性组织；单纯液体输卵管积水及无实性组织卵巢旁囊肿。
en: Unilocular cyst with no enhancing wall/solid tissue, irrespective of fluid; or simple/endometriotic unilocular fluid with a smooth enhancing wall but no solid tissue. Typical fatty lesion with possible minimal Rokitansky enhancement; homogeneous T2 dark/DWI dark solid tissue; simple-fluid hydrosalpinx and paraovarian cyst without solid tissue.

zh: 血性／蛋白性／黏液性单房囊肿，光滑壁强化但无实性组织；非脂肪多房囊肿，光滑强化壁／间隔且无实性组织；非T2 dark/DWI dark实性组织低风险曲线；含非单纯液体或厚而光滑强化壁／皱襞的扩张输卵管。
en: Hemorrhagic/proteinaceous/mucinous unilocular cyst with smooth enhancing wall but no solid tissue; nonfatty multilocular cyst with smooth enhancing wall/septa and no solid tissue; non-dark solid tissue with low-risk curve; dilated tube with nonsimple fluid or thick smooth enhancing wall/folds.

zh: 非T2 dark/DWI dark实性组织中风险曲线；含脂肪病灶有大量强化实性组织（尤其不规则）。不能DCE时，30–40秒实性组织强化≤子宫肌层归4。
en: Non-dark solid tissue with intermediate-risk curve; fatty lesion with a large enhancing solid volume, especially irregular. Without DCE, non-dark solid tissue enhancing ≤myometrium at 30–40 seconds is assigned 4.

zh: 非T2 dark/DWI dark实性组织高风险曲线；或腹膜／肠系膜／网膜结节或不规则增厚，有无腹水均可。不能DCE时30–40秒实性组织强化>子宫肌层归5。
en: Non-dark solid tissue with high-risk curve; or peritoneal/mesenteric/omental nodularity or irregular thickening, with or without ascites. Without DCE, non-dark solid tissue enhancing >myometrium at 30–40 seconds is assigned 5.

title.zh: 实性组织强化曲线（参照外层子宫肌层）

zh: 逐渐缓慢上升，无明确肩部／平台→3（先排除均匀T2 dark/DWI dark的2类）。
en: Slow progressive rise without a defined shoulder/plateau →3, after excluding homogeneous T2 dark/DWI dark score 2.

zh: 初始斜率≤肌层，有肩部和平台→4。
en: Initial slope ≤myometrium, with shoulder and plateau →4.

zh: 初始斜率>肌层，有肩部和平台→5。
en: Initial slope >myometrium, with shoulder and plateau →5.

steps.zh: 确认来源与技术充分性，再识别生理所见和脂肪／液体类型。先查有无真正强化实性组织，不以“看上去实性”或DWI亮信号单独判断。
steps.en: Confirm origin and technical adequacy, then physiology and fat/fluid type. Identify true enhancing solid tissue rather than relying on a solid appearance or bright DWI alone.

steps.zh: 均匀T2和高b值DWI均低信号的纤维性组织优先归2，不随强化曲线升级；其他实性组织按DCE曲线判3／4／5。
steps.en: Homogeneous low signal on both T2 and high-b DWI prioritizes score 2 regardless of enhancement curve; assess other solid tissue by DCE to assign 3/4/5.

steps.zh: DCE不可行时用注射结束后30–40秒单期增强参照肌层，可分4／5，不能可靠区分3／4。子宫缺如时仍可识别低风险曲线，但中／高风险难可靠区分。
steps.en: If DCE is unavailable, enhancement at 30–40 seconds after injection can separate 4/5 relative to myometrium, but cannot reliably separate 3/4. After hysterectomy low-risk curves remain recognizable, while intermediate/high-risk distinction is limited.

management.zh: 0类需补足技术或重新检查；1类为正常／生理所见。2／3类支持低风险评估，4／5类提示需及时专科评估；原文未给出可替代US管理表的统一MRI随访间隔或自动手术阈值。
management.en: Complete inadequate imaging for score 0; score 1 represents physiology. Scores 2/3 support low-risk assessment and 4/5 prompt timely specialist evaluation. The source does not provide a universal MRI follow-up interval or automatic surgical threshold replacing the US management chart.

management.zh: 可同时报告具有典型影像特征的具体诊断，结合症状、临床风险与生育需求制定处理。PPV包括交界性与侵袭性恶性肿瘤，不能当作单个征象的独立风险。
management.en: Report a specific diagnosis when classic features support it and tailor management to symptoms, clinical risk and fertility considerations. PPVs include borderline and invasive malignancies and describe categories, not individual features.

cautions.zh: 输卵管皱襞不能误当乳头状突起；急性症状伴脓性输卵管病变不应套用该算法。
cautions.en: Do not mistake tubal folds for papillary projections; acute symptomatic pyosalpinx is outside the algorithm.

cautions.zh: 2022论文图5说明中关于小出血性囊肿存在与主算法不一致之处；本页按图1与评分1正文：绝经前≤3 cm生理出血性囊肿为1。
cautions.en: A small-hemorrhagic-cyst note in the Figure 5 caption conflicts with the main algorithm. This page follows Figure 1 and the score-1 text: premenopausal physiologic hemorrhagic cysts ≤3 cm are score 1.

name.zh: 前列腺影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Prostate Imaging Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 基于前列腺 MRI 判断病灶存在临床显著癌的可能性。类别不是病理分级，不能单独决定活检或治疗。
summary.en: Uses prostate MRI to assess the likelihood of clinically significant cancer in a lesion. Categories are not histologic grades and cannot determine biopsy or treatment on their own.

organization: American College of Radiology (ACR), ESUR and AdMeTech Foundation

domain.zh: 临床显著前列腺癌的 MRI 评估
domain.en: MRI assessment for clinically significant prostate cancer

meaning.zh: 临床显著癌的可能性极低。
meaning.en: MRI provides very little suspicion of clinically significant cancer.

meaning.zh: 临床显著癌的可能性较低。
meaning.en: MRI provides limited suspicion of clinically significant cancer.

meaning.zh: 是否存在临床显著癌尚不确定。
meaning.en: MRI leaves clinically significant cancer uncertain.

meaning.zh: 临床显著癌的可能性较高。
meaning.en: MRI supports substantial suspicion of clinically significant cancer.

meaning.zh: 临床显著癌的可能性很高。
meaning.en: MRI strongly supports suspicion of clinically significant cancer.

explanation.zh: 弥散加权成像，是外周带评估的重要序列。
explanation.en: Diffusion-weighted imaging has a leading role in peripheral-zone assessment.

explanation.zh: T2 加权成像，是移行带评估的重要序列。
explanation.en: T2-weighted imaging has a leading role in transition-zone assessment.

purpose.zh: 所有前列腺 MRI 均应获取。主要识别前列腺及精囊出血、勾画腺体轮廓；也可辅助观察淋巴结和骨骼。它不是 PI-RADS 总体评分的主导序列。
purpose.en: Obtain for every prostate MRI. It primarily identifies hemorrhage in the prostate and seminal vesicles and outlines the gland; it can also help assess lymph nodes and bone. It is not a dominant sequence for the overall PI-RADS score.

purpose.zh: 用于辨认前列腺分区、腺内异常、精囊受累、腺外侵犯和淋巴结。它是移行带（TZ）总体 PI-RADS 评分的主导序列。
purpose.en: Used to identify zonal anatomy, intraprostatic abnormalities, seminal-vesicle involvement, extraprostatic extension, and lymph nodes. It is the dominant sequence for the overall PI-RADS score in the transition zone (TZ).

purpose.zh: 反映水分子扩散；应包含 ADC 图和高 b 值图像。用于评估局灶性受限扩散，是外周带（PZ）总体 PI-RADS 评分的主导序列。
purpose.en: Reflects water diffusion and should include an ADC map and high b-value images. It assesses focal restricted diffusion and is the dominant sequence for the overall PI-RADS score in the peripheral zone (PZ).

purpose.zh: 观察局灶、早于或与邻近正常前列腺组织同期、且与 T2W 或 DWI 异常对应的强化。若 T2W 和 DWI 质量合格，它通常只在外周带 DWI 评分为 3 时影响总体类别。
purpose.en: Assesses focal enhancement that is earlier than or contemporaneous with adjacent normal prostate tissue and corresponds to a T2W or DWI abnormality. When T2W and DWI are diagnostic, it usually affects the overall category only for a peripheral-zone lesion with a DWI score of 3.

steps.zh: 先确定病灶位于外周带还是移行带；分区决定主导序列。
steps.en: First determine whether the lesion is in the peripheral or transition zone; the zone determines the dominant sequence.

steps.zh: 外周带：以 DWI 评分决定总体 PI-RADS。DWI 为 1、2、4 或 5 时总体类别相同；DWI 为 3 时，若该病灶 DCE 阳性则为 PI-RADS 4，否则为 PI-RADS 3。
steps.en: Peripheral zone: use the DWI score to determine the overall PI-RADS assessment. DWI scores of 1, 2, 4, or 5 give the same overall category; with DWI of 3, positive DCE for that lesion gives PI-RADS 4, otherwise PI-RADS 3.

steps.zh: 移行带：以 T2W 评分决定总体 PI-RADS。T2W 为 1、4 或 5 时总体类别分别为 PI-RADS 1、4 或 5；T2W 为 2 时，DWI ≤3 为 PI-RADS 2、DWI ≥4 为 PI-RADS 3；T2W 为 3 时，DWI ≤4 为 PI-RADS 3，T2W 为 3 且 DWI 为 5 时，总体类别为 PI-RADS 4。DCE 不改变总体类别。
steps.en: Transition zone: use the T2W score to determine the overall PI-RADS assessment. T2W scores of 1, 4, or 5 give PI-RADS 1, 4, or 5; with T2W of 2, DWI ≤3 is PI-RADS 2 and DWI ≥4 is PI-RADS 3; with T2W of 3, DWI ≤4 is PI-RADS 3, while a T2W score of 3 with DWI of 5 is PI-RADS 4. DCE does not alter the overall category.

steps.zh: 总体类别仅基于 mpMRI 所见；PI-RADS v2.1 本身不提供活检或治疗决策规则。
steps.en: The overall category is based only on mpMRI findings; PI-RADS v2.1 itself does not provide biopsy or treatment decision rules.

cautions.zh: 若 T2W、DWI 或 DCE 技术不合格或缺失，应在相应序列标为 X；缺失 DWI 是重要限制，通常应在可补救时重做。
cautions.en: If T2W, DWI, or DCE is technically inadequate or absent, mark that sequence as X. Missing DWI is a substantial limitation and should usually be repeated when remediable.

cautions.zh: 炎症、出血和良性前列腺增生可产生相似信号或强化表现；本页不能替代对完整 v2.1 原文、临床信息和当地规范的审阅。
cautions.en: Inflammation, hemorrhage, and benign prostatic hyperplasia can create similar signal or enhancement patterns. This page does not replace review of the complete v2.1 source, clinical information, and local standards.

sources.title: PI-RADS v2.1

name.zh: 甲状腺影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Thyroid Imaging Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: ACR TI-RADS 根据甲状腺结节的超声特征进行风险分层。这里仅解释类别，不提供积分计算或穿刺、随访阈值；请勿与其他 TI-RADS 体系混用。
summary.en: ACR TI-RADS groups thyroid nodules by ultrasound features. This overview explains categories without point calculations or biopsy and follow-up thresholds; other TI-RADS systems use different rules.

domain.zh: 甲状腺结节的超声风险分层
domain.en: Ultrasound risk stratification of thyroid nodules

meaning.zh: 超声特征归入良性类别。
meaning.en: Ultrasound features place the nodule in the benign group.

meaning.zh: 超声特征未达到可疑类别。
meaning.en: Ultrasound features fall below the suspicious groups.

meaning.zh: 超声特征呈轻度疑恶性。
meaning.en: Ultrasound features raise mild concern for malignancy.

meaning.zh: 超声特征呈中度疑恶性。
meaning.en: Ultrasound features raise moderate concern for malignancy.

meaning.zh: 超声特征呈高度疑恶性，并非病理确诊。
meaning.en: Ultrasound features raise strong concern without establishing a pathology diagnosis.

explanation.zh: 描述结节内囊性与实性成分。
explanation.en: Describes the cystic and solid components of a nodule.

explanation.zh: 描述结节内亮回声灶的形态。
explanation.en: Describes the appearance of bright echoes within a nodule.

sources.title: Thyroid Imaging Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 用于甲状腺结节超声风险分层，采用五类征象累加计分。结节最大径用于穿刺／随访决策，但不参与风险分数；本节不混入其他TI-RADS体系。
scope.en: Ultrasound risk stratification of thyroid nodules by summing five feature groups. Maximum diameter guides FNA/follow-up but does not contribute to the risk score. Other TI-RADS systems are not incorporated.

sourcePages.zh: 第2–3页概述及图1，第4–6页征象／测量／增长和随访，第7页多结节选择
sourcePages.en: Pages 2–3, overview/Figure 1; pages 4–6, features/measurement/growth/follow-up; page 7, multinodular selection

purpose.zh: 记录三个正交径和部位，含晕环；用最大径对照处理阈值。纵横比在横断面按与声束平行的高度和垂直声束的宽度判断。囊实性结节的回声按实性成分评估。
purpose.en: Record three orthogonal dimensions and location, including any halo. Use maximum size for management thresholds. Assess taller-than-wide on the axial plane with height parallel and width perpendicular to the beam. Assess echogenicity of the solid component in mixed nodules.

purpose.zh: 成分、回声、形状、边缘各选一项；强回声灶选所有适用项并累加。纯囊性或海绵样直接0分，不再加其他征象。
purpose.en: Select one feature each for composition, echogenicity, shape and margin; add all applicable echogenic foci. Cystic/almost completely cystic and spongiform nodules receive zero without further scoring.

zh: 纯／近乎纯囊性0；海绵样0；囊实性1；实性／近乎实性2。
en: Cystic/almost cystic 0; spongiform 0; mixed cystic-solid 1; solid/almost solid 2.

zh: 无回声0；高／等回声1；低回声2；极低回声（低于颈前带状肌）3。
en: Anechoic 0; hyperechoic/isoechoic 1; hypoechoic 2; very hypoechoic relative to strap muscle 3.

zh: 光滑0；边界不清0；分叶／不规则2；甲状腺外侵犯3。
无或大彗星尾伪影0；粗大钙化1；周边环状钙化2；点状强回声灶3。
en: None/large comet-tail 0; macrocalcification 1; peripheral/rim calcification 2; punctate echogenic foci 3.

title.zh: 总分、等级及2017版处理阈值
title.en: Total points, categories and 2017 management thresholds

en: ≥0.5 cm: annually, up to five years

steps.zh: 先判断纯囊性／海绵样；其余按五类征象加分。海绵样需>50%由小囊腔组成，不是有几个散在囊腔即可。
steps.en: First identify cystic/spongiform nodules; otherwise sum the five groups. Spongiform requires >50% small cystic spaces, not merely a few scattered cystic areas.

steps.zh: 钙化声影遮挡成分时成分记2分；回声无法判定记1分；边缘无法判定记0分。小彗星尾出现在实性成分内可按点状强回声灶，不能与囊腔内大彗星尾混淆。
steps.en: If calcific shadowing obscures composition assign 2; if echogenicity is indeterminate assign 1; if margin is indeterminate assign 0. Small comet tails in solid tissue can qualify as punctate foci, unlike large comet tails in cystic components.

steps.zh: 总分确定TR级别，再用最大径决定是否达到FNA或随访阈值。普通可计分结节至少2分，因此没有单独的1分等级或TR0。
steps.en: Determine TR level from total points, then apply maximum-size management thresholds. Non-zero scored nodules have at least two points; there is no separate one-point category or TR0.

management.zh: 未达FNA而达到随访阈值者按表随访；5年大小不变可停止。显著增长为至少两个径线增加≥20%且至少增加2 mm，或体积增加≥50%；重评大小阈值。
management.en: Follow nodules above surveillance but below FNA thresholds according to the table. Five-year size stability can end surveillance. Significant growth is ≥20% in at least two dimensions with at least a 2 mm increase, or ≥50% volume increase; reassess size thresholds.

management.zh: 随访中TR级别增加，下次US在1年。多个结节优先随访最高分且符合条件者，最多4个；FNA优先最高分且达到阈值者，最多2个，不只选择最大结节。
management.en: If TR level rises, the next US is in one year. Follow up to four qualifying highest-scoring nodules; biopsy up to two qualifying highest-scoring nodules rather than choosing only the largest.

management.zh: 已穿刺结节的再次穿刺由既往细胞学等决定；原文不专门规定其随访。TR5的5–9 mm结节在部分临床情境可共同决策考虑穿刺，不能把常规阈值理解为绝对禁止。
management.en: Repeat biopsy of previously sampled nodules depends on cytology and clinical context; the source does not prescribe their surveillance. Selected 5–9 mm TR5 nodules may merit shared-decision biopsy rather than an absolute prohibition.

cautions.zh: 血流与弹性成像不计入2017 ACR分数；接触腺体边界不能自动视为明确腺外侵犯。
cautions.en: Vascularity and elastography are not scored in the 2017 ACR system. Border abutment alone does not establish definite extrathyroidal invasion.

cautions.zh: 合并可疑淋巴结、临床高危因素或有限预期寿命时需个体化；评分风险不等于病理诊断。
cautions.en: Suspicious nodes, clinical risk and limited life expectancy require individualized assessment; a risk category is not a histologic diagnosis.

name.zh: CT 结肠成像报告和数据系统
name.en: CT Colonography Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于 CT 结肠成像的结直肠与结肠外发现报告。下列为类别教学摘要；检查质量、病灶测量及后续处理应查阅 ACR 当前原文。
summary.en: Supports reporting of colorectal and extracolonic findings at CT colonography. The categories below are a teaching summary; consult the current ACR source for examination quality, lesion measurements and follow-up.

domain.zh: CT 结肠成像筛查与报告

categoryRange: Colonic: C0–C4; extracolonic: E0 (optional), E1/E2, E3, E4

meaning.zh: 检查不足或等待既往检查比较，尚不能完成结直肠评估。
meaning.en: The study is inadequate or prior examinations are awaited before colorectal assessment is complete.

meaning.zh: 结肠正常或见良性病变。
meaning.en: The colon is normal or has a benign lesion.

meaning.zh: 中等大小息肉或未定性发现。
meaning.en: An intermediate polyp or indeterminate finding is present.

meaning.zh: 表现倾向良性的憩室相关发现。
meaning.en: A diverticular finding is likely benign.

meaning.zh: 息肉表现可能对应进展期腺瘤。
meaning.en: A polyp may represent an advanced adenoma.

meaning.zh: 结肠肿块表现提示恶性可能。
meaning.en: A colonic mass is likely malignant.

categories.original: Normal anatomic variant or benign finding

meaning.zh: 结肠外正常解剖变异或良性发现。
meaning.en: An extracolonic normal anatomic variant or benign finding.

meaning.zh: 结肠外发现可能不重要，但尚未完全定性。
meaning.en: An extracolonic finding is likely unimportant but incompletely characterized.

meaning.zh: 可能具有临床重要性的结肠外发现。
meaning.en: A potentially important extracolonic finding.

explanation.zh: 以 CT 进行结肠与直肠评估的检查。
explanation.en: A CT examination used to assess the colon and rectum.

explanation.zh: 结肠以外解剖区域的发现，使用 E 类别描述。
explanation.en: A finding outside the colon, described with E categories.

sources.title: CT Colonography Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 用于CT结肠成像（CTC），结肠内C分类与结肠外E分类分别报告。结合检查质量、病变大小、数量、形态及既往变化，不采用累加分数。2023版新增C2b并合并E1/E2。
scope.en: For CT colonography (CTC), report separate colonic C and extracolonic E categories. Use examination adequacy, lesion size/count/morphology and interval change rather than a point sum. Version 2023 adds C2b and merges E1/E2.

sourcePages.zh: 第2页表1，第4页测量，第6–7页表2，第8–10页表3–4及结肠外解释
sourcePages.en: Page 2, Table 1; page 4, measurement; pages 6–7, Table 2; pages 8–10, Tables 3–4 and extracolonic discussion

purpose.zh: 记录清洁、标记和充气是否充分，对照双体位。大便内气体／标记剂提示残渣；脂肪密度提示脂肪瘤或内翻憩室。注明六个标准结肠段位置和形态。
purpose.en: Document cleansing, tagging and distention, comparing both positions. Internal gas/tagging favors stool; macroscopic fat favors lipoma/inverted diverticulum. Report morphology and location in the six standard colonic segments.

purpose.zh: 测病变最大径；带蒂息肉不把蒂计入头部大小。用合适息肉窗和2D／3D排除贴附造影剂及测量伪差。≤5 mm微小病变通常不报告；≥6 mm开始影响分类。
purpose.en: Measure greatest lesion size; exclude the stalk from polyp-head measurement. Use suitable polyp windows and 2D/3D assessment to avoid adherent contrast/measurement artifacts. Diminutive ≤5 mm findings are usually not reported; ≥6 mm affects categorization.

title.zh: 结肠内分类及原文处理

zh: 准备不佳不能排除≥10 mm病灶；双体位均有节段塌陷（疑似憩室肌增厚除外）；或等待必要既往对照。
补充既往报告附录；技术不足则重做CTC或改其他筛查。
en: Inadequate prep prevents exclusion of ≥10 mm lesions; segment collapse on both views except suspected diverticular myochosis; or necessary prior comparisons pending.
Amend after comparison; repeat CTC or use an alternative screening test if inadequate.

zh: 无异常或良性所见，无≥6 mm息肉；可有≤5 mm病变、脂肪瘤、内翻憩室等。
常规筛查每5–10年，按当地方案及具体情况。
en: No abnormality or benign findings and no polyp ≥6 mm; may include ≤5 mm lesions, lipoma or inverted diverticulum.
Routine screening every 5–10 years, tailored to local practice/context.

zh: 6–9 mm息肉少于3个（1–2个）或不确定所见。
3年CTC或结肠镜切除；需结合患者情况及判读信心。
en: One/two 6–9 mm polyps or an indeterminate finding.
Three-year CTC or colonoscopy/polypectomy, considering circumstances and confidence.

zh: 倾向良性憩室相关肿块样肌增厚、肥厚或狭窄。
倾向良性5年CTC；良性信心不足≤3年CTC。
en: Likely benign diverticular mass-like myochosis, muscular hypertrophy or stricture.
Five-year CTC if likely benign; ≤3 years if benignity uncertain.

zh: ≥10 mm息肉／黏膜下病变；或≥3个6–9 mm息肉；或既往C2a息肉随访增大。
en: Polyp/subepithelial lesion ≥10 mm; ≥3 polyps each 6–9 mm; or an enlarging previously C2a polyp.

zh: ≥30 mm息肉样肿块或恶性形态肿块，累及肠腔或有结肠外侵犯。
结肠镜、外科和／或肿瘤专科会诊。
en: Polypoid mass ≥30 mm or malignant-appearing mass compromising the lumen or with extracolonic invasion.

title.zh: 结肠外分类：与C分类独立
title.en: Extracolonic categories: independent of C score

zh: 2023版仍可表达检查对结肠外软组织评价严重受限的情形，使用为可选。
en: Version 2023 retains optional documentation of severely limited extracolonic assessment.

zh: 无重要结肠外所见或已知稳定且不需进一步处理者，例如明确良性肝／肾囊肿。
en: No clinically important finding, or a stable known finding needing no workup, such as clearly benign liver/renal cysts.

zh: 可能不重要但尚未充分确定，例如无可疑征象的不确定绝经后附件囊性病变。
可需进一步检查，结合当地规范及患者意愿。
en: Likely unimportant but incompletely characterized, such as an indeterminate postmenopausal cystic adnexal finding without suspicious features.
Further workup may be appropriate, considering local practice/preference.

zh: 可能重要，例如明显／高度疑似恶性肿块、腹膜结节或有梗阻的尿路结石。
需要进一步评估并向转诊医生沟通。
en: Likely important, such as an overt/highly suspicious mass, peritoneal nodularity or obstructing urinary calculus.
Further workup and communication with the referring clinician.

steps.zh: 先评估技术充分性，再排除残渣和明确良性所见；结合最大病灶大小、6–9 mm病灶数量及随访增长，确定最高相关C类别。
steps.en: Check adequacy, exclude stool and clearly benign findings, then use greatest lesion size, number of 6–9 mm lesions and interval growth to assign the highest relevant C category.

steps.zh: 憩室病所致对称壁增厚／狭窄、保留结肠袋结构且倾向良性时考虑C2b，不能把所有肿块样狭窄都降为C2b。
steps.en: Consider C2b for likely benign diverticular symmetric thickening/stricture with preserved haustral architecture; not every mass-like stricture qualifies.

steps.zh: 独立检查结肠外器官并给E分类。低剂量无增强CT不能对所有发现定性，利用既往检查可避免把已知稳定病变升级。
steps.en: Assess extracolonic organs independently and assign E category. Low-dose noncontrast CT cannot characterize every finding; prior studies can prevent escalation of known stable findings.

management.zh: 分类表列出的随访或转诊是2023版原文建议；症状、既往癌症、判读信心及本地筛查方案会影响具体间隔。C3／C4重要阳性发现需及时沟通。
management.en: Follow-up/referral in the table reflects the 2023 source. Symptoms, prior cancer, confidence and local screening programs affect intervals; communicate important C3/C4 findings promptly.

management.zh: 结肠外E3是否检查与E4需检查应明确区分；已知稳定发现可根据既往结果判断是否仍需后续检查。
management.en: Distinguish possible workup for E3 from needed workup for E4; use prior results to establish whether a stable known finding still warrants assessment.

cautions.zh: C2b与C0有边界：明确疑似憩室肌增厚可以C2b，普通充气不足仍可C0。大小达阈值、数量达3个或随访增长均可能改变分类。
cautions.en: Differentiate C2b from C0: suspected diverticular myochosis may qualify for C2b, while simple inadequate distention may remain C0. Size thresholds, three-polyps count and interval growth can each change category.

cautions.zh: 2023版E1/E2合并不能拆回旧版两类；E0是可选项。本分类不能替代病理学。
cautions.en: Do not split the merged 2023 E1/E2 into the old categories. E0 is optional; classification is not histology.

name.zh: 颈部影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Neck Imaging Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于头颈部肿瘤根治性治疗后的影像监测与复发风险分层，可用于 CT、MRI 或 PET 影像。类别用于治疗后监测，不用于治疗期间。
summary.en: Supports post-treatment surveillance and recurrence risk stratification after curative treatment for head and neck cancer, using CT, MRI or PET imaging. The categories are for post-treatment surveillance, not imaging during treatment.

domain.zh: 头颈部肿瘤治疗后监测
domain.en: Post-treatment surveillance of head and neck cancer

meaning.zh: 缺少必要比较资料或评估不完整。
meaning.en: Necessary comparison studies are unavailable or the assessment is incomplete.

meaning.zh: 未见复发证据。
meaning.en: No evidence of recurrence is identified.

meaning.zh: 复发可能性较低。
meaning.en: Findings raise low suspicion for recurrence.

meaning.zh: 复发可能性较高。
meaning.en: Findings raise high suspicion for recurrence.

meaning.zh: 已证实或影像及临床进展明确支持复发。
meaning.en: Recurrence is pathologically proven or definitively supported by radiologic and clinical progression.

explanation.zh: 根治性治疗结束后的随访影像监测。
explanation.en: Imaging surveillance after definitive or curative treatment.

explanation.zh: 原发肿瘤所在区域，与颈部淋巴结评估并列。
explanation.en: The original tumor location, assessed alongside cervical lymph nodes.

sources.title: ACR Neck Imaging Reporting and Data System for MRI Version 2025
ACR Neck Imaging Reporting and Data Systems (NI-RADS)

scope.zh: 用于头颈癌根治性／治愈目的治疗完成后的MRI监测，不用于治疗进行中。原发部位与颈部淋巴结分别分类；原发部位低可疑分2a（黏膜）和2b（深部），淋巴结低可疑为2，不照搬2a／2b。治疗前、首次治疗后基线及后续检查需分别比较。
scope.en: For MRI surveillance after definitive/curative head/neck cancer treatment, not during treatment. Assign separate primary-site and neck-node categories. Primary low-suspicion findings split into mucosal 2a and deep 2b; neck low suspicion is 2 without a/b subdivision. Distinguish pretreatment, first posttreatment baseline and subsequent comparisons.

sourcePages.zh: 第2–5页表1与脚注，第6–10页NI-RADS 1–4解释和病例
sourcePages.en: Pages 2–5, Table 1/footnotes; pages 6–10, NI-RADS 1–4 explanations and cases

purpose.zh: 比较T1、T2、DWI及增强特征与原始肿瘤；记录是否呈结节／肿块样、是否增长及是否累及颅底孔道／神经周围。熟悉重建皮瓣及放疗改变。
purpose.en: Compare T1, T2, DWI and enhancement with the original tumor. Document nodular/mass-like appearance, growth and skull-base foraminal/perineural involvement; recognize flap and radiation changes.

purpose.zh: 残余淋巴结组织与监测中新发／增大的结节区别处理；可用PET时结合FDG。PET与MRI不一致的低可疑规则仅适用于原始肿瘤曾FDG摄取者。
purpose.en: Distinguish residual treated nodal tissue from new/enlarging nodes arising during surveillance. Incorporate FDG PET when available. The low-suspicion PET/MRI discordance rule applies only if the original tumor was FDG-avid.

title.en: Primary site: MRI criteria and management

zh: 原发肿瘤未知：P-unknown primary；原发部位因牙科伪影、运动、技术或覆盖不足不能评估：P-x；颈部未覆盖或不能评估：N-x。
注明无法评估的部位及原因，不用0代替这些标记。
en: Unknown primary: P-unknown primary. Unassessable primary from dental/motion/technical/coverage limitation: P-x. Neck not covered or otherwise unassessable: N-x.
Document the region/limitation; these markers are not category 0.

zh: 新基线缺乏对照，且知道既往图像存在并会取得。
en: New baseline without comparison, knowing prior images exist and will become available.

zh: 预期治疗后改变、弥漫薄线样黏膜强化／黏膜下水肿、低T1/T2瘢痕或非肿块样T2高信号；首次基线肿瘤消退／神经周围所见减少；后续无新结节且神经周围稳定／减少。
en: Expected posttreatment changes, thin linear enhancement/edema, low-T1/T2 fibrosis or non-mass-like T2-bright change. First baseline: tumor resolution/reduced perineural findings; later: no new nodule and stable/reduced perineural findings.

zh: 局灶非肿块样黏膜强化或局灶受限扩散，尤其首次治疗后检查。
en: Focal non-mass-like mucosal enhancement or focal reduced diffusion, especially on the first posttreatment study.

zh: 深部边界不清、非结节样组织；MRI特征不同于原肿瘤；中等T2信号和中等强化；首次基线肿瘤部分消退、神经周围同原肿瘤表现但未变，或放射野内新薄而光滑神经强化。
短期MRI或PET；颅底神经周围所见优先MRI。
en: Deep ill-defined non-nodular tissue; features unlike the original tumor; intermediate T2/enhancement; first baseline partial resolution, unchanged tumor-like perineural tissue, or new thin smooth nerve enhancement in the radiation field.
Short-interval MRI or PET; prefer MRI for skull-base perineural findings.

zh: 明确结节／肿块，尤其新发／增大且信号强化类似原肿瘤；或局灶强FDG；神经／颅底孔道软组织、脂肪间隙消失或结节样强化增加。持续增大的明确肿块即使信号不匹配也归3。
临床适宜时影像引导或临床活检。
en: Discrete nodule/mass, especially new/enlarging and matching the original tumor; focal intense FDG; increasing foraminal/perineural tissue, fat effacement or nodular enhancement. Persistent growth of a discrete mass merits 3 even if signal differs.
Image-guided or clinical biopsy if clinically indicated.

zh: 病理证实复发，或明确影像和临床进展。
en: Pathologically proven recurrence or definite radiologic and clinical progression.

zh: 0同上；1为原异常结节处残余组织低强化，若有PET则无FDG摄取。治疗后变小／稳定结节的不规则边缘不能按“新发不规则结节”升级。
en: 0 as above. 1 includes hypoenhancing residual tissue at a previously abnormal node, without FDG uptake if PET is available. Irregular borders in treated stable/decreasing nodes are not equivalent to newly abnormal nodes.

zh: 残余组织有异质强化或轻中度FDG；新发／增大结节但无明确异常形态；或符合适用条件的PET/MRI不一致（discordance）。
en: Residual heterogeneous enhancement or mild/moderate FDG; new/enlarging node without definitive abnormal morphology; eligible PET/MRI discordance.

zh: 残余组织有强FDG或明确增大／强化增加；新发／增大结节伴坏死、囊变、不规则边缘或强局灶FDG。新明显结外侵犯亦异常。
en: Residual tissue with intense FDG or definite enlargement/increased enhancement; new/enlarging node with necrosis, cystic change, irregular borders or intense focal FDG. New gross extranodal invasion is also abnormal.

zh: 病理证实或明确影像和临床进展。
en: Pathologic proof or definite radiologic and clinical progression.

steps.zh: 先找治疗前肿瘤及首次治疗后基线，按原发部位与淋巴结分别分类，不合并成一个总分。
steps.en: Review the pretreatment tumor and first posttreatment baseline, and classify primary site and nodes separately rather than summing a single score.

steps.zh: 局灶黏膜异常先区分非肿块样2a与新发／增大的肿块样3；深部异常比较T2／DWI／强化及神经周围变化，区分1、2b、3。
steps.en: For mucosal change distinguish non-mass-like 2a from new/enlarging mass-like 3; for deep findings compare T2/DWI/enhancement and perineural change to separate 1, 2b and 3.

steps.zh: 随访既往2类异常时，应依据新检查尽量明确消退／稳定的治疗后改变或进展可疑，避免没有重新判断而连续重复2。
steps.en: On follow-up of a category 2 finding, reassess whether it represents resolving/stable treatment change or suspicious progression rather than repeatedly carrying 2 forward without reevaluation.

management.zh: 原发2a直接视诊；原发2b或颈部2短期MRI／PET。2025版表1未给所有2类统一固定月数，本页不把2018版3个月机械移植。
management.en: Inspect primary 2a directly; use short-interval MRI/PET for primary 2b or neck 2. The 2025 table does not prescribe one fixed interval for all category 2 findings, so the 2018 three-month interval is not automatically transferred.

management.zh: 3类在适宜且可取样时活检；颅底神经周围病变不易取样，需多学科考虑复查、其他影像或处理。4类按确证复发临床管理。
management.en: Biopsy category 3 when indicated and accessible. Perineural skull-base lesions may require multidisciplinary consideration of further imaging or management when sampling is difficult. Manage category 4 as definitive recurrence.

cautions.zh: 不新增未经原文规定的ADC数字阈值；DWI必须与形态、T2和强化综合判断。炎症／治疗改变可有强化及扩散异常。
cautions.en: Do not introduce an ADC cutoff absent from the source; integrate DWI with morphology, T2 and enhancement. Inflammation/treatment effects can enhance and alter diffusion.

cautions.zh: 原始肿瘤FDG不摄取时不能套用PET阴性降级逻辑；单凭残余大小或治疗后边缘不规则不能诊断复发。
cautions.en: A non-FDG-avid original tumor precludes using PET negativity as reassuring discordance. Residual size or posttreatment irregular borders alone does not establish recurrence.

scope.zh: 用于头颈癌治疗后CT与FDG PET/CT监测。原发部位和颈部淋巴结分别报告；2018版的CT密度、差异强化和FDG标准与2025版MRI信号标准分开使用。
scope.en: For CT and FDG PET/CT surveillance after head/neck cancer treatment. Report primary site and neck nodes separately; keep the 2018 CT-density/differential-enhancement/FDG criteria distinct from 2025 MRI signal criteria.

sourcePages.zh: 第2–4页类别、表1–2与图1，第5–9页原发灶／淋巴结实例和处理
sourcePages.en: Pages 2–4, categories/Tables 1–2/Figure 1; pages 5–9, primary-site/nodal examples and management

purpose.zh: 与治疗前和治疗后基线对照，评估软组织是弥漫治疗后扭曲还是独立结节／肿块，是否有差异强化及局灶FDG；了解原始肿瘤摄取及重建解剖。
purpose.en: Compare pretreatment and posttreatment baseline studies, separating diffuse treated distortion from a discrete nodule/mass and assessing differential enhancement/focal FDG. Know original avidity and reconstructed anatomy.

purpose.zh: 记录原发床、黏膜和深部异常；结节评估新发／增长、坏死及明显结外侵犯。可疑程度不是只按大小决定。
purpose.en: Document mucosal/deep primary-bed changes; assess nodes for new appearance/growth, necrosis and gross extranodal invasion. Suspicion is not determined by size alone.

zh: 新基线无既往图像，已知既往图像存在且将可取得。
en: New baseline with prior images known to exist but not yet available.
Assign category in an addendum after comparison.

zh: 预期治疗后改变；非肿块样软组织扭曲、低密度黏液性水肿、放疗后弥漫线样黏膜强化；无异常FDG。
en: Expected changes: non-mass-like distortion, low-density mucoid edema or diffuse linear postradiation enhancement; no abnormal FDG.

zh: 局灶黏膜强化但非肿块样，或局灶轻中度黏膜FDG。
en: Focal non-mass-like mucosal enhancement or mild/moderate focal mucosal FDG.

zh: 深部边界不清、非独立肿块软组织；很少／无差异强化或轻中度FDG。
短期复查（约3个月）或重复PET。
en: Deep ill-defined nondiscrete tissue, little/no differential enhancement or mild/moderate FDG.
Short-interval follow-up, about three months, or repeat PET.

zh: 新发／增大原发肿块；独立结节／肿块伴差异强化；或强局灶FDG。
en: New/enlarging primary mass, discrete differentially enhancing nodule/mass, or intense focal FDG.

zh: 病理证实或明确影像与临床进展。
en: Pathologic proof or definite imaging and clinical progression.

zh: 预期治疗后残余改变，无高度可疑形态／代谢。
en: Expected residual treated change without highly suspicious morphology/metabolism.

zh: 低可疑形态或轻中度FDG，例如未完全恢复但缺乏明确复发征象的结节；短期复查，淋巴结不分2a／2b。
en: Low-suspicion morphology or mild/moderate FDG, such as incompletely resolved nodes without definite recurrence features. Short follow-up; no nodal 2a/b subdivision.

zh: 新发／增大结节或强局灶FDG，尤其新坏死、明显结外侵犯等高度可疑形态。
en: New/enlarging node or intense focal FDG, especially new necrosis/gross extranodal invasion.

zh: 病理证实或明确影像与临床进展。
en: Pathologic proof or definite imaging and clinical progression.

steps.zh: 确认是否已有可用对照；0不是所有缺少对照的检查通用类别，需满足预计会取得既往图像的条件。
steps.en: Check comparison availability; 0 is not a universal label for any absent prior study and requires known prior images expected to become available.

steps.zh: 黏膜低可疑用2a并与直接观察相关；深部低可疑用2b并影像复查；明确独立肿块、强局灶摄取或进展转3／4。
steps.en: Use primary 2a for low-suspicion mucosal findings linked to inspection and 2b for deep low-suspicion changes linked to imaging follow-up. Discrete suspicious masses, intense focal uptake or definitive progression merit 3/4.

steps.zh: 结节单独给颈部类别。比较PET与增强CT，综合既往治疗和原肿瘤特征，不使用未经原文规定的统一SUV分界。
steps.en: Assign a separate neck category. Integrate PET and contrast CT with treatment history/original tumor, without inventing a universal SUV threshold.

management.zh: 1继续常规监测；原发2a直接观察；原发2b／颈部2短期约3个月复查或PET；3考虑组织确认；4临床处理。具体策略应与头颈外科、肿瘤科讨论。
management.en: Continue routine surveillance for 1; inspect primary 2a; use short follow-up around three months or PET for primary 2b/neck 2; obtain tissue confirmation for 3; manage definitive recurrence for 4 with the clinical team.

management.zh: 活检困难或影像与临床不一致时需个体化，不能把所有2类当作复发，也不能把无摄取当作绝对排除。
management.en: Individualize inaccessible lesions or discordant clinical/imaging findings; not all category 2 findings are recurrent tumor and absent uptake is not an absolute exclusion.

cautions.zh: 治疗后炎症和重建组织可增强或摄取FDG，单独一个指标不足以判断。淋巴结坏死是否新发要与基线比较。
cautions.en: Inflammation/reconstruction can enhance or take up FDG; one metric alone is insufficient. Compare baseline to determine whether nodal necrosis is new.

cautions.zh: 本节的3个月建议属于2018版；2025 MRI分支需按其单独规则使用。
cautions.en: The three-month recommendation belongs to the 2018 framework; use the separate MRI 2025 guidance for that pathway.

name.zh: 颈部腺病影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Adenopathy Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 发表于颈部淋巴结超声分类研究的框架，按声像图表现分层恶性风险。
summary.en: A published ultrasound framework that stratifies malignancy risk in cervical lymphadenopathy by sonographic appearance.

domain.zh: 颈部淋巴结超声评估
domain.en: Ultrasound assessment of cervical lymph nodes

sources.title: Adenopathy Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 原始单中心294例研究的正常、反应性、可疑/淋巴系统疾病、转移性四组形态分类；不是加分算法。
scope.en: Four morphological groups from the original single-center 294-patient study: normal, reactive, suspicious/lymphoid disorders and metastatic; not an additive score.

sourcePages.en: PDF pages 2–4 and 6; Figure 1 and Table 3 (printed pages 40–42, 44).

purpose.zh: 测长短轴、皮质及淋巴门回声和血流；记录部位、边界、钙化及囊性/坏死。皮质回声与淋巴门比较；短/长轴比<0.5为椭圆，>0.5为圆形，原文未界定恰为0.5。
purpose.en: Measure long/short axes, cortex–hilum echotexture and flow; record site, border, calcification and cystic/necrotic change. Compare cortical echogenicity with hilum. Short/long axis ratio <0.5 is oval and >0.5 round; exactly 0.5 is unspecified.

zh: 椭圆、对称低回声皮质、可见高回声门、门型血流；颈二腹肌区可有1–2个短轴约10 mm或更小结节；其他颈区一般不突出。
en: Oval, symmetric hypoechoic cortex, echogenic hilum and hilar flow; one or two jugulodigastric nodes may have a short axis about 10 mm or less; other levels are usually inconspicuous.

zh: 增大的椭圆结节，淋巴门可见，低回声皮质与门分化保留，门型血流增多。
en: Enlarged oval node with visible hilum, preserved hypoechoic cortex–hilum differentiation and increased hilar flow.

zh: 增大，门小或不可见，皮质低回声；可伴网状结构、融合或坏死，血流类型多样。
en: Enlarged with small/absent hilum and hypoechoic cortex; possible reticulation, conglomeration or necrosis, with variable vascularity.

zh: 门不可见，皮质回声升高至与门等回声；可伴囊变/钙化，非门型或在增大结节中血流减少。
en: Absent hilum with increased cortical echogenicity becoming isoechoic to hilum; possible cystic change/calcification, nonhilar flow or reduced flow in an enlarged node.

steps.zh: 先结合颈区正常大小模式识别异常短轴，再以皮质—淋巴门结构和血流组合分组；不能仅凭长轴或圆形诊断转移。
steps.en: Identify abnormal short-axis enlargement relative to the expected regional pattern, then combine cortex–hilum appearance and vascularity; long axis or round shape alone does not diagnose metastasis.

steps.zh: 按图1结合病因是否已知、是否术后及是否持续增大选择后续路径。
steps.en: Use Figure 1 with known/unknown origin, postoperative status and persistence to select the diagnostic pathway.

management.zh: 正常无需本研究额外干预。反应性病例在研究中接受2周药物治疗，并于3–4周复查超声；改善则继续观察，稳定或增大则CNB。这是研究路径，不是对所有反应性结节的抗菌药建议。
management.en: Normal nodes required no study-specific intervention. Reactive cases received two weeks of medical treatment in the study and repeat US at 3–4 weeks; improvement led to observation, persistence/enlargement to CNB. This is the study pathway, not universal antibiotic advice.

management.zh: 可疑/淋巴系统疾病及未知原发的转移样结节采用CNB；已知原发的可疑结节或已知肿瘤术后结节采用FNA；已知原发的转移性结节进入肿瘤治疗/颈清扫评估。
management.en: Suspicious/lymphoid nodes and metastatic-appearing nodes of unknown origin underwent CNB; suspicious nodes of known origin or postoperative known cancer nodes underwent FNA; metastatic nodes of known origin proceeded to cancer treatment/neck-dissection assessment.

cautions.zh: 反应性不等于排除恶性；该队列仍有8.7%恶性。风险来自转诊样本，不能外推为普遍风险。
cautions.en: Reactive appearance does not exclude malignancy: 8.7% were malignant in this referral cohort. These rates are not universal population risks.

cautions.zh: 正文、摘要和表1的良恶性人数存在对调；本节保留形态及表3组别数据，不据此推导总体患病率。
cautions.en: Benign/malignant counts are transposed between abstract, body and Table 1; this guide uses morphological criteria and Table 3 group data without deriving an overall prevalence.

name.zh: 急腹症影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Abdominal Emergency Medicine Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于急腹症 CT 所见的结构化分级和严重程度表达。
summary.en: A published framework for structured grading and severity communication of acute-abdomen CT findings.

domain.zh: 急腹症 CT 评估

sources.title: Abdominal Emergency Medicine Reporting and Data System

title.en: AEM-RADS: severity of abdominal CT emergencies (2024)

scope.zh: 急诊成人腹部CT的1–5级及字母亚类；研究排除<18岁。区分择期、需要补充成像、急诊但不紧急手术和紧急情况。
scope.en: Categories 1–5 with letter subclasses for adult emergency abdominal CT; patients <18 years were excluded. Separates elective findings, further-imaging needs, nonurgent emergencies and urgent conditions.

sourcePages.en: PDF pages 3–5 and 7–9; Figures 1, 4 and 5.

purpose.zh: 完整评估腹部及扫描覆盖的胸部、脊柱和骨盆，记录创伤性/非创伤性、穿孔、活动出血、血管急症和不稳定骨折；检查协议和伪影。
purpose.en: Assess the abdomen and included chest, spine and pelvis for traumatic/nontraumatic disease, perforation, active bleeding, vascular urgencies and unstable fractures; check protocol adequacy and artifacts.

zh: 创伤后皮下脂肪水肿性密度增高。
en: Post-traumatic edematous increase in subcutaneous fat density.

zh: 非恶性病理，当前无急诊表现，如未破裂主动脉瘤。
en: Nonmalignant pathology without current emergency findings, such as an uncomplicated aortic aneurysm.

zh: 2C：疑似恶性，如肾上腺结节；2D：明确呈恶性表现；均为无更高级急症的择期问题。
en: 2C: suspicious malignancy, e.g. adrenal nodules; 2D: definitely malignant-appearing findings; elective issues when no higher-grade emergency exists.

zh: 需改变CT协议（如血尿协议/肠系膜CTA）或改用MRI/超声。
en: Change CT protocol, e.g. hematuria protocol/mesenteric CTA, or use MRI/US.

zh: 需追加CT且不再给予静脉对比剂，如疑似部分肠梗阻。
en: Additional CT without further IV contrast, e.g. suspected partial bowel obstruction.

zh: 非创伤性急诊病变，无第5类紧急特征：如未穿孔阑尾炎/胆囊炎、未并发梗阻、无血管并发症胰腺炎。
en: Nontraumatic emergencies without category-5 urgency: nonperforated appendicitis/cholecystitis, uncomplicated obstruction or pancreatitis without vascular complication.

zh: 创伤性急诊病变，但无不稳定骨折、活动出血、血/气腹、血/气胸或空腔脏器穿孔；如稳定骨盆/脊柱骨折、局限实质脏器伤。
en: Traumatic emergencies without unstable fracture, active bleeding, hemo/pneumoperitoneum, hemo/pneumothorax or luminal-organ perforation; e.g. stable pelvic/spinal fracture or confined solid-organ injury.

zh: 紧急：空腔脏器穿孔、血腹、气腹、覆盖胸部的血胸/气胸、血管急症、不稳定脊柱或骨盆骨折。5A非创伤性；5B创伤性。
en: Urgent: luminal-organ perforation, hemoperitoneum, pneumoperitoneum, included hemothorax/pneumothorax, vascular emergencies or unstable spinal/pelvic fractures. 5A nontraumatic; 5B traumatic.

steps.zh: 先检查成像质量及紧急特征，再确定疾病属于创伤还是非创伤；多个发现同时存在时取更高级别。
steps.en: Assess technical adequacy and urgency, then distinguish traumatic from nontraumatic disease; when findings qualify for different levels, use the higher category.

steps.zh: 肿瘤/囊肿引起肠梗阻即以4A等急诊级别为准，不能因为肿瘤外观停留在2C/2D。出现穿孔或活动出血等紧急特征则升至5。
steps.en: A tumor/cyst causing obstruction is assigned the appropriate emergency level such as 4A rather than 2C/2D; perforation, active bleeding or other urgent features raise it to 5.

management.zh: 2类择期评估；3类按亚类补足成像；4类提示急诊处理但无原文定义的紧急特征；5类提示紧急处置。原文未规定统一手术、药物或时间阈值。
management.en: Category 2 calls for elective assessment, 3 for subtype-specific imaging completion, 4 for emergency care without defined urgency features, and 5 for urgent action. The paper does not prescribe universal surgery, medication or timing thresholds.

cautions.zh: 单中心2656例主要评价观察者一致性，没有建立治疗后果或预后关联；术后气腹适用性不足。
cautions.en: The single-center 2656-patient study primarily assesses agreement rather than clinical outcomes/prognosis; postoperative pneumoperitoneum applicability is limited.

cautions.zh: 原文4类称“emergency/non-urgent”、5类称“urgent”，本节按特征解释，避免中文“急诊/紧急”词序混淆。
cautions.en: The source labels category 4 emergency/nonurgent and 5 urgent; interpret by the listed findings rather than terminology alone.

name.zh: 阑尾影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Appendix Imaging Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于急性阑尾炎超声所见的标准化报告和可能性分级。
summary.en: A published system for standardized ultrasound reporting and likelihood grading in suspected acute appendicitis.

domain.zh: 急性阑尾炎超声评估

sources.title: Appendix Imaging Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 原始全年龄急性阑尾炎疑诊队列的0–4分类；747例回顾性单中心研究。
scope.en: Categories 0–4 for suspected acute appendicitis across age groups; original retrospective single-center cohort of 747 patients.

sourcePages.zh: PDF第3–5页；图1、表1及表3（印刷页2–4）。
sourcePages.en: PDF pages 3–5; Figure 1 and Tables 1 and 3 (printed pages 2–4).

purpose.zh: 以凸阵和线阵探头从横/升结肠至盲肠和右髂区扫查，确认阑尾是否完整显示；记录加压最大横径、压缩性、壁厚及分层、局部血流与周围征象。
purpose.en: Scan from the transverse/ascending colon to the cecum and right iliac region using convex and linear probes; document complete/partial visualization, compressed maximum transverse diameter, compressibility, wall thickness/layers, flow and surrounding findings.

zh: 阑尾未显示；其阑尾直径和直接/间接征象列均列为无法评估。
en: Appendix not seen; its diameter and direct/indirect-sign columns are marked not assessable.
Not a normal or negative conclusion.

zh: 完整显示；无“加压横径>6 mm且不可压缩”组合。
en: Fully visualized; the combination of compressed diameter >6 mm and lost compressibility is absent.

zh: 部分显示；无上述直径/压缩性组合。
无直接征象；间接征象可有，但不能有气腹。
en: Partially seen; the diameter/compressibility combination is absent.
No direct signs; indirect signs may be present except pneumoperitoneum.

zh: 完整或部分显示；无上述直径/压缩性组合。
至少一项直接或间接征象，但除外阑尾周围脓肿；阑尾炎不能排除。
en: Fully or partially seen; diameter/compressibility combination absent.
At least one direct or indirect sign, excluding periappendiceal abscess; appendicitis remains inconclusive.

zh: 完整或部分显示；加压最大横径>6 mm且压缩性消失。
其他直接或间接征象可有；急性阑尾炎。
en: Fully or partially seen; compressed maximum transverse diameter >6 mm with lost compressibility.
Other direct/indirect signs may be present; acute appendicitis.

zh: 阑尾石；壁厚>3 mm、壁层消失、阑尾周围回声增加或彩色多普勒血流增加；阑尾周围脓肿。
en: Appendicolith; wall >3 mm, loss of wall stratification, increased periappendiceal echogenicity or increased color-Doppler vascularity; periappendiceal abscess.

zh: 腹腔游离液、盲肠周围脂肪高回声、肠腔外气体/气腹、局部淋巴结肿大。
en: Free abdominal fluid, hyperechoic pericecal fat, extraluminal gas/pneumoperitoneum and locoregional adenopathy.

steps.zh: 先分未见、部分见或全见，再判断加压横径>6 mm且不可压缩的组合；若该组合缺失，按征象与完整性区分1、2或3。
steps.en: First classify visibility as absent, partial or complete, then assess the >6 mm/noncompressibility combination; if absent, use accompanying signs and visibility to distinguish 1, 2 or 3.

steps.zh: 把直径、压缩性和征象逐项写入报告，不能把“未见阑尾”转换为排除阑尾炎。
steps.en: Report diameter, compressibility and each sign explicitly; a nonvisualized appendix must not be converted into exclusion of appendicitis.

management.zh: 研究中0、1、2、3、4类阑尾炎发生率依次为4.5%、0.7%、2.2%、11.5%、93.5%。原文未给出各类统一的观察时长、CT升级或手术阈值，后续需结合临床。
management.en: Observed appendicitis rates were 4.5%, 0.7%, 2.2%, 11.5% and 93.5% for categories 0–4. The source provides no universal observation duration, CT escalation rule or surgical threshold for each class; integrate clinical findings.

cautions.zh: 表1将阑尾周围脓肿排除于3类，但未单独说明没有>6 mm/不可压缩组合时脓肿如何分类；2类与3类在部分显示且有非气腹间接征象时也重叠。保留原表，不新增决定性分支。
cautions.en: Table 1 excludes periappendiceal abscess from category 3 without an explicit category for abscess lacking the >6 mm/noncompressibility combination; categories 2 and 3 also overlap for partial visualization with non-pneumoperitoneum indirect signs. These unresolved source branches are preserved rather than invented.

name.zh: 腋窝影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Axillary Imaging Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于乳腺癌腋窝淋巴结超声的转移风险分层。
summary.en: A published ultrasound score for stratifying axillary-metastasis risk in breast cancer.

domain.zh: 乳腺癌腋窝淋巴结超声评估
domain.en: Ultrasound assessment of axillary nodes in breast cancer

sources.title: Axillary Imaging Reporting and Data System

title.zh: AX-RADS：乳腺癌腋窝超声风险分数（2025）
title.en: AX-RADS: axillary US risk score in breast cancer (2025)

scope.zh: 术前腋窝超声预测淋巴结转移的回顾性模型，218例建模、140例外部机构验证；超声前新辅助治疗者及纯DCIS排除。
scope.en: Retrospective preoperative axillary US model predicting nodal metastasis: 218 development and 140 external-institution validation cases; excludes neoadjuvant treatment before US and pure DCIS.

sourcePages.en: PDF pages 2–3 and 5; Tables 1, 2 and 4, Figure 1.

purpose.zh: 测量结节长度（不是短轴）、最大皮质厚度，确认淋巴门和形状。该模型不把所有已记录变量都计分，边界、偏心和异常结节数不是表1评分项。
purpose.en: Measure node length (not short axis), cortical thickness, hilum and shape. Not every recorded variable is scored: border, eccentricity and number of abnormal nodes are not Table 1 components.

steps.zh: 分别选长度、厚度、门和形状的一个分支相加，总分0–9，再按表2风险组报告。
steps.en: Choose one alternative per length, thickness, hilum and shape component, sum to 0–9, then assign the Table 2 risk stratum.

steps.zh: 如结合MSKCC前哨淋巴结列线图，分开报告超声分数和临床病理预测，不把其变量加进AX-RADS。
steps.en: If used with the MSKCC sentinel-node nomogram, report US score and clinicopathologic prediction separately; do not add nomogram variables to AX-RADS.

management.zh: 分数用于团队沟通和腋窝风险评估；原文未规定按AX-RADS直接省略活检、前哨结节手术或实施腋清扫的处理算法。
management.en: The score informs communication and axillary risk assessment; the source does not prescribe omission of biopsy/sentinel surgery or performance of axillary dissection directly from AX-RADS.

cautions.zh: 表1中第二长度行仅写≤20 mm，与第一行≤10 mm重叠；上表以有序互斥长度段呈现解释，原表未明写>10 mm，需保留这一来源边界歧义。
cautions.en: Table 1 labels its second length row only ≤20 mm, overlapping the first ≤10 mm row. The ordered disjoint interval above is an interpretation; the source does not explicitly write >10 mm, so this boundary ambiguity is retained.

cautions.zh: 回顾性模型的低风险仍有转移，不可用84% NPV宣称排除；外部验证高风险PPV为71%，风险受病例组成影响。
cautions.en: Low risk still includes metastasis; NPV 84% does not establish exclusion. External-validation high-risk PPV was 71%, illustrating case-mix dependence.

name.zh: 骨肿瘤影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Bone Tumor Imaging Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于局灶性骨肿瘤 CT 和 MRI 所见的分层。
summary.en: A published stratification framework for focal bone-tumor findings on CT and MRI.

domain.zh: 骨肿瘤影像评估

sources.title: Bone Tumor Imaging Reporting and Data System

title.zh: BTI-RADS 2.0：机器学习骨肿瘤风险分层

scope.zh: 2025年多中心回顾性研究的局灶性骨病变分层；使用训练后的XGBoost输出，不能将影像征象直接相加。
scope.en: Focal bone-lesion stratification from the 2025 multicenter retrospective study, using a trained XGBoost output rather than an additive imaging score.

sourcePages.zh: PDF第2–4页：检查、模型与表1–2；第6–9页：验证及局限。
sourcePages.en: PDF pp 2–4: examination, model and Tables 1–2; pp 6–9: validation and limitations.

purpose.zh: 以病灶为中心评价骨质、皮质、骨膜和基质；脊柱及骨盆须用CT，不能仅以平片替代。
purpose.en: Assess lesion-centered bone destruction, cortex, periosteum and matrix; spine and pelvic lesions require CT rather than radiography alone.

purpose.zh: T1非脂抑、至少两个正交平面T2脂抑、增强T1脂抑，覆盖肿瘤及软组织；侵袭性病变另评估转移。
purpose.en: Include non-fat-suppressed T1, fat-suppressed T2 in at least two orthogonal planes, and postcontrast fat-suppressed T1; cover tumor and soft tissue and assess metastases for aggressive lesions.

title.zh: 七类分层、模型区间与原文管理建议
title.en: Seven classes, model intervals and source management

zh: 检查不完整，模型值不适用；例如未增强MRI或平片显示不清。补全检查。
en: Incomplete evaluation; no model interval applies, e.g. unenhanced MRI or poorly visualized radiographs. Complete imaging.

zh: 影像未见病灶；不需要随访。
模型分数0–15%；确定良性。验证集恶性率0%；逐例讨论是否随访。
en: Model score 0–15%; definitely benign. Test-set malignancy rate 0%; discuss follow-up individually.

zh: 模型分数>15–37%；可能良性。验证集恶性率约8%（95% CI 4–13%）；可在非专家中心影像随访。
en: Model score >15–37%; probably benign. Test-set malignancy about 8% (95% CI 4–13%); imaging follow-up outside an expert center.

zh: 模型分数>37–74%；可疑恶性。验证集恶性率45%（39–50%）；转专家中心，紧密随访或活检。
en: Model score >37–74%; suspicious for malignancy. Test-set malignancy 45% (39–50%); refer to an expert center for close follow-up or biopsy.

zh: 模型分数>74–100%；高度提示恶性。验证集恶性率92%（89–95%）；加急转专家中心，需组织诊断。
en: Model score >74–100%; highly suggestive of malignancy. Test-set malignancy 92% (89–95%); expedite expert referral and obtain tissue diagnosis.

zh: 已证实或复发恶性；模型值不适用，在专家中心管理。
en: Proven or recurrent malignancy; no model interval applies; expert-center management.

zh: 年龄、肿瘤史、部位及骨类型、大小（mm）、形状、进展及首次就诊不能评估进展的状态。
en: Age, neoplasm history, anatomic region and bone type, size in mm, shape, progression and first-visit status when progression cannot be assessed.

zh: Lodwick–Madewell分级、骨膜反应、皮质溶解、骨小梁、溶骨/硬化/混合表现、横断面位置及典型无需处理病灶。
en: Lodwick–Madewell grade, periosteal reaction, cortical lysis, trabeculation, lytic/sclerotic/mixed pattern, transverse location and a presumed do-not-touch diagnosis.

zh: 软组织侵犯、强化有无、基质；多模态方案采用27个统计筛选特征并额外区分首次就诊进展状态，SHAP说明模型贡献。
en: Soft-tissue invasion, enhancement and matrix; the multimodal model uses 27 statistically selected features with an additional first-visit progression distinction, with SHAP explaining contributions.

steps.zh: 先确定完整检查、阴性或已证实恶性分支，再对可建模病灶运行原模型并按输出分数分层。
steps.en: First identify incomplete, negative or proven-malignant branches; run the source model for eligible lesions and classify its output.

steps.zh: 模型分数区间与验证集观察恶性率是不同量；不可将15%、37%、74%解释为各类观察恶性率。
steps.en: Model-score intervals and observed test-set malignancy rates are different quantities; 15%, 37% and 74% are not observed category malignancy rates.

management.zh: 执行表中原文转诊/诊断建议时结合患者背景；此页面不提供独立治疗处方。
management.en: Apply source referral/diagnostic recommendations with clinical context; this page supplies no independent treatment prescription.

cautions.zh: 这是BTI-RADS 2.0而非2021年的1.0；影像征象不能手工换算为机器学习概率。研究未证明临床结局获益，仍需前瞻验证。
cautions.en: This is BTI-RADS 2.0 rather than the 2021 version 1.0; findings cannot be manually converted to model probabilities. Clinical outcome benefit remains unproven and prospective validation is needed.

cautions.zh: 研究排除了软组织肿瘤、治疗后病变和多灶系统性疾病，且肿瘤模拟病较少；不要泛化到所有偶发骨病变。
cautions.en: The study excluded soft-tissue tumors, treated lesions and multifocal systemic disease and included few mimickers; do not generalize to every incidental bone lesion.

name.zh: 冠状动脉钙化数据和报告系统
name.en: Coronary Artery Calcium Data and Reporting System

summary.zh: 用于 CT 冠状动脉钙化的标准化分级和报告。
summary.en: A published consensus system for standardized CT coronary-artery calcium grading and reporting.

domain.zh: 冠状动脉钙化 CT 评估

sources.title: Coronary Artery Calcium Data and Reporting System

scope.zh: 用于无增强心脏或胸部CT的冠状动脉钙化负荷与分布报告。保留2018年SCCT共识原文的Agatston和非门控目测两条路径。
scope.en: For coronary calcium burden and distribution on unenhanced cardiac or chest CT; preserves the Agatston and nongated visual pathways of the 2018 SCCT consensus.

sourcePages.en: PDF pages 7–10, 21 and 27–28; Tables 1a/1b and Figures 5/6.

purpose.zh: 面积乘病灶最大密度权重后累加；原文允许120 kV、层厚2.5–3 mm的门控或非门控扫描，并记录年龄、性别及族群相关百分位。
purpose.en: Sum calcified lesion area weighted by maximal density. The source permits gated or nongated scans at 120 kV and 2.5–3 mm thickness; record demographic percentiles.

purpose.zh: 非增强非门控CT按总钙化目测无、轻、中、重；不以目测替代门控钙化扫描的定量评分。逐支记录LM、LAD、LCx、RCA。
purpose.en: Grade overall calcium as none/mild/moderate/severe on unenhanced nongated CT; do not use visual grading for gated calcium scans. Record LM, LAD, LCx and RCA involvement.

title.zh: 分级、风险与原文预防建议
title.en: Categories, risk and source preventive recommendations

zh: Agatston 0；目测无。风险很低；通常不推荐他汀，家族性高胆固醇血症除外。
en: Agatston 0; no visual calcium. Very low risk; statin generally not recommended, except familial hypercholesterolemia.

zh: Agatston 1–99；目测轻度。风险轻度增加；中等强度他汀。
en: Agatston 1–99; mild visual burden. Mildly increased risk; moderate-intensity statin.

zh: Agatston 100–299；目测中度。风险中度增加；中到高强度他汀及阿司匹林81 mg。
en: Agatston 100–299; moderate visual burden. Moderately increased risk; moderate-to-high-intensity statin and aspirin 81 mg.

zh: 表1写Agatston >300；目测重度。风险中到重度增加；高强度他汀及阿司匹林81 mg。恰为300的边界见警示。
en: Table 1 prints Agatston >300; severe visual burden. Moderately-to-severely increased risk; high-intensity statin and aspirin 81 mg. See caution for exactly 300.

zh: A为Agatston，V为目测；N为有钙化的冠脉支数（1–4）。0级不加N。
en: A denotes Agatston and V visual assessment; N counts calcium-containing coronary vessels (1–4). Omit N for grade 0.

steps.zh: 先按所用方法分0–3级，再在非零级附上支数：A1/N3、V3/N4；支数有附加预后意义，但原文认为尚不足以直接改动风险类别。
steps.en: Assign grade 0–3 by the chosen method, then append vessel count for nonzero grades, e.g. A1/N3 or V3/N4. Vessel count adds prognostic information but is not established as a basis for changing risk category.

steps.zh: 主动脉、主动脉瓣、二尖瓣环及心包钙化另按无／轻／中／重描述，不并入CAC-DRS；另报大血管尺寸和需处理的胸部偶发发现。
steps.en: Describe aortic, aortic-valve, mitral-annular and pericardial calcium separately as none/mild/moderate/severe; exclude it from CAC-DRS. Report vessel measurements and actionable incidental thoracic findings.

management.zh: 表中药物建议是该版共识的预防框架，需结合整体ASCVD风险、禁忌与患者讨论；不是仅凭钙化分数自动开药。
management.en: Medication suggestions are the preventive framework of this source version and require overall ASCVD risk, contraindications and patient discussion; they are not automatic prescriptions.

cautions.zh: 局部接受稿将300–1000和>1000合并的文字同时写成>300，表1亦写>300，恰为300存在原文边界不一致；本节明确保留该不一致，不能据此自行补成≥300。
cautions.en: The accepted manuscript describes merging 300–1000 and >1000 but prints >300 in prose and Table 1, leaving exactly 300 inconsistent. This source ambiguity is retained rather than silently changing the boundary.

cautions.zh: 目测等级没有规定客观毫米或面积阈值。CAC仅量化钙化，不排除非钙化斑块或冠脉狭窄。
cautions.en: Visual categories have no prescribed objective millimeter or area cutoffs. CAC measures calcium and does not exclude noncalcified plaque or coronary stenosis.

name.zh: 冠状动脉疾病报告和数据系统
name.en: Coronary Artery Disease Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于冠状动脉 CT 血管成像中冠状动脉粥样硬化性疾病的标准化分级。
summary.en: A multi-society system for standardized grading of coronary atherosclerotic disease on CT angiography.

domain.zh: 冠状动脉 CT 血管成像

categoryRange: CAD-RADS 0–5; N, HRP, I, S, G, E

sources.title: Coronary Artery Disease Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 2022年CCTA患者级报告框架：同时表达最重要狭窄、整体斑块负荷及修饰符，适用于稳定或急性胸痛，需与临床共同解释。
scope.en: The 2022 patient-level CCTA framework combines the clinically most relevant stenosis, overall plaque burden and modifiers for stable or acute chest pain, interpreted with clinical data.

sourcePages.en: PDF pages 3–7, 10–20 and 22; Tables 1–7 and 10–11, Figures 12–18.

purpose.zh: 逐段评估可诊断且直径>1.5 mm的冠脉；患者级通常取最高级、临床最相关狭窄。整体斑块包括钙化及非钙化成分。
purpose.en: Assess diagnostic coronary segments >1.5 mm in diameter; assign the usually highest-grade clinically relevant patient-level stenosis. Plaque burden includes calcified and noncalcified plaque.

purpose.zh: 可用CT-FFR或负荷心肌CT灌注进一步评估功能；CT-FFR读狭窄远端1–2 cm的病灶特异值，不以全血管最低值直接决定导管室转诊。
purpose.en: CT-FFR or stress myocardial CTP can assess physiology; read lesion-specific CT-FFR 1–2 cm distal to stenosis, rather than using the lowest whole-vessel value to decide catheterization referral.

zh: 1–24%：极轻非阻塞性病变；有斑块及正性重构但无狭窄也归1。
en: 1–24% minimal nonobstructive disease; plaque with positive remodeling but no stenosis also qualifies.
70–99% severe stenosis in one or two vessels.

zh: 左主干≥50%或三支冠脉阻塞性病变（表4为各≥70%）。
en: Left-main stenosis ≥50% or three-vessel obstructive disease (Table 4 uses ≥70% in each).

zh: 至少一支100%完全闭塞；区分急性与慢性及临床意义。
en: At least one 100% occlusion; distinguish acute from chronic and explain clinical significance.

zh: 有不可评价段，其他可评价段均<50%则以N替代数值级；若其他段已有≥50%狭窄则保留数值级并附N。
en: If a segment is nondiagnostic and all evaluable segments are <50%, replace the numeric grade with N; retain the numeric grade and append N if another segment has ≥50% stenosis.

title.zh: 整体斑块负荷：方法不一致时取最严重评估
title.en: Overall plaque burden: use the highest assessment when methods disagree

en: CAC 1–100; SIS ≤2; visually mild plaque in 1–2 vessels.
CAC 101–300; SIS 3–4; moderate plaque in 1–2 vessels or mild plaque in 3 vessels.
CAC 301–999; SIS 5–7; moderate plaque in 3 vessels or severe plaque in 1 vessel.

zh: CAC >1000；SIS≥8；目测2–3支重度。原表未明确CAC=1000。
en: CAC >1000; SIS ≥8; severe plaque in 2–3 vessels. The table does not explicitly assign CAC=1000.

zh: SIS为至少有一处斑块的冠脉节段数，不依赖该段狭窄程度；CAD-RADS 0不需P0。
en: SIS counts coronary segments with any plaque regardless of stenosis; CAD-RADS 0 does not require P0.

zh: 同一斑块明确≥2项：点状钙化、低衰减<30 HU、正性重构（局部外径／近远端平均外径>1.1）、餐巾环征（接触腔面的低衰减核心及较高衰减外围环）。
en: A plaque clearly has ≥2 features: spotty calcium, attenuation <30 HU, positive remodeling (local outer diameter / mean proximal and distal outer diameter >1.1), or napkin-ring sign (lumen-contacting low-attenuation core with a higher-attenuation rim).

zh: 有匹配解剖狭窄，病灶特异CT-FFR≤0.75且血管适合PCI；或负荷CTP有可逆缺损／负荷缺损大于静息缺损的梗死周围缺血。
en: Concordant anatomic stenosis with lesion-specific CT-FFR ≤0.75 in a vessel suitable for PCI, or reversible CTP defect / stress defect exceeding a rest infarct defect.

zh: 病灶特异CT-FFR>0.80；或无灌注缺血、仅固定梗死缺损。另在正文报告梗死。
en: Lesion-specific CT-FFR >0.80, or no perfusion ischemia / only fixed infarction. Describe infarction separately.

zh: CT-FFR 0.76–0.80或CTP边界／不确定；综合病灶位置、症状及跨病灶梯度>0.12。
en: CT-FFR 0.76–0.80 or borderline/inconclusive CTP; integrate lesion location, symptoms and translesional gradient >0.12.
