zh: 至少一处支架／旁路移植物。支架内狭窄按普通冠脉分级；完全通畅移植物所绕过的原生近端狭窄不计入狭窄级；评估移植物、吻合口及远端流出道。
en: At least one stent / bypass graft. Grade in-stent stenosis normally; exclude proximal native stenosis bypassed by a fully patent graft from stenosis grading, and assess grafts, anastomoses and distal runoff.

zh: 非动脉粥样硬化性异常，如夹层、冠脉起源异常、动脉瘤、血管炎、瘘、外压或动静脉畸形；加在编码末尾并说明具体原因。
en: Nonatherosclerotic abnormality such as dissection, anomalous origin, aneurysm, vasculitis, fistula, extrinsic compression or arteriovenous malformation; append last and describe the cause.

steps.zh: 编码次序：狭窄／P／N／HRP／I／S／G／E，仅保留适用项。例如3/P2/N与N/P2/S；即使有N，只要整体负荷仍可可靠评估也可加P。
steps.en: Code in order: stenosis / P / N / HRP / I / S / G / E, retaining applicable items only, e.g. 3/P2/N or N/P2/S. Add P with N when overall burden remains reliable.

steps.zh: 负荷既评估原生冠脉也评估移植物；不能以低CAC忽略更严重的非钙化负荷。HRP需列出所见，不是任一单独征象即加HRP。
steps.en: Assess plaque burden in native arteries and grafts; low CAC must not conceal greater noncalcified burden. List the HRP findings; a single feature does not qualify.

steps.zh: 无匹配解剖病变而功能阳性时，如明确是假阳性用I−，如仍不确定用I±并解释；功能检查不可诊断也可附N。晚得到功能结果应更新报告。
steps.en: For functional positivity without matching anatomy, use I− if confidently false-positive or I± if uncertain and explain. N can also qualify a nondiagnostic functional test. Update the report when functional results arrive later.

management.zh: 稳定胸痛：0通常无需进一步冠脉检查；1–2考虑其他病因与按负荷调整预防；3考虑功能评估；4A考虑ICA或功能检查；4B推荐ICA；5考虑ICA、功能及／或存活心肌评估。持续症状、>90%狭窄、HRP或I+可更支持ICA。
management.en: Stable chest pain: usually no further coronary investigation for 0; consider other causes and burden-based prevention for 1–2; functional assessment for 3; ICA or functional testing for 4A; ICA for 4B; ICA, functional and/or viability assessment for 5. Persistent symptoms, >90% stenosis, HRP or I+ may favor ICA.

management.zh: 急性胸痛：0–1通常不需进一步ACS评估但肌钙蛋白升高需找其他原因；2如ACS临床高度疑似、肌钙蛋白阳性或HRP可住院会诊；3考虑住院、心内科及功能检查；4–5住院会诊，4B推荐ICA，疑似急性闭塞的5需加快ICA／血运重建；慢性闭塞例外。N需进一步或替代检查。
management.en: Acute chest pain: 0–1 usually require no further ACS evaluation, but elevated troponin needs other explanations; with 2, high clinical suspicion, positive troponin or HRP can justify admission/consultation; consider admission, cardiology and functional testing for 3; admit/consult for 4–5, recommend ICA for 4B and expedited ICA/revascularization for suspected acute occlusion in 5, except established chronic occlusion. N needs additional/alternative testing.

management.zh: P3/P4或HRP支持更积极的危险因素控制和预防药物；阻塞性病变还需综合抗心绞痛治疗、是否持续症状与血运重建候选资格。原文不是为每一类别规定固定药物方案。
management.en: P3/P4 or HRP favors more intensive risk-factor modification and preventive pharmacotherapy; obstructive disease also requires consideration of antianginal therapy, persistent symptoms and revascularization candidacy. The source does not assign a fixed drug regimen to every category.

cautions.zh: 表4三支≥70%与正文>70%、表2 CAC 301–999与>1000存在边界文字差异；本节按表4表达三支阈值，CAC恰1000不强行归类。
cautions.en: Table 4 uses three-vessel ≥70% while prose uses >70%; Table 2 lists CAC 301–999 and >1000. This guide uses Table 4 for three-vessel grading and leaves exactly CAC 1000 explicitly unresolved.

cautions.zh: 共识建议须合并症状、心电图、肌钙蛋白、既往史及其他检查；原文说明尚缺乏充分前瞻随机证据支持所有CCTA后管理路径。
cautions.en: Integrate symptoms, ECG, troponin, history and other tests. The consensus acknowledges insufficient prospective randomized evidence for all post-CCTA management pathways.

name.zh: 颈部淋巴结影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Cervical Lymph Node Imaging Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 颈部淋巴结超声的探索性标准化分级框架。
summary.en: A pilot standardized classification framework for cervical-lymphadenopathy ultrasound.

domain.zh: 颈部淋巴结超声评估

sources.title: Cervical Lymph Node Imaging Reporting and Data System

title.zh: CLN-RADS：颈部淋巴结超声与弹性成像（2016）

scope.zh: 291例颈部淋巴结回顾性研究，根据六项可疑征象个数分为1–5类；原文另有回归概率模型，但分类是计数法。
scope.en: Retrospective study of 291 cervical nodes; categories 1–5 use the count of six suspicious features. A separate logistic probability model is described, but the categories use feature counts.

sourcePages.zh: PDF第3–6页；图2、3，方法、结果与局限（印刷页1288–1291）。
sourcePages.en: PDF pages 3–6; Figures 2–3, methods, results and limitations (printed pages 1288–1291).

purpose.zh: 在纵切面测短/长轴比；与邻近肌肉比较回声；评估连接结外脂肪的中心高回声门、钙化及血流分布。周边血流为包膜/周边流，混合血流同时有门和周边流。
purpose.en: Measure short/long-axis ratio in the longitudinal plane; compare echogenicity with adjacent muscle; assess central echogenic hilum continuous with perinodal fat, calcification and flow. Peripheral flow is capsular/peripheral; mixed flow includes hilar and peripheral components.

purpose.zh: 轻度反复加压，稳定图像下取包含结节及邻近软组织ROI，避免骨等硬组织。蓝色代表硬区，按硬区占病灶比例评估；肌肉/结节应变比是单独测量。
purpose.en: Apply light repetitive compression; select a stable ROI containing node and surrounding soft tissue while avoiding bone. Blue represents stiffness and is graded by its lesion fraction; muscle-to-node strain ratio is a separate measurement.

zh: 点状高回声，可有或无后方声影
en: Punctate echogenic foci with or without shadowing

steps.zh: 逐项计数六个独立征象（每项最多1），不要再给边缘、坏死、融合或应变比追加分数。
steps.en: Count the six independent features, at most one per feature; do not add separate points for margin, necrosis, matting or strain ratio.

steps.zh: 原文回归式：z=−3.3969+1.0058×圆形+1.1707×高回声+1.2122×无门+2.0356×钙化+1.7322×周边/混合血流+0.7506×恶性弹性评估；p=1/(1+exp(−z))。这是另一个概率输出，不替代分类个数规则。
steps.en: The source regression is z=−3.3969+1.0058×round+1.1707×hyperechoic+1.2122×absent hilum+2.0356×calcification+1.7322×peripheral/mixed flow+0.7506×malignant RTE, with p=1/(1+exp(−z)). This is a separate probability output, not a replacement for count-based categories.

management.zh: 报告可疑程度以辅助进一步取样决策；原文未建立按类别的FNA/CNB时间或治疗方案。
management.en: Report suspicion to support further sampling decisions; the source does not establish category-specific FNA/CNB timing or treatment protocols.

cautions.zh: 研究中应变比>2.41与恶性相关，但不是第七个计分征象；不应把应变比和弹性等级重复计数。
cautions.en: Strain ratio >2.41 was associated with malignancy but is not a seventh counted feature; do not double-count ratio and elasticity grade.

cautions.zh: 各征象等权计数不代表相同预测强度；研究为回顾性并需进一步前瞻性验证。比值恰为0.5的形状归属没有单独界定。
cautions.en: Equal counting does not imply equal predictive strength; the retrospective framework needs prospective validation. Shape at a ratio of exactly 0.5 is not separately specified.

name.zh: 新冠肺炎胸部 X 线报告和数据系统
name.en: COVID-19 Chest X-ray Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于 COVID-19 相关胸部 X 线改变的临床影像严重程度分级建议。
summary.en: A published proposal for clinico-radiological severity grading of COVID-19 chest-radiograph changes.

domain.zh: COVID-19 肺炎胸部 X 线评估

sources.title: COVID-19 Chest X-ray Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 在PCR确诊、成人有症状COVID-19患者中提出的胸片肺受累严重度系统：0–10影像级对应0–IV严重度，并非CT感染可能性分级。
scope.en: A proposed chest-radiograph lung involvement severity scheme in symptomatic adults with PCR-confirmed COVID-19: image scores 0–10 map to severity 0–IV.

sourcePages.en: PDF pages 3–5 and 11–13; Tables 1–3 and 6–7.

purpose.zh: 观察肺血管／肺门、细线影、微结节样影、GGO样肺泡影、实变、累及肺叶数、条索、积液和其他异常。肺泡朦胧影应比无重叠肋骨浅，且不浓于血管影；实变比邻近无重叠肋骨浓，可有或无空气支气管征。
purpose.en: Assess vascular/hilar markings, fine lines, microbeading, GGO-like alveolar veiling, consolidation, involved lobes, bands, effusion and other abnormalities. Alveolar veiling is less dense than unobscured ribs and no denser than vascular shadows; consolidation is denser than adjacent unobscured ribs, with or without air bronchograms.

title.zh: 逐级影像模式（数字是级别而非加分项）
title.en: Ordered radiographic patterns (levels, not additive points)

zh: 肺血管和肺门正常，肺野清晰，胸膜反折清晰。
en: Normal vascular and hilar shadows, clear lung fields and pleural reflections.

zh: 中央线状影突出，主要为血管影。
en: Prominent central linear markings, predominantly vascular.

zh: 1级背景＋肺门影增浓＋细线状间质影增多。
en: Level 1 background plus accentuated hila and increased fine interstitial lines.

zh: 2级＋细小软组织微结节／串珠样影，可为血管或支气管周围浸润、微血管端面影，以基底及周边较明显。
en: Level 2 plus fine microbeaded soft-tissue shadows, possibly perivascular/peribronchial infiltrates and end-on tiny vessels, more evident basally and peripherally.

zh: 3级＋周边较粗短线影（Kerley线），可有细蜂窝样影、肺门或血管模糊。
en: Level 3 plus short thicker peripheral septal/Kerley lines, with or without fine honeycomb appearance and hilar/vascular haze.

zh: 3级＋1–2个肺叶内周边一处或少数模糊低通气肺泡影／GGO样影。
en: Level 3 plus one/few ill-defined peripheral alveolar/GGO-like opacities in 1–2 lobes.

zh: 3级＋>2个肺叶内多处大小不一模糊周边肺泡影。
en: Level 3 plus multiple variable-sized ill-defined peripheral alveolar opacities in >2 lobes.

zh: 6级＋1个肺叶内一处或少数小片较致密实变。
en: Level 6 plus one/few small denser consolidations in one lobe.

zh: 6级＋2个肺叶内少数或多处大小不一、融合或分散实变。
en: Level 6 plus few/multiple variable confluent or discrete consolidations in two lobes.

zh: 6级＋>2个肺叶内多处大小不一、融合或分散实变。
en: Level 6 plus multiple variable confluent or discrete consolidations in >2 lobes.

zh: 8或9级＋较粗周边线影（不张／纤维条索和／或间隔线），或胸腔积液，或肺门增大。
en: Level 8 or 9 plus thicker peripheral atelectatic/fibrotic bands and/or septal lines, or pleural effusion, or enlarged hila.

steps.zh: 依据最符合的整组影像模式赋0–10级，再映射0–IV；条索原文以>3 mm为粗、<3 mm为细，恰3 mm未定义。
steps.en: Assign the best matching combined pattern from 0–10, then map to 0–IV. The source defines thick strands as >3 mm and thin strands as <3 mm; exactly 3 mm is unspecified.

steps.zh: 随访比较级别、实变密度／范围及并发症；原研究仅对恶化或临床状态停滞的70例进行随访。
steps.en: Compare level, consolidation density/extent and complications on follow-up. The study followed only 70 patients with deteriorating or stationary clinical conditions.

management.zh: 作者将分级用于初诊分流及住院监测；表6是与症状、吸氧及辅助通气的观察性对应，未制定按级别启动药物或通气的强制协议。
management.en: The authors propose triage and inpatient monitoring. Table 6 describes observed symptom, oxygen and ventilation correlations, rather than a mandatory score-triggered drug or ventilation protocol.

cautions.zh: 这是500例研究提出的系统，作者要求其他中心验证；0分胸片可见于PCR阳性患者，不能用于排除感染。
cautions.en: This proposal arose from a 500-patient study and the authors call for external testing; a normal radiograph can occur with positive PCR and cannot exclude infection.

name.zh: 新冠肺炎 CT 报告和数据系统
name.en: COVID-19 Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 荷兰放射学会标准化报告工作组提出的 COVID-19 疑似患者 CT 可能性分级。
summary.en: A Dutch Radiological Society working-group CT likelihood scheme for patients suspected of COVID-19.

organization: COVID-19 Standardized Reporting Working Group of the Dutch Radiological Society

domain.zh: COVID-19 肺炎 CT 评估

sources.title: COVID-19 Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 2020年荷兰放射学会用于中重度症状疑似COVID-19患者的非增强胸部CT肺受累可能性分类；并非病变范围或严重度分数。
scope.en: The 2020 Dutch Radiological Society scheme grades pulmonary COVID-19 suspicion on unenhanced chest CT in patients with moderate/severe symptoms; it does not grade extent or severity.

sourcePages.en: PDF pages 2–4 and 6–7 (E98–E100 and E102–E103); Tables 1–2.

purpose.zh: 非增强CT评估GGO、实变、分布、感染替代模式及既往肺病；临床诊断另结合症状持续时间、实验室和RT-PCR。
purpose.en: Assess GGO, consolidation, distribution, alternative infectious patterns and pre-existing lung disease on unenhanced CT; diagnosis additionally uses symptom duration, laboratory data and RT-PCR.

zh: 图像缺失／质量不足（如严重咳嗽或呼吸伪影），无法分1–5。
en: Incomplete/insufficient-quality scan, e.g. severe cough or respiratory artifact, prevents assignment of 1–5.

zh: 正常或明确非感染性：肺气肿、叶间裂旁结节、肿瘤、纤维化；典型间质性肺水肿也可归1。
en: Normal or unequivocally noninfectious, including emphysema, perifissural nodules, tumors, fibrosis or typical interstitial edema.

zh: 典型其他感染：支气管炎／细支气管炎、支气管肺炎、叶性肺炎、脓肿；树芽、中心小叶结节、叶／段实变、空洞。
en: Typical alternative infection: bronchitis/bronchiolitis, bronchopneumonia, lobar pneumonia or abscess; tree-in-bud, centrilobular nodules, lobar/segmental consolidation or cavitation.

zh: 可为COVID-19也可为其他病：肺门周围GGO、广泛均匀GGO伴或不伴部分次级肺小叶保留、GGO＋平滑间隔增厚伴或不伴积液；无其他典型征象的小片非中心小叶、非胸膜旁GGO，或可能为机化性肺炎的非典型实变。
en: Overlap with other diseases: perihilar GGO, extensive homogeneous GGO with/without spared lobules, GGO plus smooth septal thickening with/without effusion; small noncentrilobular and nonpleural GGO, or atypical consolidation potentially representing organizing pneumonia.

zh: 类似5但分布不典型：不接触脏层胸膜，或严格单侧／主要沿支气管血管，或叠加于严重弥漫性既有肺异常。
en: Resembles 5 but lacks typical distribution: not in contact with visceral pleura, strictly unilateral/predominantly peribronchovascular, or superimposed on severe diffuse pre-existing abnormalities.

zh: 必须同时有胸膜／叶间裂附近GGO（可伴实变，允许胸膜下保留）和双侧多灶分布，并至少有一项符合时间演变的确认模式，见下表。无需下叶优势。
en: Requires GGO with/without consolidation near visceral pleura/fissures (subpleural sparing allowed), multifocal bilateral distribution, and ≥1 temporally appropriate confirmatory pattern below. Lower-lobe predominance is not required.

zh: 检查时SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR阳性；表示病原证据，不是影像第6级严重度。
en: Positive SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR at examination; denotes virologic proof rather than a sixth imaging-severity level.

zh: 界限不清的圆形／半圆形；或锐利界限勾勒多个相邻次级肺小叶。
en: Unsharp rounded/half-rounded regions, or sharply delineated regions outlining adjacent secondary lobules.

zh: 小叶内线形成铺路石；可有机化性肺炎模式，如反晕、胸膜旁带状／弧形影和通向胸膜的小连接。
en: Intralobular lines producing crazy paving, or organizing-pneumonia patterns such as reverse halo and pleural bands/arching opacities tethered to pleura.

zh: 病灶内血管增粗可见于所有上述模式，作为支持表现记录。
en: Vessels within abnormalities may be thickened across these patterns; record as supportive evidence.

steps.zh: 先排图像不足及已知RT-PCR证实，再根据肺征象分1–5；肺水肿＋可疑GGO时可为3，不能只因平滑间隔或积液就固定归2。
steps.en: Check technical insufficiency and known RT-PCR proof, then grade lung findings 1–5. Edema with mimicking GGO can be 3; smooth septa/effusion do not automatically mean 2.

management.zh: 原文定位为沟通及研究的诊断可能性框架，没有按类别规定药物、住院或固定复查间隔；感染结论须合并RT-PCR及临床，必要时重复病原检查。
management.en: The source is a communication/research suspicion framework without category-specific drug, admission or fixed follow-up schedules; integrate RT-PCR and clinical data, with repeated virologic testing when needed.

cautions.zh: 初始验证为105例住院疑似患者及8名阅片者；不将结果泛化为无症状筛查。早期病程CT可阴性，1类也不能完全排除COVID-19。
cautions.en: Initial validation involved 105 hospitalized suspected patients and eight readers; it is not validation for asymptomatic screening. Early CT may be negative and category 1 cannot fully exclude COVID-19.

name.zh: 新冠肺炎影像报告和数据系统
name.en: COVID-19 Imaging Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 基于文献影像资料提出的 COVID-19 CT 报告分类和常用术语建议。
summary.en: A published CT reporting classification and common lexicon proposal for COVID-19 imaging.

domain.zh: COVID-19 肺炎 CT 评估

sources.title: COVID-19 Imaging Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 2020年胸部CT征象词汇与COVID-19影像可能性提议；0、1、2A、2B、3与CO-RADS类别不互换。
scope.en: A 2020 proposal for chest CT terminology and imaging suspicion of COVID-19; categories 0, 1, 2A, 2B and 3 are not interchangeable with CO-RADS.

sourcePages.en: PDF pages 2–4 and 11 (4931–4933 and 4940); Tables 2–3 and Figure 1.

purpose.zh: 记录单双侧、前后、中心／周边、灶数及肺叶；周边定义为肺野最外1/3，前后以腋中线分；GGO保留血管轮廓，实变遮蔽血管。
purpose.en: Record laterality, anterior/posterior, central/peripheral distribution, multiplicity and lobes. Peripheral means outermost lung third; the midaxillary line divides anterior/posterior. GGO preserves vessels while consolidation obscures them.

zh: 胸部CT正常；不能据此排除感染。
en: Normal chest CT; infection is not excluded.

zh: 积液、空洞、肺结节／结节模式、淋巴结肿大、支气管血管周围分布、晕征、树芽、支扩、气道分泌物、肺气肿、纤维化、孤立胸膜增厚、气胸、心包积液。
en: Pleural effusion, cavity, nodules/nodular pattern, lymphadenopathy, peribronchovascular distribution, halo, tree-in-bud, bronchiectasis, airway secretions, emphysema, fibrosis, isolated pleural thickening, pneumothorax or pericardial effusion.

zh: 单灶GGO（早期）、无GGO实变（晚期／复杂）、邻近GGO或实变的局灶胸膜增厚、血管扩张／壁增厚、空气支气管征、支气管壁增厚、白肺（晚期／复杂）、肺实质纤维条带（晚期／吸收）。
en: Single GGO (early), consolidation without GGO (late/complicated), focal pleural thickening adjacent to GGO/consolidation, vascular luminal dilation/wall thickening, air bronchogram, bronchial wall thickening, white lung (late/complicated), or parenchymal fibrotic bands (late/remission).

zh: 非典型征象与典型／较典型征象同时存在。
en: Atypical findings coexist with typical or fairly typical findings.

zh: 多灶GGO、GGO伴叠加实变、实变优势模式（晚期／复杂）、线状影（晚期／复杂）、铺路石（晚期／复杂）、融糖征（实变逐渐转为GGO，晚期／吸收）。双侧、周边分布一般增加疑似程度。
en: Multifocal GGO, GGO with superimposed consolidation, consolidation-predominant pattern (late/complicated), linear opacity (late/complicated), crazy paving (late/complicated), or melted-sugar sign (consolidation gradually fading into GGO, late/remission). Bilateral peripheral involvement generally increases suspicion.

steps.zh: 按图1先识别正常，再判断非典型、较典型与典型组合；同时有非典型与典型／较典型时归2B，不忽略伴随非典型征象而自动归3。
steps.en: Use Figure 1 to identify normal studies and combinations of atypical, fairly typical and typical findings; mixed atypical plus typical/fairly typical findings belong to 2B rather than automatically 3.

steps.zh: 孤立胸膜增厚指无邻近GGO／实变；晕征在词汇表指结节周围GGO，不能与融糖征混淆。
steps.en: Isolated pleural thickening has no adjacent GGO/consolidation. Halo denotes GGO around a nodule and must not be confused with melted-sugar appearance.

management.zh: 原文强调RT-PCR是确认试验，CT为补充；未规定类别特异药物或固定复查间隔。临床高度可疑而阴性时需结合检测时点、采样质量和重复检测。
management.en: RT-PCR is the confirmatory test and CT complementary. No category-specific medication or fixed follow-up interval is prescribed; high clinical suspicion with negative testing requires consideration of timing, sampling quality and repeat testing.

cautions.zh: 这是原文提议及综述框架，缺乏该文独立前瞻验证；肺部表现与其他病因重叠。不要把原文疫情时期讨论直接当作现在的筛查政策。
cautions.en: This is a proposed review-based framework without independent prospective validation in the article; lung appearances overlap other diseases. Pandemic-era discussion is not a current screening policy.

name.zh: 欧洲甲状腺影像报告和数据系统
name.en: European Thyroid Imaging Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 欧洲甲状腺协会发布的成人甲状腺结节超声恶性风险分层指南。
summary.en: European Thyroid Association guidance for ultrasound malignancy-risk stratification of adult thyroid nodules.

domain.zh: 甲状腺结节超声风险分层
domain.en: Ultrasound risk stratification of thyroid nodules

sources.title: European Thyroid Imaging Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 2017 ETA成人甲状腺结节超声风险及FNA选择框架；按模式分组，不是加分法。此节保留2017版本阈值。
scope.en: 2017 ETA adult thyroid-nodule US risk and FNA-selection framework; pattern-based rather than additive. This guide retains 2017 thresholds.

sourcePages.en: PDF pages 3–10; Table 1, Figures 2–12 and R2–R11; lexicon on pages 10–11.

purpose.zh: 记录三个径线、部位、结构、形状、边缘、回声及钙化；回声以正常甲状腺和带状肌作比较。所有患者查颈部淋巴结，中/高风险必须查；疑似甲状腺来源的异常门/囊变/钙化等结节需独立取样评估。
purpose.en: Record three dimensions, location, composition, shape, margin, echogenicity and calcification; compare with normal thyroid and strap muscles. Survey cervical nodes in all patients, mandatorily for intermediate/high-risk nodules; suspicious nodes of thyroid origin require separate sampling evaluation.

zh: 纯无回声囊肿，无壁厚或实性成分；或全结节海绵样（微囊遍布整个结节）。
近0%；不做诊断FNA，可因压迫症状治疗性处理。
en: Pure anechoic cyst without thick wall/solid component, or entirely spongiform nodule with microcysts throughout.
Near 0%; no diagnostic FNA, with therapeutic intervention possible for compression.

zh: 椭圆、光滑、等或高回声，无高危征象。
en: Oval, smooth, iso/hyperechoic, without high-risk features.

zh: 椭圆、光滑、轻度低回声，无高危征象；实性部分任何低回声组织即按中风险。
en: Oval, smooth, mildly hypoechoic without high-risk features; any hypoechoic tissue in the solid component places a heterogeneous nodule here.

zh: 至少一项：非椭圆形、边缘不规则、微钙化、显著低回声。显著低回声低于带状肌，对实性且非愈合囊肿瘢痕最具特异性。
en: At least one of nonoval shape, irregular margins, microcalcification or marked hypoechogenicity. Marked hypoechogenicity is below strap muscle and most specific in solid nodules rather than healed-cyst scars.

title.zh: 需区分的亮点和附加征象

zh: 实性部分多个约1 mm圆形亮点，无后方声影；不同于胶质彗尾或微囊后壁增强。
en: Multiple round echogenic foci about 1 mm in the solid component, without posterior shadowing; distinguish colloid comet tails and microcyst back-wall enhancement.

zh: >1 mm伴后方声影，单独不特异；中断环形钙化可能增加风险。
en: >1 mm with shadowing; not specific alone, although disrupted rim calcification may increase risk.

zh: 描述包膜隆起、接触或中断，邻近结构突出/侵犯；>2 mm正常甲状腺间隔并连续包膜降低侵犯可能。
en: Describe capsular bulging, abutment or disruption and protrusion/invasion of neighboring structures; >2 mm normal thyroid with continuous capsule reduces extension risk.

zh: 多普勒不纳入评分；可区分厚胶质与实性；弹性尚不足以纳入主要分层。
en: Doppler is not a scoring component but may distinguish thick colloid from solid tissue; elastography is not established as a core category input.

steps.zh: 先找高危征象，任何一项使其进入5；无高危征象再按纯囊/全海绵、等高回声或轻低回声分别选2、3、4。
steps.en: First seek high-risk features: any one assigns 5. With none, distinguish pure cyst/entire spongiform (2), iso/hyperechoic (3) or mildly hypoechoic (4).

steps.zh: 多发结节先描述所有高风险且>10 mm者FNA，再中风险>5 mm描述、>15 mm FNA，再低风险>10 mm描述、>20 mm FNA；很多结节时至少详细描述风险/大小最重要的3个。
steps.en: In multinodular disease describe all high-risk nodules and FNA those >10 mm, then describe intermediate-risk nodules >5 mm and FNA >15 mm, then describe low-risk nodules >10 mm and FNA >20 mm. Describe at least the three most important nodules by risk/size when numerous.

management.zh: <10 mm高风险且无异常淋巴结者可知情选择主动监测或FNA；监测中生长或出现可疑结节则FNA。>10 mm高风险FNA可因无法手术或其他病低预期寿命而调整；首次良性细胞学建议3个月内重复FNA。
management.en: High-risk nodules <10 mm without abnormal nodes may choose surveillance or FNA with informed agreement; growth or suspicious nodes during surveillance prompts FNA. For >10 mm high-risk nodules, inoperability/limited life expectancy may modify FNA; repeat a first benign cytology within three months.

management.zh: 可疑甲状腺来源淋巴结做FNA及适当甲状腺球蛋白/降钙素洗脱液分析，并取最可疑甲状腺结节。温/热结节若显像证实通常不FNA。
management.en: Sample suspicious thyroid-origin nodes with FNA and appropriate thyroglobulin/calcitonin washout and sample the most suspicious thyroid nodule. Scintigraphically warm/hot nodules generally do not undergo FNA.

cautions.zh: FNA阈值是>10、>15、>20 mm，不能换成≥。2017图12与正文未单独说明恰为10 mm的高风险结节路径；结合临床而不虚构界值。
cautions.en: FNA thresholds are >10, >15 and >20 mm, not ≥. Figure 12 and the text do not separately specify the high-risk branch at exactly 10 mm; retain clinical judgment rather than inventing a boundary.

cautions.zh: 部分海绵样或纯囊是否含实性无法确定时不能直接当作2；本文说存疑实性成分归低风险。结节生长本身不宜用于预测恶性。
cautions.en: Incomplete spongiform appearance or an uncertain solid component cannot automatically be called 2; the source places uncertain solid content in the low-risk category. Growth alone is not recommended for predicting malignancy.

name.zh: 成纤维细胞活化蛋白靶向影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Fibroblast Activation Protein Targeted Imaging Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于 FAP 靶向 PET 影像的结构化报告和病变可能性表达。
summary.en: A published structured-reporting framework for fibroblast-activation-protein-targeted PET imaging.

domain.zh: FAP 靶向 PET 肿瘤影像

sources.title: Fibroblast Activation Protein Targeted Imaging Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 2025年PET或SPECT、CT或MRI结合的FAP靶向影像结构化提案；按所疑癌种的分布评价，属于需验证框架。
scope.en: A 2025 structured proposal for FAP-targeted PET or SPECT combined with CT/MRI; interpretation is relative to the suspected cancer distribution and requires validation.

sourcePages.zh: PDF第3–6页：定义和类别；第4页表1及血池强摄取脚注；第5页图3不确定分支。
sourcePages.en: PDF pp 3–6: definitions and categories; p 4 Table 1 and blood-pool intensity footnote; p 5 Fig 3 indeterminate branches.

purpose.zh: 结合形态、所疑恶性类型、炎症/创伤/手术/放疗史，报告各灶与整体FAP-RADS。
purpose.en: Combine anatomy, suspected malignancy and inflammation/trauma/surgery/radiotherapy history; report lesion and overall FAP-RADS.

purpose.zh: 原文强摄取定义为降主动脉血池SUVmax的3倍；摄取强度不能单独分良恶性。
purpose.en: The source defines intense uptake as three times descending-aortic blood-pool SUVmax; intensity alone cannot separate benign and malignant lesions.

zh: 典型良性、生理/已知良性解剖或功能/组织特征；不论摄取程度，典型良性现象仍为1。
en: Typical physiologic/benign anatomy, function or histology; a characteristic benign phenomenon remains 1 regardless of uptake intensity.

zh: 高度可能良性：从轻度至强摄取，形态和病史符合退变、炎症、创伤或术后，无可疑恶性对应；未必有特异影像或良性组织证实。
en: Highly likely benign: slight-to-intense uptake with anatomy/history supporting degeneration, inflammation, trauma or intervention and no suspicious malignant correlate; definitive benign imaging/histology need not exist.

zh: 典型疑癌部位摄取不确定、无形态对应；建议影像随访。
en: Equivocal uptake in a typical site for the suspected malignancy without anatomic correlate; imaging follow-up recommended.

zh: 典型疑癌部位摄取不确定且有特异/非特异形态对应，或形态高度可疑却无明显摄取；随访或活检。
en: Equivocal uptake in a typical cancer site with specific/nonspecific anatomy, or highly suspicious anatomy without substantial uptake; follow-up or biopsy.

zh: 典型疑癌部位强摄取但无特异形态对应/无对应；高度可能恶性，若影响决策考虑活检。
en: Intense uptake in a typical cancer site without a specific correlate or with no correlate; malignancy highly likely; consider biopsy if it changes management.

zh: 典型疑癌部位强摄取且常规影像相符；与恶性一致，原文建议活检或按具体病情启动治疗。
en: Intense uptake in a typical cancer site with matching conventional anatomy; consistent with malignancy; the source discusses biopsy or disease-specific treatment.

zh: 整体取各靶灶最高FAP-RADS；不是平均或累加。
en: Overall score is the highest target-lesion category, not an average or sum.

steps.zh: 先评估典型生理/良性现象与病史，再将可疑灶按摄取、典型分布、形态对应分类。
steps.en: Assess characteristic physiologic/benign findings and history before classifying suspicious lesions by uptake, typical distribution and anatomy.

steps.zh: 随访更支持癌可升4/5；排除癌可降1/2。广泛转移背景下可酌情将3升4/5，即使严格形态/摄取前提未全满足。
steps.en: Follow-up supporting malignancy may upgrade to 4/5; exclusion may downgrade to 1/2. Extensive metastatic context may justify upgrading 3 to 4/5 despite incomplete strict imaging prerequisites.

steps.zh: 最终报告最多逐一列出5个关键病灶的FAP-RADS分类，并说明整体最高类别和未解决的临床相关不确定性。
steps.en: In the final report individually categorize no more than five key lesions, and state the highest overall category and unresolved clinically relevant uncertainty.

management.zh: 是否活检取决于结果是否改变治疗；本页仅转述原文决策方向，不给药物或治疗处方。
management.en: Biopsy depends on whether the result changes care; this page paraphrases source decision directions without drug/treatment prescriptions.

management.zh: 原文明确不制定强制FAPI复查频率或时间，不能从3A/3B擅自推导3个月等固定间隔。
management.en: The source explicitly avoids strong recommendations on FAPI scan frequency/timing; do not invent a fixed interval such as 3 months for 3A/3B.

cautions.zh: 纤维化、炎症、术后异物及放疗多年后仍可摄取；SUVmax在良恶性间重叠，不能移植文中个别研究的4.7/5.5阈值。
cautions.en: Fibrosis, inflammation, surgical foreign bodies and remote radiotherapy can remain avid; benign/malignant SUVmax overlap prevents using individual-study cutoffs 4.7/5.5 as category rules.

cautions.zh: 关于监管批准的陈述仅代表原文发表时点；此处不更新或推断2026年监管现状。
cautions.en: Any approval discussion is historical to the publication; this guide does not update or infer 2026 regulatory status.

name.zh: 胆囊影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Gallbladder Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 国际专家共识提出的胆囊壁增厚超声风险分层框架。
summary.en: An international expert-consensus framework for ultrasound risk stratification of gallbladder-wall thickening.

domain.zh: 胆囊壁增厚超声评估

sources.title: Gallbladder Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 多学科共识的超声胆囊壁恶性风险分类；使用前排除急性胆囊炎、系统性疾病、肝炎/慢性肝病及其他胆囊外原因，适用于有或无结石的胆囊。
scope.en: Multidisciplinary consensus US classification of malignancy risk in wall thickening; first exclude acute cholecystitis, systemic disease, hepatitis/chronic liver disease and other extracholecystic causes; applies with or without stones.

sourcePages.en: PDF pages 3–8 and 10; Tables 1–3, Figures 1–2 and 6 (printed pages 556–561, 563).

purpose.zh: 确认胆囊充分充盈及整个壁可见；壁厚从黏膜内侧至外层结缔组织外侧，以mm记，在局灶增厚处测最厚点。记录结石/胆泥、局灶或全周、对称性、分层、壁内囊/亮点、与肝界面及壁外延伸。
purpose.en: Confirm adequate distension and complete wall visualization; measure inner mucosa to outer connective-tissue layer in mm, using the thickest focal area. Document stones/sludge, focal/circumferential extent, symmetry, layering, intramural cysts/foci, liver interface and extramural extension.

zh: 对称：各壁厚度一致；不对称：某部分比其余更厚。局灶限于部分壁，全周/弥漫涉及整个壁。
en: Symmetric means uniform wall thickness; asymmetric means one part is thicker. Focal involves part of the wall and circumferential/diffuse the whole wall.

zh: 可见内和外壁层；若丢失则无分层。
en: Inner and outer wall layers are visible; absent when these cannot be distinguished.

zh: 壁内亮点可有/无彗尾；壁内囊为壁中的无回声空间，与腔内肿块/结石不同。
en: Wall echogenic foci with/without comet tail and intramural cysts as anechoic wall spaces; distinct from intraluminal mass/stones.

zh: 清晰是胆囊壁至肝的锐利过渡；不清是过渡无法明确识别。
en: Distinct means a sharp wall-to-liver transition; indistinct means the transition cannot be clearly seen.

zh: 技术、患者或胆囊因素导致不全：肥胖、结石填满形成壁-回声-声影复合征、瓷化胆囊、腔内气体、收缩等。
风险不定；部分病例复查US，多学科讨论多期增强CT/MRI。
en: Incomplete evaluation from technical/patient/gallbladder factors: obesity, stone-filled wall-echo-shadow complex, porcelain gallbladder, luminal gas or contraction.
Risk undefined; repeat US in selected cases or discuss multiphasic contrast CT/MRI.

zh: 正常；无需额外成像或随访。
对称全周增厚，可有或无壁内改变；或局灶增厚且有壁内改变；分层保留、肝界面清楚。
en: Symmetric circumferential thickening with/without intramural findings, or focal thickening with intramural findings; layered appearance and preserved liver interface.

zh: 全周增厚无分层；或局灶增厚无壁内囊/亮点或无分层；肝界面仍清楚。
2–50%；多学科讨论后考虑多期增强CT/MRI。
en: Circumferential thickening without layering, or focal thickening without intramural cysts/foci or without layering; liver interface remains distinct.
2–50%; consider multiphasic contrast CT/MRI after multidisciplinary discussion.

zh: 全周或局灶增厚，无分层且肝界面消失。
en: Circumferential/focal thickening without layering and with loss of liver interface.

zh: 4类表现加明确壁外侵犯：壁增厚直接延伸累及胆道/血管，或连续的肝肿块。
en: Category-4 features plus definite extramural invasion: direct biliary/vascular involvement by mural extension or contiguous liver mass.

steps.zh: 先排除不在适用范围的急性/系统性/肝脏原因，再核查充盈及完整可见性；不全归0并说明具体原因。
steps.en: Exclude acute/systemic/hepatic causes outside scope, then check distension/completeness; assign 0 and specify the limiting reason if incomplete.

steps.zh: 可评估时按分层、壁内改变、肝界面及壁外侵犯组合判断1–5，不根据结石存在或壁厚数值单独推断恶性。
steps.en: When evaluable, combine layering, intramural features, liver interface and extramural invasion to assign 1–5; neither stones nor thickness alone determines malignant category.

management.zh: 非充分空腹导致的收缩胆囊可充分空腹后复查；3–5类的CT/MRI是进一步鉴别/范围评估，原文并未规定各类自动活检或手术。
management.en: If contraction follows inadequate fasting, repeat after proper fasting. CT/MRI for 3–5 further characterizes disease/extent; the source does not mandate automatic biopsy or surgery by category.

cautions.zh: 概率是共识估计而非该文前瞻性校准数据，需多中心验证。早期癌可保留肝界面而落入2/3；胆囊炎及黄肉芽肿性炎症可模拟高类别。
cautions.en: Probabilities are consensus estimates, not prospectively calibrated in this paper, and need multicenter validation. Early cancer may retain the liver interface and resemble 2/3; cholecystitis/xanthogranulomatous inflammation may mimic higher categories.

cautions.zh: 正文称正常壁<3 mm，但表2的1类明确≤3 mm；此处保留表2分级边界。多普勒和CEUS没有纳入GB-RADS评分。
cautions.en: The text describes a normal wall as <3 mm but Table 2 explicitly defines category 1 as ≤3 mm; retain the table boundary. Doppler and CEUS are not GB-RADS scoring components.

name.zh: 妇科影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Gynecologic Imaging Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于附件肿块超声所见的分类建议。
summary.en: A published proposal for classifying adnexal masses from ultrasound findings.

domain.zh: 附件肿块超声评估

sources.title: Gynecologic Imaging Reporting and Data System

title.en: GI-RADS: transvaginal US of adnexal masses (2009)

scope.zh: 原始前瞻性初步研究的附件肿块模式识别及1–5分级。是2009出版方案，不采用后续或O-RADS风险阈值。
scope.en: Original preliminary prospective pattern-recognition framework and categories 1–5 for adnexal masses. This is the 2009 published scheme, without later or O-RADS risk thresholds.

sourcePages.en: PDF pages 2–5; methods, Figures 1–6 and Tables 1–3 (printed pages 286–289).

examinations.label: Transvaginal US / color and spectral Doppler

purpose.zh: 扫子宫与附件，记录双侧性、壁厚、分隔、乳头、实性区、回声及腹水；以A×B×C×0.5233估算cm³体积。彩色多普勒找肿块血流，再频谱测最低阻力指数RI；原研究绝经前黄体期不做多普勒，以避免黄体血流混淆。
purpose.en: Scan uterus/adnexa for bilaterality, wall thickness, septa, papillary projections, solid areas, echogenicity and ascites; estimate volume in cm³ as A×B×C×0.5233. Locate tumor vessels with color Doppler and measure lowest RI spectrally; the original study avoided Doppler in premenopausal luteal-phase scans to avoid corpus-luteum vascular confusion.

zh: 正常卵巢，未见附件肿块。
en: Normal ovaries without an adnexal mass.

zh: 有功能性来源特征，如卵泡、黄体或出血囊肿。
en: Functional-origin appearance, e.g. follicle, corpus luteum or hemorrhagic cyst.

zh: 典型良性模式，如子宫内膜异位囊肿、成熟畸胎瘤、单纯囊肿、输卵管积水、卵巢旁囊肿、腹膜假囊肿、带蒂肌瘤或盆腔炎表现。
en: Recognizable benign patterns, e.g. endometrioma, mature teratoma, simple cyst, hydrosalpinx, paraovarian cyst, peritoneal pseudocyst, pedunculated myoma or pelvic inflammatory disease.

zh: 不能归入上述模式且有1–2项可疑恶性征象。
en: Not assignable to the above patterns and has one or two suspicious malignant features.
Three or more suspicious features listed for category 4.

zh: 原文没有给出数值mm界值。
en: No numeric mm cutoff is supplied.

zh: 原文没有给出数值厚度界值。
en: No numeric thickness cutoff is supplied.
Solid tissue within the adnexal lesion.
<0.5; exactly 0.5 does not satisfy this feature.

steps.zh: 先以模式识别是否正常、功能性或典型良性病变；未能归入前三组时再计可疑征象，1–2项为4，≥3项为5。
steps.en: First determine normal, functional or characteristic benign patterns. If not assigned to the first three groups, count suspicious features: one/two gives 4 and three or more gives 5.

steps.zh: 报告推测病因及形态依据，而不只提供数字。原文未规定无法模式识别且零项可疑征象的完整分支，不自行补成3。
steps.en: Report the presumed etiology and supporting morphology, not only a number. The source does not define a complete branch for an unrecognized pattern with zero suspicious features; do not silently invent category 3.

management.zh: 研究中1/2多观察；症状性2类有5例手术，其余2类观察至囊肿消退。3/4/5在研究中全部手术并取得组织学；这是验证队列处理方式，不是对所有当前3类病变的统一手术指令。
management.en: Most 1/2 cases were observed; five symptomatic category-2 cases had surgery, while others were followed to cyst resolution. All 3/4/5 masses underwent surgery with histology in the study; this is the validation-cohort approach rather than a universal current mandate to operate on category 3.

management.zh: 以5作为恶性检测界值时原研究敏感度92%、特异度97%；将4也算阳性时敏感度100%、特异度90%。原文没有按类别给出一致随访时长或转诊时间。
management.en: Using 5 as the positive threshold, sensitivity was 92% and specificity 97%; including 4 as positive raised sensitivity to 100% and lowered specificity to 90%. No uniform category-specific follow-up or referral time is prescribed.

cautions.zh: 依赖有经验者模式识别；早期未成熟畸胎瘤/低度恶性潜能肿瘤可假阴性，纤维瘤、卵巢甲状腺肿等可假阳性。类别名称不是病理证明。
cautions.en: Depends on experienced pattern recognition; early immature teratoma/borderline tumors may be false negative and fibroma/struma ovarii false positive. Category names are not histologic proof.

cautions.zh: 原文表2总计与正常卵巢行及正文数字不完全一致，不能据其构造新的精确类别患病率；本节不借用其他版本风险百分比。
cautions.en: Table 2 totals, its normal-ovary row and narrative counts are not fully consistent; do not derive new precise category prevalences from them. No risk percentages from other versions are imported.

name.zh: 间质性肺疾病报告和数据系统
name.en: Interstitial Lung Disease Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 间质性肺疾病 CT 标准化报告模板的先导研究。
summary.en: A pilot published standardized reporting template for interstitial lung disease CT.

domain.zh: 间质性肺疾病 CT 报告
domain.en: CT reporting of interstitial lung disease

sources.title: Interstitial Lung Disease Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 2019年纤维化性间质性肺病HRCT结构化报告试点；五类是0–4，目的是表达UIP模式，不是纤维化程度。纯囊性肺病且无纤维化成分不使用该模板。
scope.en: A 2019 pilot structured HRCT report for fibrotic ILD. The five categories are 0–4 and express UIP pattern rather than fibrosis severity. Pure cystic disease without fibrosis is outside the template.

sourcePages.zh: PDF第1–4页（1169–1172）；图1报告模板、图2完整类别。
sourcePages.en: PDF pages 1–4 (1169–1172); Figure 1 reporting template and Figure 2 categories.

purpose.zh: 非门控1 mm非增强薄层胸部CT，吸气及呼气；记录肺容量、网格、牵拉支扩、蜂窝、结节、囊肿、GGO、实变、马赛克／气体潴留、肺气肿。
purpose.en: Nongated 1 mm unenhanced chest CT at inspiration and expiration; document volumes, reticulation, traction bronchiectasis, honeycomb, nodules, cysts, GGO, consolidation, mosaic attenuation/air trapping and emphysema.

purpose.zh: 肺容量由定位像或冠／矢状重建估计；上区为肺尖至隆突，中区隆突至下肺静脉，下区下肺静脉至膈。记录轴向分布、既往变化及感染／急性加重／可疑恶性。
purpose.en: Estimate volumes on scout or coronal/sagittal reformats. Upper zone extends apex-to-carina, middle carina-to-inferior pulmonary veins, lower inferior veins-to-diaphragm. Record axial distribution, interval change and infection/exacerbation/malignancy.

zh: 不完整或不可诊断检查。
胸膜下、基底为主（常不均匀）；网格和蜂窝；牵拉支气管／细支气管扩张；无4类替代诊断征象。
en: Subpleural basal predominance, often heterogeneous; reticulation and honeycombing; traction bronchiectasis/bronchiolectasis; no category 4 alternative-diagnosis features.

zh: 胸膜下、基底为主；网格但无明确肉眼蜂窝；周边牵拉支气管／细支气管扩张；无4类征象。
en: Subpleural basal predominance; reticulation without definite macroscopic honeycombing; peripheral traction bronchiectasis/bronchiolectasis; no category 4 features.

zh: 纤维化弥漫、斑片、可变分布；无清楚胸膜下或基底优势；有轻微提示非UIP的征象。
en: Diffuse, patchy, variable fibrosis distribution; no clear subpleural/basal predominance; minor features suggesting a non-UIP pattern.

zh: 下列任一：上中肺优势；支气管血管周围优势并胸膜下保留；广泛GGO；实变优势；明显马赛克伴明确小叶气体潴留；弥漫结节；弥漫囊肿。
en: Any of: upper/midlung predominance, peribronchovascular predominance with subpleural sparing, extensive GGO, predominant consolidation, extensive mosaic attenuation with well-defined lobular air trapping, diffuse nodules, or diffuse cysts.

steps.zh: 报告正文逐项给阳性和阴性征象，结论选择0–4；若不是UIP模式，另外提出具体替代CT诊断。
steps.en: Document pertinent positive and negative findings and select 0–4 in the impression; if not UIP, provide an alternative CT diagnosis.

steps.zh: 合并肺纤维化及肺气肿时先诊断UIP、可分1，另定性描述肺气肿以表达合并病变。
steps.en: For combined fibrosis and emphysema, first assess UIP (potentially category 1) and qualitatively describe coexisting emphysema.

management.zh: 通过多学科ILD会诊结合临床确定IPF及治疗；该文没有按0–4规定活检、药物或复查间隔。
management.en: Integrate clinical data at multidisciplinary ILD review to establish IPF and treatment; the article does not prescribe category-based biopsy, medication or follow-up intervals.

cautions.zh: 为71份报告、8周的小规模实施及问卷研究；并未验证诊断准确度或结局。UIP影像模式不等于所有病因均为特发性肺纤维化。
cautions.en: The pilot evaluated 71 reports over eight weeks with surveys, rather than diagnostic accuracy or outcomes. A UIP imaging pattern does not establish idiopathic etiology.

name.zh: 间质性肺纤维化影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Interstitial Lung Fibrosis Imaging Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于间质性肺纤维化 CT 所见的影像报告框架。
summary.en: A published imaging-reporting framework for CT findings of interstitial lung fibrosis.

domain.zh: 间质性肺纤维化 CT 评估
domain.en: CT assessment of interstitial lung fibrosis

sources.title: Interstitial Lung Fibrosis Imaging Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 2020年间质性肺纤维化HRCT报告框架；类别和管理建议依据该原文，不与2019年ILD-RADS模板混合。
scope.en: A 2020 HRCT framework for interstitial lung fibrosis; categories and proposed management follow this paper and are kept separate from the 2019 ILD-RADS template.

sourcePages.en: PDF pages 2–4 and 6–9 (657–659 and 661–664); Tables 1–3, Figures 18–21.

purpose.zh: 记录网格、牵拉支扩、蜂窝、结节、囊肿、GGO、实变、马赛克及肺气肿；多平面及minIP辅助区分蜂窝与牵拉支扩，呼气扫描确认气体潴留。
purpose.en: Record reticulation, traction bronchiectasis, honeycomb, nodules, cysts, GGO, consolidation, mosaic attenuation and emphysema; multiplanar/minIP images help separate honeycomb from traction bronchi, and expiration confirms air trapping.

purpose.zh: 记录肺容量、中心／周边／弥漫和上中下分布、纵向变化；上区到隆突、中区到下肺静脉、下区至膈。另评估肺动脉高压、纵隔淋巴结、胸膜、气道、可见腹部及骨软组织异常。
purpose.en: Record volume, central/peripheral/diffuse and upper/middle/lower distribution and interval change; zones end at carina, inferior pulmonary veins and diaphragm. Assess pulmonary hypertension, mediastinal nodes, pleura, airways, visible abdomen and bones/soft tissues.

zh: 未进行或未完成影像评估。
基底及胸膜下优势；网格＋蜂窝＋周边牵拉支扩；无非典型征象；可有轻度GGO但不是优势征象。
en: Basal/subpleural predominance; reticulation, honeycomb and peripheral traction bronchiectasis; no atypical features; mild nondominant GGO may occur.

zh: 同样基底及胸膜下优势；网格而无蜂窝；周边牵拉支扩；无非典型征象；轻度非优势GGO可有。
en: Basal/subpleural predominance, reticulation without honeycomb, peripheral traction bronchiectasis, absent atypical features and possible mild nondominant GGO.

zh: 无清楚基底或胸膜下优势；斑片纤维化，轻网格但无蜂窝、无牵拉支扩；征象／分布不提示特定病因。
en: No clear basal/subpleural predominance; patchy fibrosis, mild reticulation without honeycomb or traction bronchiectasis; findings/distribution do not suggest a specific cause.

zh: 上中肺优势，或非典型表现：囊肿、显著马赛克、中心小叶结节、实变、广泛GGO。
en: Upper/midlung predominance or atypical features: cysts, marked mosaic attenuation, centrilobular nodules, consolidation or extensive GGO.

zh: 胸膜下有壁、成层囊腔，通常3–10 mm；微囊<4 mm、宏囊>4 mm。
en: Layered subpleural walled cystic airspaces, usually 3–10 mm; microcystic <4 mm and macrocystic >4 mm.

zh: GGO仍见血管和支气管壁；实变遮蔽血管。纤维化区外新发纯GGO需考虑感染或急性加重。
en: GGO preserves vessels/bronchial walls; consolidation obscures vessels. New pure GGO outside fibrotic areas suggests infection or exacerbation.

zh: 呼气时低密度异常区不增浓，正常区增浓；若非气体潴留，各区均随呼气增浓。
en: Low-attenuation abnormal regions fail to increase on expiration while normal regions increase; without air trapping, all regions increase.

steps.zh: 按表3联合形态与分布赋类，同时描述肺外征象及并发症；比较既往以识别纤维化进展或周边新肿块。
steps.en: Combine morphology and distribution using Table 3, describing extrapulmonary findings and complications; compare prior scans for fibrosis progression or new peripheral masses.

management.zh: 作者提出：1–2不推荐外科肺活检，采用药物治疗和常规监测；3在3个月内重复诊断影像；4考虑活检或药物治疗，或<3个月重复诊断影像；由多学科团队制定。
management.en: The authors propose no surgical lung biopsy for 1–2, with medical treatment and routine surveillance; repeat diagnostic imaging within three months for 3; consider biopsy, medical treatment or repeat imaging in <3 months for 4, planned by a multidisciplinary team.

management.zh: 一般随访HRCT的最佳频率原文称尚不确定；急性呼吸恶化可进行HRCT评估。
management.en: The optimal general HRCT surveillance frequency is stated to be unknown; HRCT is indicated for suspected acute respiratory deterioration.

cautions.zh: 原文是新提出的报告框架，要求多中心验证；管理段为作者建议，不能等同于独立验证的统一治疗指南。
cautions.en: This new reporting framework calls for multicenter validation; the management section is an author proposal rather than an independently validated universal treatment guideline.

cautions.zh: 原文微／宏蜂窝用<4与>4 mm，恰4 mm未分；这不改变表3中蜂窝是否存在的主要判据。
cautions.en: The source leaves exactly 4 mm unassigned between micro/macro honeycomb; this does not alter the main category criterion of honeycomb presence.

name.zh: 韩国甲状腺影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Korean Thyroid Imaging Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 韩国甲状腺放射学会及韩国放射学会发布的甲状腺结节超声诊断与影像管理共识。
summary.en: A Korean Society of Thyroid Radiology and Korean Society of Radiology consensus for ultrasound diagnosis and imaging-based management of thyroid nodules.

organization: Korean Society of Thyroid Radiology and Korean Society of Radiology

domain.zh: 甲状腺结节超声风险分层
domain.en: Ultrasound risk stratification of thyroid nodules

sources.title: Korean Thyroid Imaging Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 本地原文是2016修订韩国共识而非后续版本。甲状腺结节依组成、回声和三项可疑征象分类，并将超声与Bethesda细胞学联用。
scope.en: The local source is the revised 2016 Korean consensus, not a later version. Classifies thyroid nodules by composition, echogenicity and three suspicious features, integrating US with Bethesda cytology.

sourcePages.en: PDF pages 3–7, 9–13 and 14–18; Tables 1–5, Figures 1–9 (printed pages 372–387).

purpose.zh: 在横/纵切面测三径；实性为无明显囊性成分，主要实性为囊性≤50%，主要囊性为囊性>50%，纯囊无实性。低回声与甲状腺比较，显著低回声低于肌肉；记录颈部淋巴结和包膜外侵犯。
purpose.en: Measure three dimensions in transverse/longitudinal planes; solid means no obvious cystic component, predominantly solid cystic ≤50%, predominantly cystic cystic >50%, and pure cyst no solid portion. Compare hypoechogenicity with thyroid and marked hypoechogenicity with muscle; assess cervical nodes and extrathyroidal extension.

zh: 海绵样；无可疑征象且彗尾位于囊性部分的部分囊性结节；纯囊。实性部分的彗尾不能用于确认良性。
海绵样<3%，可选择≥2 cm FNA；后两者<1%，无诊断FNA适应证。
en: Spongiform; partially cystic nodule without suspicious features and comet-tail artifact within the cystic portion; pure cyst. A comet tail in solid tissue does not establish benignity.
Spongiform <3%, selectively FNA ≥2 cm; latter two <1%, no diagnostic FNA indication.

zh: 部分囊性或等/高回声，无三项可疑征象。
en: Partially cystic or iso/hyperechoic without the three suspicious features.

zh: 实性低回声但无可疑征象；或部分囊性/等高回声伴任何可疑征象。
en: Solid hypoechoic without suspicious features; or partially cystic/iso-hyperechoic with any suspicious feature.

zh: 实性低回声伴三项可疑征象中至少一项。
en: Solid hypoechoic with at least one of the three suspicious features.

zh: 微钙化、非平行/高于宽方向、毛刺/微分叶边缘。
en: Microcalcification, nonparallel/taller-than-wide orientation and spiculated/microlobulated margin.

zh: 高风险：3–6个月内重复FNA或有经验者CNB；中/低风险：6–12个月。
en: High suspicion: repeat FNA or expert CNB within 3–6 months; intermediate/low: 6–12 months.

zh: 高风险：6–12个月重复FNA；中/低风险：12–24个月超声，此后可2–4年一次。
en: High suspicion: repeat FNA in 6–12 months; intermediate/low: US in 12–24 months, then potentially every 2–4 years.

zh: 高风险：3–6个月重复FNA；中/低：6–12个月；结合风险可密切观察，重复仍不确定可观察或诊断手术。
en: High suspicion: repeat FNA in 3–6 months; intermediate/low: 6–12 months; selected cases may be closely followed, with observation/diagnostic surgery if still inconclusive.

zh: 诊断性叶切除；部分患者可依据临床、大小、US和分子结果观察。
en: Diagnostic lobectomy; selected patients may be followed based on clinical factors, size, US and molecular results.

zh: 可疑恶性+高/中风险建议手术，低风险可重复FNA或手术；恶性建议手术。成人低危微小乳头癌可考虑主动监测。
en: Suspicious cytology with high/intermediate US: surgery; low US: repeat FNA or surgery. Malignant cytology: surgery; selected adult low-risk papillary microcarcinoma may undergo surveillance.

zh: 微钙化为实性部分≤1 mm亮点，可有/无声影；海绵样为等回声结节中微囊占>50%，不是EU-TIRADS要求的全海绵样。
en: Microcalcification is an echogenic focus ≤1 mm in solid tissue, with/without shadowing; spongiform means microcysts >50% of an isoechoic nodule, distinct from entirely spongiform EU-TIRADS.

zh: US任一囊变、微/粗钙化、局灶/弥漫高回声、周边或弥漫异常血流；CT任一囊变、钙化、不均匀或强烈局灶/弥漫增强。有任一可疑征象优先于门型良性征象。
en: US: any cystic change, micro/macrocalcification, focal/diffuse hyperechogenicity or abnormal peripheral/diffuse flow. CT: cystic change, calcification, heterogeneous or strong focal/diffuse enhancement. Any suspicious feature overrides hilar benign signs.

zh: 无可疑征象且有门回声或中央门型血流；CT有门脂肪或门血管增强。
en: No suspicious sign and either central hilar echo or hilar flow; on CT, hilar fat or hilar-vessel enhancement.

zh: 没有可疑或良性分组条件；US门回声缺失且门型血流缺失，CT门脂肪及门血管增强均缺失。
en: Neither suspicious nor benign criteria; absent hilar echo and flow on US, or absent hilar fat and hilar-vessel enhancement on CT.

steps.zh: 先区分实性低回声与部分囊性/等高回声，再看三项可疑征象，按图1完整保留有/无两支；正常无结节为1。
steps.en: Distinguish solid hypoechoic from partially cystic/iso-hyperechoic, then branch by presence/absence of the three suspicious features as in Figure 1; no nodule is 1.

steps.zh: 疑似淋巴结转移、甲状腺外侵犯或已证实远处转移时，结节无论大小及US类型均应考虑FNA。否则结合风险与大小阈值；每个结节独立评估，不能只取最大。
steps.en: Suspected nodal metastasis, extrathyroidal extension or proven distant metastasis prompts FNA regardless of nodule size/US pattern. Otherwise use risk and size thresholds; assess each nodule independently rather than sampling only the largest.

management.zh: 无高危预后因素的≤1 cm结节不常规全部FNA；>5 mm的高可疑结节可选择取样，依据临床、偏好和是否改变治疗。随访期间出现侵犯/结节转移或≥3 mm生长时可即时FNA。
management.en: Without poor prognostic factors, not all ≤1 cm nodules routinely undergo FNA; >5 mm high-suspicion nodules may be selectively sampled based on clinical factors, preference and treatment impact. New invasion/nodal disease or growth ≥3 mm during surveillance may prompt immediate FNA.

management.zh: 表5：可能/已证实甲状腺癌术前，可疑颈结节短轴>3–5 mm、未定结节>5 mm考虑FNA；术后可疑/未定结节短轴>8–10 mm；如紧邻重要结构或结果影响处置，可取更小结节。
management.en: Table 5: before surgery for possible/proven thyroid cancer, FNA suspicious cervical nodes >3–5 mm short axis or indeterminate nodes >5 mm; postoperative suspicious/indeterminate nodes >8–10 mm; smaller nodes may be sampled near vital structures or when results affect management.

cautions.zh: 保留2016表2的≥1/1.5/2 cm以及选择性>0.5 cm，不能混入新版阈值。弹性和血流不属于这三项可疑征象。
cautions.en: Retain 2016 thresholds ≥1/1.5/2 cm and selective >0.5 cm; do not import later versions. Elastography and vascularity are not the three defining suspicious features.

cautions.zh: 良性细胞学后的生长不自动要求重复FNA；综合US模式和临床。指南中结节取样阈值含3–5和8–10 mm范围，不能宣称单一确定界值。
cautions.en: Growth after benign cytology does not automatically require repeat FNA; integrate US pattern and clinical context. Nodal thresholds include 3–5 and 8–10 mm ranges and must not be represented as single exact cutoffs.

name.zh: 淋巴结报告和数据系统
name.en: Lymph Node Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于浅表淋巴结超声分类的发表框架。
summary.en: A published framework for ultrasound classification of superficial lymph nodes.

domain.zh: 浅表淋巴结超声评估
domain.en: Ultrasound assessment of superficial lymph nodes

sources.title: Lymph Node Reporting and Data System

title.zh: LN-RADS：浅表淋巴结启发式分级（2025）

scope.zh: 719个浅表淋巴结、489例患者的回顾性组织学对照；1、2、3、4a、4b、5共六组。将临床背景与形态综合判断，不存在简单加分公式。
scope.en: Retrospective histology-correlated study of 719 superficial nodes in 489 patients; six groups 1, 2, 3, 4a, 4b and 5. Combines clinical context and morphology; no simple additive equation.

sourcePages.en: PDF pages 5–9; section 2.3, Figure 3 and Tables 1–2.

purpose.zh: 测SAD短轴、LAD长轴、皮质厚度及髓质，评估L/S比、门、局部皮质增厚LCT和局灶皮质增厚FCT、皮质回声与背景脂肪、边缘和血管分布。结合肿瘤、血液病、感染、疫苗和实验室背景。
purpose.en: Measure SAD, LAD, cortex and medulla; assess L/S ratio, hilum, local cortical thickening (LCT), focal cortical thickening (FCT), echogenicity relative to background fat, borders and flow. Include cancer/hematologic disease, inflammation, vaccination and laboratory history.

title.zh: 六组的形态与临床组合
title.en: Morphological and clinical patterns of six groups

zh: 建议SAD最大约6–7 mm；L/S>2；规则皮质≤3 mm，回声等于或高于背景脂肪，光滑；无钙化、液体、坏死、FCT/LCT或病理性周边/紊乱血流。
en: Suggested maximum SAD about 6–7 mm; L/S>2; regular cortex ≤3 mm, equal/higher echogenicity than fat, smooth borders; no calcification, fluid, necrosis, FCT/LCT or pathological peripheral/chaotic flow.

zh: 一或双轴可大；皮质规则≤3 mm，脂肪门高回声且无大小上限；无其他结构改变及病理性周边/紊乱血流。
en: May enlarge in one/both axes; regular cortex ≤3 mm, echogenic fatty hilum without size limits; no other architectural changes or pathological peripheral/chaotic flow.

zh: 常与炎症/疫苗有关；皮质>3 mm，规则或轻微不规则；L/S>2，髓质保留；无钙化、液体、坏死或FCT；皮质等或稍低于脂肪，边界清晰，无异常周边/紊乱血流，可见门小血管；无肿瘤/血液病史及肿瘤性实验室异常。
en: Often inflammatory/vaccine-related; cortex >3 mm, regular/minimally irregular; L/S>2 and preserved medulla; no calcification, fluid, necrosis or FCT; cortex equal/moderately lower than fat, well-defined margin, no abnormal peripheral/chaotic flow, possibly small hilar vessels; no oncologic/hematologic history or oncologic laboratory abnormality.

zh: SAD/LAD可正常；皮质>3 mm并中度不规则，尤其LCT；或原3组伴增加恶性可能性的临床因素。
en: SAD/LAD may be normal; cortex >3 mm with moderate irregularity, particularly LCT; or a group-3 appearance with clinical factors increasing suspicion.

zh: 大小可正常；皮质>4 mm且不规则尤其FCT，或无门；L/S≤2；低回声尤其近无回声“黑洞征”；微钙化、液体、坏死、异常周边/紊乱血流或模糊边缘。
en: Size may be normal; cortex >4 mm and irregular, especially FCT, or absent hilum; L/S≤2; hypoechoic, particularly nearly anechoic black-hole sign; microcalcification, fluid, necrosis, peripheral/chaotic flow or blurred margin.

zh: 短轴增大并多项恶性形态：皮质>6 mm、无门、低回声/黑洞征、明显LCT/FCT、L/S≤2、微钙化、液体/坏死、周边/紊乱血流、模糊边缘或包膜外浸润。
en: Enlarged SAD plus multiple malignant findings: cortex >6 mm, absent hilum, hypoechoic/black-hole appearance, obvious LCT/FCT, L/S≤2, microcalcification, fluid/necrosis, peripheral/chaotic flow, blurred borders or extracapsular infiltration.

steps.zh: 优先整体匹配模式而非机械按某一个厚度阈值赋级。3组形态合并活动区域肿瘤、同区其他转移/系统性结节、升高/上升肿瘤指标或血液病症状时考虑4组。
steps.en: Match the overall pattern rather than assigning a category mechanically from one thickness cutoff. A group-3 pattern with active regional cancer, other metastatic/systemic nodes, elevated/rising markers or hematologic symptoms should raise consideration of group 4.

steps.zh: 原文强调4组为不能归入1、2、3或5，或有附加可疑因素的结节，再综合分4a/4b；没有固定“必须有几项”的算法。
steps.en: Group 4 comprises nodes not fitting 1, 2, 3 or 5, or with additional suspicious factors; subdivide by overall suspicion into 4a/4b. There is no fixed required feature count.

management.zh: 原文建议所有4a以活检或PET核实，无法活检时按可疑/恶性对待；4b/5提示更高恶性可能，组织学与病种决定治疗。文章未规定各组统一随访间隔。
management.en: The authors recommend biopsy or PET verification for all 4a nodes and treating unbiopsiable 4a nodes as suspected malignant. Groups 4b/5 imply higher suspicion; histology and disease context determine treatment. No universal category-specific surveillance interval is prescribed.

cautions.zh: “明确恶性”是影像组名而非病理证明；5组仍有良性病例。3组可被淋巴瘤/白血病或均匀皮质转移模拟。
cautions.en: Definitely malignant is an imaging group name, not histologic proof; group 5 still contained benign cases. Lymphoma/leukemia or regular-cortex metastases can mimic group 3.

cautions.zh: 结果分析中的皮质厚度≥6 mm最佳阈值、表1的五档单项特征图，均不是LN-RADS分类公式；不要以它们取代2.3节。
cautions.en: The result-derived optimum cortex cutoff ≥6 mm and five-grade individual-feature grid in Table 1 are not LN-RADS category algorithms; do not substitute them for section 2.3.

name.zh: 肺部报告和数据系统
name.en: Lung Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于肺癌 CT 筛查的发表分级建议。
summary.en: A published proposal for CT lung-cancer screening classification.

domain.zh: 肺癌 CT 筛查

sources.title: Lung Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 2014年筛查CT发现肺结节的沟通与管理框架，包含1–6和3S/3L、4A/4B/4C；并非ACR Lung-RADS。
scope.en: A 2014 communication/management framework for screen-detected nodules, including 1–6, 3S/3L and 4A/4B/4C; distinct from ACR Lung-RADS.

sourcePages.en: PDF pages 2–11 (122–131); Table 1 and Figures 1–10.

purpose.zh: 低剂量薄层CT记录大小、密度、边缘及实性成分；部分实性结节分别报告整体和实性部分的大小／增长。与最近及最早CT均比较；局部增长可能不改变最大径。
purpose.en: Low-dose thin-section CT assesses size, density, margins and solid component. Report overall and solid-component size/growth separately for part-solid nodules; compare both recent and earliest CT, since focal growth may leave maximal diameter unchanged.

zh: 任何密度<5 mm（约60 mm³）；良性钙化模式（全钙化、完整钙化环、中心钙化）；良性叶间裂旁结节；含脂肪错构瘤（至少8体素−40至−120 HU）；圆形不张；核心活检特定良性诊断；≥5 mm实性结节至少2年无／极少增长，亚实性至少5年无增长。
en: Any density <5 mm (~60 mm³); benign calcification (complete, complete ring or central); benign perifissural nodule; fat-containing hamartoma (−40 to −120 HU in ≥8 voxels); rounded atelectasis; specific benign core-biopsy diagnosis; ≥5 mm solid nodule with no/minimal growth ≥2 years, or subsolid with no growth ≥5 years.

zh: 5–9 mm（约60–500 mm³），新发／不增大，尚未达到实性2年或亚实性5年稳定期。
en: New/nonenlarging 5–9 mm (~60–500 mm³), not yet meeting two-year solid or five-year subsolid stability.

zh: 新发或基线≥10 mm（约500 mm³）且可能是短暂炎症；如模糊／GGO边缘、部分GGO、多发新结节、簇状、伴树芽／炎症，或近3个月呼吸道感染史。
en: New/baseline ≥10 mm (~500 mm³) with any possibility of transient inflammation: indistinct/GGO margins, partial GGO, multiple new/clustered nodules, tree-in-bud/inflammatory findings or respiratory infection in prior three months.

zh: 10–25 mm实性结节，较良性但不确定：边界清楚、近球形，无微分叶，如未证实宏观脂肪的错构瘤或非钙化肉芽肿。
en: 10–25 mm solid nodule with benign-leaning but nondefinitive features: well-defined, roughly spherical without microlobulations, e.g. hamartoma without proven macroscopic fat or noncalcified granuloma.

zh: 4B 很可能原位／微浸润腺癌
≥10 mm且持续不消退／不改善的纯GGO，或部分实性且实性部分≤5 mm。整体／实性成分增长需要再评估。
en: Persistent ≥10 mm pure GGO or part-solid nodule with solid component ≤5 mm that does not resolve/improve. Reassess overall/solid-component growth.

zh: 令人担忧的持续：≥10 mm部分实性结节短期不改善且实性部分≥5 mm；增长：实性结节／实性部分恶性速度增长；基线：≥10 mm、清楚且分叶／毛刺的实性结节，无炎症可能或良性特征。
en: Worrisome persistence: ≥10 mm part-solid nodule without short-interval improvement and solid component ≥5 mm; growth: malignant growth of solid nodule/component; baseline: ≥10 mm well-defined lobulated/spiculated solid nodule without inflammatory possibility or benign features.

zh: 明确侵袭行为，如胸壁或纵隔侵犯。
en: Frankly invasive behavior, e.g. chest-wall or mediastinal invasion.

zh: 支气管镜、经皮取样或手术明确肺恶性肿瘤。
en: Lung malignancy proven by bronchoscopy, percutaneous sampling or surgery.

zh: 达到相应稳定期后归2；实性结节增大、GGO增浓或长到≥10 mm应转4B或4C。
en: Reassign to 2 after sufficient stability; enlarging solid nodules, densifying GGO or growth to ≥10 mm prompt 4B/4C.

zh: 短期CT完全消退可回筛查；无改善转4；缩小但未消退可继续观察。
en: Resolution permits return to screening; no improvement prompts 4; partial decrease may warrant further follow-up.

zh: 实性结节VDT<400天通常符合恶性速度，>400天较支持良性；新发大结节VDT<30天较支持短暂炎症。GGO肿瘤常>600天；短暂缩小不确证良性。
en: Solid VDT <400 days generally fits malignant growth; >400 days favors benignity. A newly large nodule with VDT <30 days favors transience. GGO tumors often exceed 600 days; transient shrinkage does not prove benignity.

steps.zh: 逐个结节综合形态、大小及随访行为，按最相关发现形成报告；良性叶间裂旁形态为沿裂、实性、亚厘米、光滑清楚及椭圆／透镜／多边形。圆形不张需胸膜接触、容积缩小、胸膜异常和支气管血管卷曲。
steps.en: Integrate morphology, size and serial behavior for each nodule and report the relevant findings. Benign perifissural morphology is fissural, solid, subcentimeter, smooth, well-defined and oval/lentiform/polygonal. Rounded atelectasis requires pleural contact, volume loss, pleural abnormality and bronchovascular swirling.

management.zh: 1–2回常规年度筛查；2无需额外检查，但转移风险者可能需提前。3S用机构选定的大小相关LDCT计划，原文不统一规定间隔；表1对3L建议6–12周LDCT以排除短暂炎症，无改善转4。
management.en: Return 1–2 to annual screening; no additional workup for 2, though metastatic-risk patients may need earlier review. Use locally selected size-based LDCT schedules for 3S; Table 1 recommends 6–12-week LDCT for 3L to exclude transient inflammation, with no improvement prompting category 4.

management.zh: 4A转专科，可PET或优先核心活检；表1至少3个月复查，即使检查支持良性仍随访，实性2年稳定可转2。4B转专科共同决定切除或随访，未切除者每年筛查剂量CT；PET分期不推荐，取样低检出率。
management.en: Refer 4A; consider PET or preferably core biopsy. Table 1 specifies at least a three-month follow-up, continued even after reassuring tests; solid two-year stability permits category 2. Refer 4B for shared resection/surveillance planning, with annual screening-dose CT if not initially resected; PET staging is not indicated and sampling has low yield.

management.zh: 4C/5需迅速专科确认、分期、治疗；PET、细针取样或支气管镜阴性与高度可疑CT不一致时需讨论。部分实性活检靶向实性成分。6分期治疗；根治后仍适合治疗且没有常规CT随访者可继续筛查第二原发。
management.en: Promptly refer 4C/5 for confirmation, staging and treatment; negative PET, fine-needle sampling or bronchoscopy discordant with CT requires discussion. Target the solid component for part-solid biopsy. Stage/treat 6; eligible patients without regular surveillance CT may continue screening for second primaries.

cautions.zh: 表1中4B实性成分≤5 mm、4C>5 mm；第10页正文却将4C写为至少5 mm，产生恰5 mm的表／正文差异。本节4C行保留正文描述，应综合持续性和增长，不凭该边界独断。
cautions.en: Table 1 uses solid component ≤5 mm for 4B and >5 mm for 4C, while page 10 prose uses at least 5 mm for 4C. At exactly 5 mm, table and prose differ. The criteria row retains the prose and calls for integrating persistence/growth rather than relying on this boundary alone.

cautions.zh: 这是2014年提出的框架；随访策略依当地筛查计划，不能将其阈值自动替换为ACR Lung-RADS。
cautions.en: This is a 2014 proposal with locally selected screening follow-up schedules; its thresholds are not interchangeable with ACR Lung-RADS.

name.zh: 前列腺癌转移报告和数据系统
name.en: Metastasis Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于晚期前列腺癌全身 MRI 多器官受累评估和报告的实践指南。
summary.en: A published guideline for whole-body MRI acquisition, interpretation and reporting of multiorgan involvement in advanced prostate cancer.

domain.zh: 晚期前列腺癌全身 MRI 评估
domain.en: Whole-body MRI assessment of advanced prostate cancer

sources.title: Metastasis Reporting and Data System

title.en: MET-RADS-P: whole-body MRI metastasis and regional response

scope.zh: 前列腺癌全身MRI采集、判读和区域疗效报告共识（2017）。
scope.en: The 2017 consensus for whole-body MRI acquisition, interpretation and regional response reporting in prostate cancer.

sourcePages.zh: PDF第3–8页：协议与判读；第4页表2；第8–10页区域报告及不一致应答；第9页表3。
sourcePages.en: PDF pp 3–8: protocol and interpretation; p 4 Table 2; pp 8–10 regional reporting and discordance; p 9 Table 3.

purpose.zh: 核心方案检测转移；已知转移及连续疗效评估采用全面方案，保留基线及最低负荷检查供比较。
purpose.en: Use core protocol to detect metastases and comprehensive protocol for known metastatic disease and serial response; retain baseline and nadir studies.

purpose.zh: 记录原发肿瘤、淋巴结、内脏及骨病范围，结合治疗、PSA、症状及骨髓刺激治疗背景。
purpose.en: Record primary, nodal, visceral and bone involvement alongside treatment, PSA, symptoms and marrow-stimulating therapy.

zh: 全脊柱矢状T1及STIR/脂抑T2，层厚4–5 mm，两种方案均有。
en: Whole-spine sagittal T1 and STIR/fat-suppressed T2, 4–5-mm sections in both protocols.

zh: 头顶至大腿中段T1 Dixon，核心轴位5 mm或冠状2 mm，全面方案两者均做；脂肪图必需。
en: T1 Dixon vertex to midthighs; core axial 5 mm or coronal 2 mm; comprehensive both; fat images mandatory.

zh: 颅底至大腿中段轴位DWI，STIR脂抑，连续5–7 mm；核心b=50–100和800–1000 s/mm²，全面增加500–600；单指数ADC、冠状高b重建及3D MIP。
en: Axial DWI skull base to midthighs, STIR, contiguous 5–7 mm; core b=50–100 and 800–1000 s/mm², comprehensive adds 500–600; monoexponential ADC, coronal high-b reconstruction and 3D MIP.

zh: 轴位非脂抑T2核心可选、全面/研究推荐；有症状或特定问题增加局部检查。
en: Axial non-fat-suppressed T2 is optional in core and included in comprehensive/research assessment; add regional imaging for symptoms or specific questions.

zh: 高度可能应答：受累骨髓恢复正常脂肪信号，病灶数量/大小明确下降，弥漫浸润转为局灶并减低负荷，骨病相关软组织减少，出现脂肪点/晕；ADC从≤1400升至>1400 µm²/s，或较基线增加≥40%且高b信号下降、形态稳定或应答。；还包括边到边致密硬化、边缘锐利及T2脂抑高信号薄环变薄/消失。
en: Highly likely responding: restoration of fatty marrow, unequivocal reduction in lesion number/size, diffuse-to-focal change with reduced burden, reduced bone-associated soft tissue and fat-dot/halo signs; ADC rises from ≤1400 to >1400 µm²/s, or increases ≥40% from baseline with lower high-b signal and stable/responding morphology. Also includes dense edge-to-edge sclerosis, sharp margins and a very thin/disappearing T2-fat-suppressed hyperintense rim.

zh: 可能应答：改善不足以满足RAC 1，例如轻微缩小/减少；ADC由≤1000升高但仍<1400 µm²/s，或较基线增加>25%且<40%，同时高b信号下降且形态稳定/应答。
en: Likely responding: improvement insufficient for RAC 1, e.g. slight reduction in lesion size/number; ADC increases from ≤1000 but remains <1400 µm²/s, or increases >25% and <40%, with lower high-b signal and stable/responding morphology.

zh: 可能进展：恶化但不满足RAC 5；新灶不确定；大小不变而高b信号增高、ADC<1400 µm²/s；已消失灶再现或曾缩小/稳定灶增大；椎管软组织导致狭窄但无神经症状且不需放疗。；亦包括可能有临床意义的影像骨病灶，排除非关键骨的无症状骨折。
en: Likely progressing: worsening insufficient for RAC 5; equivocal new lesions; unchanged size but higher high-b signal with ADC <1400 µm²/s; reappearance of resolved lesions or enlargement of previously regressed/stabilized lesions; canal soft tissue causes narrowing without neurologic findings or a need for radiotherapy. Also includes potentially clinically important bone lesions, excluding asymptomatic fractures in noncritical bones.

zh: 高度可能进展：MRI证实恶性的新关键骨折/脊髓压迫且需放疗或手术；原正常骨髓中新出现明确局灶/弥漫浸润；数量/大小明确增加；局灶转弥漫；骨病相关软组织新出现/增加；新高b信号区域ADC为600–1000 µm²/s。
en: Highly likely progressing: new critical fracture/cord compression confirmed malignant on MRI and requiring radiotherapy or surgery; unequivocal new focal/diffuse infiltration in previously normal marrow; unequivocal growth in lesion size/number; focal-to-diffuse change; new/increasing bone-associated soft tissue; new high-b lesions with ADC 600–1000 µm²/s.

title.zh: 软组织与淋巴结分支（原文表中RECIST 1.1摘要）
title.en: Soft-tissue and nodal branches (source-table RECIST 1.1 summary)

zh: CR为靶病灶消失；PR为最长径总和较基线减少≥30%。RAC 1用明确PR/CR；改善但未达PR归RAC 2。
en: CR is disappearance of target lesions; PR is ≥30% reduction in summed longest diameters from baseline. RAC 1 uses definite PR/CR; improvement below PR is RAC 2.

zh: SD为不足以达PR或PD；PD为最长径总和较治疗以来最低值增加≥20%或出现新灶；恶化未达PD为RAC 4，达到PD为RAC 5。此处保留来源摘要，不替代完整RECIST规范。
en: SD is insufficient change for PR or PD; PD is ≥20% increase in summed longest diameters from treatment nadir or new lesions. Worsening below PD is RAC 4; meeting PD is RAC 5. This retains the source summary, not the full RECIST specification.

zh: 短轴较基线或最低值增长≥5 mm且达到≥1 cm才视为进展。
en: Progression requires ≥5-mm short-axis growth from baseline/nadir and a final short axis ≥1 cm.

zh: 短轴增长≥5 mm且达到≥1.5 cm可视为进展；短轴≥1.5 cm按RECIST 1.1。
en: Progression may be assigned with ≥5-mm short-axis growth and a final short axis ≥1.5 cm; nodes ≥1.5 cm use RECIST 1.1.

title.zh: 基线测量、应答异质性与复查时点
title.en: Baseline measurement, heterogeneity and follow-up timing

zh: 基线映射14个区域：原发、7个骨骼、5个淋巴结/内脏及其他。骨灶高质量T1测最长径≥1.5 cm，最多5灶（有则含附肢骨）；淋巴结短轴≥1.5 cm最多5灶，软组织最长径≥1.5 cm最多5灶，共最多15。
en: Map 14 regions: primary, seven skeletal, five nodal/visceral and other sites. Measure up to five bone lesions ≥1.5 cm long axis on high-quality T1 (include appendicular skeleton if present), five nodes ≥1.5 cm short axis and five soft-tissue lesions ≥1.5 cm long axis, maximum 15.

zh: 淋巴结短轴≥1且<1.5 cm为病理性但不可测量；明确内脏灶<1.5 cm也记为不可测。高分辨率3D情况下门槛可放宽至1 cm；临床试验特殊入组通常仍优选≥1.5 cm、最低>1 cm。
en: Nodes ≥1 and <1.5 cm short axis are pathologic but nonmeasurable, as are unequivocal visceral lesions <1.5 cm. High-resolution 3D may permit 1 cm; exceptional trial enrollment still prefers ≥1.5 cm with a minimum >1 cm.

zh: 区域记录主导/第二/第三模式；主导为多数病灶，第二为第二常见。第三模式仅记录少数RAC 4/5进展，第三模式RAC 1–3可忽略。
en: Record dominant/secondary/tertiary regional patterns: dominant is most common, secondary second most common. Record tertiary only for minority RAC 4/5 progression; a tertiary RAC 1–3 pattern may be ignored.

zh: 软组织整体按CR/PR/SD/PD/discordant，骨整体按1–5及discordant；不能将各区域分数简单平均。进展测量比较基线或治疗最低值中较小者。
en: Overall soft tissue uses CR/PR/SD/PD/discordant, bone uses 1–5 plus discordant; do not average regional scores. Measurement-based progression uses the lower baseline/treatment-nadir value.

zh: 原文试验：前6个月每8–9周，之后每12周；已获批治疗常规每12周、临床需要可提前；M0-CRPC转移监测可16周。仅为2017原文情境建议。
en: Source trial setting: every 8–9 weeks for 6 months, then 12 weeks; approved therapy usually every 12 weeks with earlier assessment if clinically indicated; M0-CRPC surveillance may use 16 weeks. These are context-specific 2017 source suggestions.

steps.zh: 逐区域按多项形态+DWI+ADC证据给RAC，不用单一ADC变化替代综合判断；ADC阈值针对未经治疗病灶。
steps.en: Assign RAC by region using multiple morphology, DWI and ADC observations; do not use ADC alone. Thresholds derive from untreated lesions.

steps.zh: 原发、淋巴结、内脏和骨分别报告主导及其他反应；软组织不一致应答仅用于稳定/部分应答，骨仅用于稳定/应答，记录具体相反部位。
steps.en: Report dominant and other responses separately for primary, nodes, viscera and bone; use discordance only in stable/partial-response soft tissue and stable/responding bone, identifying contrary sites.

management.zh: 报告疾病负荷、关键骨折/神经压迫及区域异质性以支持多学科决策；RAC不是直接更换治疗的处方。
management.en: Report burden, critical fractures/neural compression and regional heterogeneity for multidisciplinary decisions; RAC does not prescribe a treatment change.

cautions.zh: 治疗后骨髓恢复、硬化和脂肪再现可能改变信号与ADC；高b图应与T1/T2、ADC共同阅读，不只看MIP。
cautions.en: Marrow recovery, sclerosis and fat reappearance after therapy can change signal and ADC; read high-b images with T1/T2 and ADC, not only MIP.

cautions.zh: 原文ADC单位经图像核对为µm²/s；文本提取可能丢失≤、≥及希腊字母。
cautions.en: ADC units were visually checked as µm²/s; text extraction may lose ≤/≥ signs and Greek characters.

cautions.zh: 致密硬化且DWI无可检测水信号的灶不可测ADC；高b阴性而低/中b仍有信号时可测。正常骨髓ADC通常<600–700、活肿瘤约700–1400 µm²/s，治疗/坏死常≥1400；有重叠且依技术变化。
cautions.en: Do not measure ADC in dense sclerotic lesions without detectable DWI water signal; absent high-b signal does not invalidate measurement if low/intermediate-b signal persists. Normal marrow is usually <600–700, viable tumor around 700–1400 µm²/s, treated/necrotic disease often ≥1400, with overlap and technical dependence.

name.zh: 分子影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Molecular Imaging Reporting and Data Systems

summary.zh: 面向靶向放射性示踪剂 PET 影像的通用报告框架。
summary.en: A generalizable published reporting framework for targeted-radiotracer PET imaging.

domain.zh: 靶向放射性示踪剂 PET 影像

sources.title: Molecular Imaging Reporting and Data Systems

title.en: MI-RADS: harmonized PSMA and SSTR molecular imaging

scope.zh: 2018年的PSMA-RADS与SSTR-RADS共同架构，两个靶点各自应用而非数字合并；与MY-RADS骨髓瘤体系不同。
scope.en: The 2018 shared architecture for PSMA-RADS and SSTR-RADS, applied separately by target rather than numerically combined; distinct from MY-RADS for myeloma.

sourcePages.zh: PDF第3–8页：生理分布、分类、图2流程；第8页表2（类别/处理及摄取脚注）与表3（报告要求）。
sourcePages.en: PDF pp 3–8: biodistribution, categories and Fig 2 workflow; p 8 Tables 2 (classes, work-up and uptake footnote) and 3 (report requirements).

purpose.zh: 前列腺癌背景，记录PSA、Gleason、活检/治疗及示踪剂注射量、采集时间、覆盖范围。
purpose.en: Use in prostate-cancer context and document PSA, Gleason, biopsy/treatment, injected activity, uptake time and field of view.

purpose.zh: NET背景，记录原发、CgA/NSE、Ki-67及既往FDG；SSTR三级摄取相对于血池和肝。
purpose.en: Use in NET context and document primary, CgA/NSE, Ki-67 and prior FDG; three SSTR uptake levels compare blood pool and liver.

title.zh: 两种靶点共享类别与差异

zh: 1A为组织/典型影像证实良性且无异常摄取；1B为证实良性但有摄取。MI-RADS原文采用2018分类，不能套用2025 PSMA合并1/5T。
en: 1A is proven benign without abnormal uptake; 1B is proven benign with uptake. This source uses the 2018 scheme; do not import the 2025 PSMA merged category 1 or 5T.

zh: 摄取位于不典型PCa或NET软组织/骨部位，倾向良性；无需凭此考虑靶向放射配体治疗。
en: Uptake in soft tissue/bone atypical for PCa or NET, likely benign; it does not support targeted radionuclide treatment.

zh: 典型PCa/NET软组织灶不确定摄取；活检或随访（原文表2为3–6个月，NET需结合Ki-67）。
en: Equivocal uptake in typical PCa/NET soft tissue; biopsy or follow-up (Table 2 gives 3–6 months, considering Ki-67 for NET).

zh: 不排斥PCa/NET的骨灶不确定摄取；活检或随访；SSTR单灶倾向局部，多/增多灶可讨论PRRT。
en: Equivocal bone uptake not atypical for PCa/NET; biopsy or follow-up; in SSTR, a single lesion may favor local treatment whereas increasing/multiple lesions may support PRRT consideration.

zh: 高度不典型PCa/NET部位强摄取，可能其他癌或良性病；建议组织学。
en: Intense uptake in a highly atypical PCa/NET site, potentially another tumor or benign process; biopsy is advised.

zh: 形态可疑恶性而无靶点摄取；活检/随访；SSTR另考虑FDG排除去分化。
en: Suspicious malignant anatomy without targeted uptake; biopsy/follow-up; SSTR additionally considers FDG for dedifferentiation.

zh: 均为典型部位强摄取；4缺乏确定常规影像对应，5有对应；原文讨论PRRT/PRLT，但须满足常规资格条件。
en: Both show intense uptake in typical sites; 4 lacks a definitive conventional correlate, 5 has one. The source discusses PRRT/PRLT subject to standard eligibility.

zh: 水平1≤血池；2>血池且≤肝；3>肝。表2脚注明确此摄取级别仅用于SSTR，不是PSMA的统一量表。
en: Level 1 ≤blood pool; 2 >blood pool and ≤liver; 3 >liver. The Table 2 footnote restricts these levels to SSTR, not a universal PSMA scale.

title.zh: 图2不确定PSMA灶的阳性与阴性分支
title.en: Fig 2 positive and negative branches for equivocal PSMA lesions

zh: 观察期间形态增大支持确认病变；未变仍疑良性并继续观察。活检证实则确认，阴性结果走良性分支。
en: Morphologic growth on observation supports disease confirmation; no change favors benignity with continued observation. Positive biopsy confirms disease; negative tissue takes the benign branch.

zh: 观察中形态变化（例如硬化增加）支持确认；未变继续观察。MRI异常强化、骨髓水肿或低T1支持病灶，缺乏这些则倾向良性；必须结合临床和具体形态。
en: Morphologic change on observation (e.g. increasing sclerosis) supports disease; absent change leads to continued observation. MRI abnormal enhancement, marrow edema or low T1 supports disease, absence favors benignity; interpret in clinical/morphologic context.

zh: 可选最多5个最强摄取/最大靶灶，整体取最高类别；PSMA与SSTR各自报分，不相加。
en: Select up to five most avid/largest target lesions and use the highest category overall; report PSMA and SSTR separately without adding scores.

steps.zh: 先选择相应靶点子体系，审核生理分布和假阳性，再逐灶分类和报告整体印象。
steps.en: Choose the relevant target-specific subsystem, review physiologic distribution/pitfalls, then classify individual lesions and summarize the study.

steps.zh: 保留较低分却可能是去分化/第二原发的灶，不能被整体高分覆盖。
steps.en: Retain lower-scored lesions that may represent dedifferentiation/second primary rather than hiding them behind the overall high score.

management.zh: 3A/B依影响决策选择活检或随访；NET高Ki-67可需更短间隔。放射配体治疗建议是原文待验证方向，不是仅凭影像类别处方。
management.en: Choose biopsy/follow-up for 3A/B according to decision impact; high-Ki-67 NET may need shorter intervals. Radionuclide treatment suggestions are proposed directions needing validation, not prescriptions from category alone.

cautions.zh: MI-RADS是可扩展的概念框架，原文只建立PSMA/SSTR；不能为FAP/CXCR4/GRPR等未来扩展虚构数值算法。
cautions.en: MI-RADS is an extensible concept with PSMA/SSTR established in this source; do not invent numeric algorithms for future FAP/CXCR4/GRPR extensions.

cautions.zh: 图2流程是文章示意，MRI水肿/低T1或阴性活检本身并非所有骨灶的绝对诊断标准。
cautions.en: Fig 2 is a schematic workflow; edema/low T1 or negative biopsy alone is not an absolute diagnostic rule for every bone lesion.

name.zh: 肌肉骨骼感染影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Musculoskeletal Infection Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于四肢肌肉骨骼感染 MRI 诊断的报告和数据系统。
summary.en: A published MRI-based reporting and data system for diagnosing extremity musculoskeletal infections.

domain.zh: 四肢肌肉骨骼感染 MRI 评估
domain.en: MRI assessment of extremity musculoskeletal infection

sources.title: Musculoskeletal Infection Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 2024年肌骨感染MRI分类，按浅层、深层、骨/关节及治疗后状态分型；NOS保留非感染炎症。
scope.en: The 2024 musculoskeletal-infection MRI classification by superficial/deep, bone/joint and treated states, with NOS retaining noninfectious inflammation.

sourcePages.zh: PDF第2–4页：检查与类别；第3页表1全分类及表2管理；第4页IV/V形态与筋膜征；第5–9页各类实例。
sourcePages.en: PDF pp 2–4: examination and classes; p 3 Tables 1 all categories and 2 management; p 4 IV/V morphology and fascial signs; pp 5–9 examples.

purpose.zh: 覆盖感染区域T1与液体敏感脂抑序列，增强有助于脓肿、坏死及滑膜；与临床、创口、治疗史及前片共同判断。
purpose.en: Cover the infected region with T1 and fluid-sensitive fat-suppressed sequences; enhancement helps assess abscess, devitalized tissue and synovium; correlate wound, clinical/treatment history and prior imaging.

purpose.zh: 缺必要检查归0；可补增强、CT评筋膜气体；MRI不适配时按情境用超声或SPECT-CT。
purpose.en: Missing necessary evaluation is 0; add contrast or CT for fascial gas; consider ultrasound or SPECT-CT when MRI is unsuitable.

zh: 检查不完整/不可诊断；补充影像。
无感染相关发现，可有单纯皮下水肿；感染无需进一步影像随访。
en: No infection-associated finding, possibly bland subcutaneous edema; no further infection imaging follow-up.

zh: 浅层感染：皮肤/皮下蜂窝织炎，溃疡、窦道、异物或皮肤脓肿。
en: Superficial infection: skin/subcutaneous cellulitis, ulcer, sinus tract, foreign body or cutaneous abscess.

zh: 深层/筋膜下或间感染、软组织脓肿、坏死性筋膜炎、肌炎/化脓性肌炎；可有失活组织、腱鞘/腱周或滑囊感染。
en: Deep/sub-/interfascial infection, abscess, necrotizing fasciitis or myositis/pyomyositis; possible devitalized tissue, infected tendon sheath/peritendon or bursa.

zh: 可能骨髓炎：邻近软组织感染骨髓液体敏感高信号，但T1无或仅轻皮质/皮质下改变；可有骨膜炎、骨膜下/骨旁脓肿、溃疡骨暴露。
en: Possible osteomyelitis: fluid-sensitive marrow edema by soft-tissue infection with absent/minimal cortical/subcortical T1 alteration; periostitis, subperiosteal/paraosseous abscess or exposed bone may occur.

zh: 高度提示骨髓炎：皮质侵蚀、融合性T1骨髓低信号、髓内脂肪球/骨内脓肿；可坏死、死骨、包壳、骨瘘或病理骨折。
en: Highly suggestive osteomyelitis: cortical erosion, confluent T1 marrow hypointensity, intramedullary fat globules/intraosseous abscess; possible necrosis, sequestrum, involucrum, cloaca or pathologic fracture.

zh: 高度提示化脓性关节炎：关节侵蚀、复杂积液、明显间隙丢失、增强滑膜炎。
en: Highly suggestive septic arthritis: erosions, complex effusion, substantial joint-space loss and enhancing synovitis.

zh: 同时高度提示骨髓炎及化脓性关节炎。
en: Highly suggestive osteomyelitis plus septic arthritis.

zh: 已知/推定骨髓炎或化脓性关节炎治疗中，无残余感染。
en: Known/presumed osteomyelitis/septic arthritis under treatment, with no residual infection.

zh: 治疗中感染明确持续或恶化，例如骨髓炎范围增加、新或增大脓肿。
en: Definite persistence/worsening during treatment, e.g. expanding osteomyelitis or new/increasing abscess.

zh: 非特异、可能非感染：结缔组织炎症、损伤、痛风、Charcot神经关节病或Raynaud相关表现。
en: Nonspecific possibly noninfectious change: connective-tissue inflammation, injury, gout, Charcot neuroarthropathy or Raynaud-associated findings.

title.zh: 原文处理建议（由临床团队执行）
title.en: Source management directions (for the clinical team)

zh: 药物治疗由团队决定；平片/MRI随访按临床。
en: Medical therapy determined by the team; radiographic/MRI follow-up according to clinical need.

zh: 考虑引流、标本培养/药敏及清创会诊；临床和/或MRI随访至消退。
en: Consider drainage, culture/susceptibility and debridement consultation; clinical and/or MRI follow-up to resolution.

zh: 考虑骨活检、培养/药敏及清创会诊；MRI随访由团队安排。
en: Consider bone biopsy, culture/susceptibility and debridement consultation; MRI follow-up per team.

zh: 考虑骨活检/手术，疑关节感染可关节冲洗，培养/药敏及清创；可治疗后6–8周MRI。
en: Consider bone biopsy/surgery, joint washout for suspected septic arthritis, culture/susceptibility and debridement; MRI may be considered 6–8 weeks after treatment.

zh: VIa不需感染影像随访；VIb可治疗后6–8周MRI。
en: VIa needs no infection imaging follow-up; VIb may undergo MRI 6–8 weeks after treatment.

zh: 团队结合培养/药敏继续或调整治疗，并评估骨/关节手术及清创；可治疗后6–8周MRI。
en: The team may continue/adjust therapy using culture/susceptibility and assess bone/joint intervention or debridement; MRI may be considered at 6–8 weeks after treatment.

zh: 可风湿科会诊；平片/MRI按临床演变。
en: Consider rheumatology consultation; radiography/MRI according to clinical evolution.

steps.zh: 先检查质量与治疗史，再确定感染深度、骨髓T1证据和关节受累；保留Va/b/c及VIa/b/c后缀，不能把VI当更高严重度。
steps.en: Check adequacy and treatment history, then infection depth, T1 marrow evidence and joint involvement; preserve Va/b/c and VIa/b/c, and do not treat VI as simply more severe.

steps.zh: 深筋膜T2高信号且厚≥3 mm、远端深筋膜延伸、多间室、无强化及气体支持坏死性筋膜炎，但后者是临床诊断。
steps.en: Deep-fascial T2 hyperintensity/thickness ≥3 mm, remote deep extension, multiple compartments, absent enhancement and gas support necrotizing fasciitis, which remains a clinical diagnosis.

management.zh: 表中药物方向仅概括原文建议，未给具体抗菌药、剂量或疗程；临床团队根据病情和培养执行。
management.en: Medication directions only summarize source recommendations without antibiotic selection, dose or duration; the clinical team manages according to illness and culture.

management.zh: 怀疑坏死性筋膜炎或危急感染不能用建议的6–8周影像复查替代及时临床处理。
management.en: Suspected necrotizing fasciitis/critical infection requires timely clinical action; the optional 6–8-week MRI does not replace it.

cautions.zh: MRI异常和治疗后残余信号不必然等于活动感染，VIb保留不确定性；研究没有0类病例，验证范围需注意。
cautions.en: MRI abnormalities/post-treatment signal do not automatically establish active infection; VIb retains uncertainty. No category-0 cases were included in the study.

cautions.zh: 非感染神经关节病/炎症可模拟感染；完整临床信息和对比检查影响分类。
cautions.en: Noninfectious neuroarthropathy/inflammation may mimic infection; complete clinical context and comparison studies influence classification.

name.zh: 骨髓瘤反应评估和诊断系统
name.en: Myeloma Response Assessment and Diagnosis System

summary.zh: 用于多发性骨髓瘤全身 MRI 的采集、解读和报告指南。
summary.en: Published guidance for acquisition, interpretation and reporting of whole-body MRI in multiple myeloma.

domain.zh: 多发性骨髓瘤全身 MRI 评估
domain.en: Whole-body MRI assessment of multiple myeloma

sources.title: Myeloma Response Assessment and Diagnosis System

title.zh: MY-RADS：骨髓瘤全身MRI与区域应答
title.en: MY-RADS: myeloma whole-body MRI and regional response

scope.zh: 2019年骨髓瘤诊断、负荷和治疗期间区域变化共识；核心临床与全面研究方案。
scope.en: The 2019 consensus for myeloma diagnosis, burden and regional treatment change, using core clinical or comprehensive research protocols.

sourcePages.zh: PDF第3–7页（印刷页7–11）：技术、判读与表1–3；第4页图2浸润模式；第7页表3全部疗效分支及脚注。
sourcePages.en: PDF pp 3–7 (printed pp 7–11): acquisition, interpretation and Tables 1–3; p 4 Fig 2 patterns; p 7 Table 3 all response branches and notes.

purpose.zh: 核心/研究协议覆盖头顶至膝；同时报告旁髓、髓外病变、骨折及后髂嵴取样代表性。
purpose.en: Core/research protocols cover vertex to knees; also report paramedullary/extramedullary disease, fractures and posterior iliac crest sampling representativeness.

purpose.zh: 只对有可检测水信号的组织测ADC；结合T1脂肪和Dixon脂/水图，弥漫病变可取>1 cm²代表ROI。
purpose.en: Measure ADC only where water signal is detectable; correlate with T1 fat and Dixon fat/water images, using a representative ROI >1 cm² for diffuse involvement.

zh: 全脊柱矢状T1及STIR/脂抑T2，层厚4–5 mm，两种方案均有。
en: Whole-spine sagittal T1 and STIR/fat-suppressed T2, 4–5-mm sections in both protocols.

zh: 头顶至膝T1 Dixon，核心轴位或冠状5 mm；研究方案两者均做。脂/水图必需，并生成FF=F/(F+W)×100%。
en: T1 Dixon vertex to knees; core axial or coronal 5 mm; research both. Fat/water images required and FF=F/(F+W)×100%.

zh: 头顶至膝轴位DWI，STIR脂抑，连续5 mm；核心b=50–100和800–900 s/mm²，研究增加500–600；单指数ADC及最高b值3D MIP。
en: Axial DWI vertex to knees, STIR, contiguous 5 mm; core b=50–100 and 800–900 s/mm², research adds 500–600; monoexponential ADC and high-b 3D MIP.

zh: 轴位非脂抑T2核心可选、全面/研究推荐；有症状或特定问题增加局部检查。
en: Axial non-fat-suppressed T2 is optional in core and included in comprehensive/research assessment; add regional imaging for symptoms or specific questions.

zh: 高度可能应答：受累骨髓恢复正常脂肪信号，病灶数量/大小明确下降，弥漫浸润转为局灶并减低负荷，骨病相关软组织减少，出现脂肪点/晕；ADC从≤1400升至>1400 µm²/s，或较基线增加≥40%且高b信号下降、形态稳定或应答。
en: Highly likely responding: restoration of fatty marrow, unequivocal reduction in lesion number/size, diffuse-to-focal change with reduced burden, reduced bone-associated soft tissue and fat-dot/halo signs; ADC rises from ≤1400 to >1400 µm²/s, or increases ≥40% from baseline with lower high-b signal and stable/responding morphology.

zh: 可能应答：改善不足以满足RAC 1，例如轻微缩小/减少；ADC由≤1000升高但仍<1400 µm²/s，或较基线增加>25%且<40%，同时高b信号下降且形态稳定/应答。
en: Likely responding: improvement insufficient for RAC 1, e.g. slight reduction in lesion size/number; ADC increases from ≤1000 but remains <1400 µm²/s, or increases >25% and <40%, with lower high-b signal and stable/responding morphology.

zh: 可能进展：恶化但不满足RAC 5；新灶不确定；大小不变而高b信号增高、ADC<1400 µm²/s；已消失灶再现或曾缩小/稳定灶增大；椎管软组织导致狭窄但无神经症状且不需放疗。
