en: Likely progressing: worsening insufficient for RAC 5; equivocal new lesions; unchanged size but higher high-b signal with ADC <1400 µm²/s; reappearance of resolved lesions or enlargement of previously regressed/stabilized lesions; canal soft tissue causes narrowing without neurologic findings or a need for radiotherapy.

zh: 高度可能进展：MRI证实恶性的新关键骨折/脊髓压迫且需放疗或手术；原正常骨髓中新出现明确局灶/弥漫浸润；数量/大小明确增加；局灶转弥漫；骨病相关软组织新出现/增加；新高b信号区域ADC为600–1000 µm²/s。；表3对新局灶病变写为>5至10 mm。
en: Highly likely progressing: new critical fracture/cord compression confirmed malignant on MRI and requiring radiotherapy or surgery; unequivocal new focal/diffuse infiltration in previously normal marrow; unequivocal growth in lesion size/number; focal-to-diffuse change; new/increasing bone-associated soft tissue; new high-b lesions with ADC 600–1000 µm²/s. Table 3 describes new focal lesions as >5 to 10 mm.

title.zh: 软组织与淋巴结分支（原文表中RECIST 1.1摘要）
title.en: Soft-tissue and nodal branches (source-table RECIST 1.1 summary)

zh: CR为靶病灶消失；PR为最长径总和较基线减少≥30%。RAC 1用明确PR/CR；改善但未达PR归RAC 2。
en: CR is disappearance of target lesions; PR is ≥30% reduction in summed longest diameters from baseline. RAC 1 uses definite PR/CR; improvement below PR is RAC 2.

zh: SD为不足以达PR或PD；PD为最长径总和较治疗以来最低值增加≥20%或出现新灶；恶化未达PD为RAC 4，达到PD为RAC 5。此处保留来源摘要，不替代完整RECIST规范。
en: SD is insufficient change for PR or PD; PD is ≥20% increase in summed longest diameters from treatment nadir or new lesions. Worsening below PD is RAC 4; meeting PD is RAC 5. This retains the source summary, not the full RECIST specification.

zh: 短轴较基线或最低值增长≥5 mm且达到≥1 cm才视为进展。
en: Progression requires ≥5-mm short-axis growth from baseline/nadir and a final short axis ≥1 cm.

zh: 短轴增长≥5 mm且达到≥1.5 cm可视为进展；短轴≥1.5 cm按RECIST 1.1。
en: Progression may be assigned with ≥5-mm short-axis growth and a final short axis ≥1.5 cm; nodes ≥1.5 cm use RECIST 1.1.

zh: 正常、局灶、局灶合并弥漫、弥漫、微结节；每个区域记录模式与RAC，可测最多5个代表灶。
en: Normal, focal, focal-on-diffuse, diffuse and micronodular; document pattern and RAC by region and measure up to five representative lesions.

zh: ≤5 mm记录供监测，不给精确测量；>5 mm且<1 cm、信号符合者记录为局灶活动病，但不强调精确测量；≥1 cm通常可测量。
en: Document lesions ≤5 mm for surveillance without precise measurement; >5 mm and <1 cm with appropriate signal are focal active disease, without precise measurement; ≥1 cm is generally measurable.

zh: 疑似新诊断弥漫病变需骨髓活检确认；未经治疗时ADC>600–700 µm²/s增加信心，但不是独立诊断阈值。
en: Suspected diffuse involvement at new diagnosis requires trephine confirmation; untreated marrow ADC >600–700 µm²/s supports confidence but is not an independent diagnostic cutoff.

zh: 局灶灶>5 mm、高b信号高于肌肉/正常骨髓，ADC高于背景但低于自由液体；弥漫模式为广泛骨髓高b信号高于肌肉。
en: Focal lesions >5 mm have high-b signal above muscle/background marrow and ADC above background but below free fluid; diffuse pattern shows widespread marrow high-b signal above muscle.

zh: 弥漫背景上有更高信号局灶；微结节为≤5 mm广泛小结节，其间正常骨髓保存。
en: Focal-on-diffuse has focal higher-signal lesions on diffuse background; micronodular has widespread tiny nodules ≤5 mm with preserved marrow between.

zh: 旁髓软组织与骨髓病灶直接连续；髓外软组织与骨髓病不连续。
en: Paramedullary soft tissue is directly continuous with marrow disease; extramedullary disease is not.

zh: 正常骨髓通常<600–700、活肿瘤约700–1400、治疗/坏死常≥1400 µm²/s；骨髓瘤细胞、脂肪与正常髓细胞混合比例会改变数值，不能独立诊断。
en: Normal marrow usually <600–700, viable tumor around 700–1400, treated/necrotic disease often ≥1400 µm²/s; proportions of myeloma, fat and myeloid cells alter values and prevent standalone diagnosis.

steps.zh: 按颈/胸/腰椎、骨盆、长骨、颅骨、肋骨及其他区域给RAC，结论说明异质性和需进一步确认的不确定灶。
steps.en: Assign RAC in cervical/thoracic/lumbar spine, pelvis, long bones, skull, ribs and other regions; summarize heterogeneity and equivocal lesions needing confirmation.

steps.zh: RAC 1/2形态与DWI不一致时考虑T1假进展及脂肪骨髓再现，后者未必伴ADC上升。
steps.en: If morphology and DWI disagree in RAC 1/2, consider T1 pseudoprogression and returning fatty marrow, which need not increase ADC.

management.zh: 随访时间与常规血清/骨髓评估相配合；原文不制定所有患者通用的固定扫描间隔。
management.en: Coordinate imaging with routine serum/marrow assessments; the source does not prescribe one fixed scan interval for all patients.

management.zh: 仅凭疑似弥漫浸润判进展时，先排除G-CSF/治疗相关反跳增生，再用生化和/或骨髓取样确认。
management.en: Before diagnosing progression from diffuse infiltration alone, exclude G-CSF/treatment rebound hypercellularity and confirm with biochemistry and/or marrow sampling.

cautions.zh: MY-RADS不是MI-RADS；RAC是影像变化类别，不等同于IMWG实验室完全缓解。仍需研究验证可重复性及预后价值。
cautions.en: MY-RADS is distinct from MI-RADS; imaging RAC is not equivalent to laboratory-based IMWG complete response. Reproducibility and prognostic value require validation.

name.zh: 淋巴结报告和数据系统
name.en: Node Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于肿瘤患者淋巴结 CT、MRI 及超声评估的标准化报告概念；表 2 同时列出不同模态的 Node-RADS 研究。
summary.en: A standardized reporting concept for CT, MRI and ultrasound lymph-node assessment in oncology; table 2 lists Node-RADS research across modalities.

domain.zh: 肿瘤患者淋巴结影像评估

sources.title: Introducing the Node Reporting and Data System 1.0 (Node-RADS)
Ultrasound-based Node-RADS

scope.zh: 癌症患者各部位区域及远处淋巴结的CT/MRI分类，用于基线分期及治疗后评估。2021原文为概念框架，要求独立前瞻性验证；不包括超声、PET或功能MRI计分。
scope.en: CT/MRI classification of regional/distant nodes at any site in cancer patients, at baseline staging and response assessment. The 2021 paper is a conceptual framework requiring independent prospective validation; US, PET and functional MRI are not scoring inputs.

sourcePages.zh: PDF第2–7页；图1–5及报告规则（印刷页6117–6122）。
sourcePages.en: PDF pages 2–7; Figures 1–5 and reporting rules (printed pages 6117–6122).

purpose.zh: CT须静脉增强并采用适当实质期，MRI因软组织对比可不增强；基线覆盖相关区域及可能远处结节，疗效评估覆盖所有基线异常部位。测短轴及任意方向最大径，并比较既往。
purpose.en: CT requires IV contrast with an appropriate parenchymal phase; MRI contrast is not mandatory owing to intrinsic tissue contrast. Cover regional and relevant distant nodal sites at baseline and all baseline abnormal sites for response; measure short axis and greatest diameter in any plane and compare prior imaging.

zh: 一般短轴<10 mm；腹股沟<15 mm；面部、腮腺、耳后、枕部、咽后、颈前、膈脚后、心膈角、肠系膜、闭孔、直肠系膜短轴<5 mm。
en: Usually short axis <10 mm; inguinal <15 mm; facial, parotid, retroauricular, occipital, retropharyngeal, anterior jugular, retrocrural, cardiophrenic, mesenteric, obturator and mesorectal <5 mm.

zh: 超出所在部位正常范围但不达bulk；或与既往相比短轴增加≥2 mm。恰达10、15或5 mm不在各自正常范围内。
en: Above the regional normal range but not bulk, or short-axis increase ≥2 mm versus prior imaging. Exactly 10, 15 or 5 mm is outside the corresponding normal branch.

zh: 任意方向最大径≥30 mm；直接分为Node-RADS 5。
en: Largest diameter ≥30 mm in any dimension; directly Node-RADS 5.

title.zh: 结构分数：每组仅选一项
title.en: Configuration score: one feature per component

zh: 均匀；不均匀；局灶坏死；广泛坏死或任何新坏死
en: Homogeneous; heterogeneous; focal necrosis; gross or any new necrosis

zh: 囊性（HPV阳性颈部鳞癌、甲状腺癌、非精原细胞生殖细胞瘤）；钙化（甲状腺癌）；黏液性结构（黏液腺癌）
内部结构3分，不与坏死等重复加
en: Cystic appearance in HPV-positive neck SCC, thyroid cancer or nonseminomatous germ-cell tumor; calcification in thyroid cancer; mucinous texture in mucinous adenocarcinoma
Texture 3; not added again to other texture findings

zh: 任何形状且脂肪门保留，或肾豆/椭圆且无门；球形且无门
en: Any shape with fatty hilum, or kidney-bean/oval without hilum; spherical without hilum

title.zh: 大小×结构分数的图1矩阵

steps.zh: 先确定正常/增大/bulk；非bulk结节各从内部结构、边缘、形状选一项相加，结构分数0–5，再查矩阵。
steps.en: First determine normal/enlarged/bulk. For nonbulk nodes choose one texture, border and shape feature, sum configuration to 0–5, then use the matrix.

steps.zh: 同一结节组一般报告最高类别结节；若转移数量会改变TNM或治疗，应额外报告数量。按病种区分区域N及远处M，并使用标准结节图谱定位。
steps.en: Generally report the highest-category node per nodal group; also document number when it alters TNM or treatment. Distinguish regional N from distant M for the cancer type and use a standard nodal atlas.

steps.zh: 分区交界结节按淋巴引流方向归属。Node-RADS用于恶性可能性，与RECIST的可测量性目的不同；不能把短轴<15 mm当成低风险。
steps.en: Assign boundary nodes in the direction of lymphatic drainage. Node-RADS assesses malignant involvement whereas RECIST concerns measurable disease; short axis <15 mm does not imply low suspicion.

management.zh: 原文分期报告规则：1/2记N(−)，4/5记N(+)；3按原发分期/组织学判读，缺乏组织学信息则Nx。示例中低级别前列腺癌的3类可N(−)，胰头腺癌的3类可N(+)。
management.en: Source staging-report rule: 1/2 as N(−), 4/5 as N(+); interpret 3 by primary stage/histology, or Nx when histology is unavailable. Examples assign category 3 as N(−) in low-grade prostate cancer and N(+) in pancreatic-head adenocarcinoma.

management.zh: 原文不规定统一活检、随访间隔或治疗；检查目的、组织学、预期播散方式和结果对治疗的影响必须纳入团队讨论。
management.en: No universal biopsy, follow-up interval or therapy is prescribed; integrate examination purpose, histology, expected spread and the impact of results on treatment.

cautions.zh: 1/2不能排除微转移；这是影像分类而不是病理证实。NI-RADS颈部随访算法与此不一致，不应互换。
cautions.en: Categories 1/2 cannot exclude microscopic disease and are not histologic proof. NI-RADS neck-surveillance criteria are not concordant and are not interchangeable.

scope.zh: 颈部淋巴结的独立超声研究提案，不是2021 CT/MRI算法的同一分数。以下按原文表2显示拟议评分，保留该论文内部不一致。
scope.en: A separate cervical-node ultrasound research proposal, not the same score as the 2021 CT/MRI algorithm. The proposed score below follows Table 2 and explicitly retains internal source inconsistencies.

sourcePages.en: PDF pages 2–4 and 6–7; Tables 1–2 (printed pages 170–172, 174–175).

purpose.zh: 测短轴SAD，区别颈二腹肌区与其他区，评估皮质回声、门可见性、门/非门型及减少血流，记录持续时间与已知原发、术后状态。
purpose.en: Measure SAD distinguishing jugulodigastric from other regions; assess cortical echogenicity, hilum visibility, hilar/nonhilar/reduced flow, persistence and known-origin/postoperative status.

zh: 颈二腹肌区<10 mm、其他区<8 mm；颈二腹肌区≥10 mm、其他区≥8 mm；≥16 mm
en: Jugulodigastric <10 mm/other <8 mm; jugulodigastric ≥10 mm/other ≥8 mm; ≥16 mm

zh: 低回声皮质；门不可见；高回声皮质
en: Hypoechoic cortex; invisible hilum; hyperechoic cortex
<2–4 weeks; >2–4 weeks (the source uses a range as its cutoff)
Known origin FNA; unknown origin CNB

zh: 已知原发治疗；未知原发CNB；已知原发术后FNA
en: Known origin treatment; unknown origin CNB; postoperative known origin FNA

steps.zh: 按表2分别记录各项及总分，短轴≥16 mm使用4分而不再叠加较低短轴档。表2未说明高回声皮质与无门同时存在时回声项是叠加还是互斥；不要自行自动化该分支。
steps.en: Record Table 2 components and total; use 4 points rather than also adding the lower SAD tier when SAD ≥16 mm. Table 2 does not specify whether absent hilum and hyperechoic cortex are additive or exclusive within echotexture; do not automate that unresolved branch.

steps.zh: 系数Sj分层和表2简化总分是不同表达。表2路径可作研究性参照，但内部歧义需直接向原文核对。
steps.en: Coefficient Sj strata and the simplified Table 2 total are different representations. The Table 2 pathway is a research reference whose ambiguities require direct source review.

management.zh: 按表2报告类别及其路径；持续>2–4周或怀疑淋巴系统疾病、病因未知的结节，正文强调CNB/组织学的重要性，FNA对恶性类型鉴别有局限。
management.en: Report the Table 2 category and pathway. The text emphasizes CNB/histology for nodes persisting >2–4 weeks, suspected lymphoid disease or unknown origin, and notes FNA limitations in typing malignancy.

cautions.zh: 来源不一致：表1低回声皮质为1分、等回声为4分，而表2低回声0分、高回声3分并加门不可见1分；表1短轴印作≤16，正文>16，表2≥16 mm。此处保留表2，不宣称已解决差异。
cautions.en: Source conflict: Table 1 gives hypoechoic cortex 1 point and isoechoic cortex 4, whereas Table 2 gives hypoechoic cortex 0, hyperechoic cortex 3 and invisible hilum 1; Table 1 prints ≤16, the text >16 and Table 2 ≥16 mm. Table 2 is retained without claiming these differences are resolved.

cautions.zh: Sj分层正文出现重叠11、16、20、25边界及后文方向相反的>11/<25，不能据此实现独立可靠计算；持续时间“2–4周”也不是单一精确界值。
cautions.en: Sj strata overlap at 11, 16, 20 and 25 and later text reverses inequality directions (>11/<25); they cannot support an independently reliable calculator. Persistence stated as 2–4 weeks is not one precise cutoff.

cautions.zh: 新提案需要外部验证；不能把影像V类等同病理确诊或自行替代既定肿瘤管理。
cautions.en: This new proposal requires external validation; imaging category V is not pathologic confirmation and must not independently replace established cancer management.

name.zh: 神经病变评分报告和数据系统
name.en: Neuropathy Score Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于周围神经病变 MRI 的报告指南。
summary.en: A published MRI reporting guideline for peripheral neuropathy.

domain.zh: 周围神经病变 MRI 评估

sources.title: Neuropathy Score Reporting and Data System

title.en: NS-RADS: peripheral nerve and muscle MRI classification

scope.zh: 依据所附综述的神经损伤、肿瘤、卡压、弥漫病变和神经干预后分型；肌肉去神经模式单独记录，不形成统一相加分数。
scope.en: The supplied review's classification of nerve injury, neoplasia, entrapment, diffuse neuropathy and targeted post-intervention change; muscle denervation is recorded separately without one additive score.

sourcePages.zh: PDF第2–4页：技术、0/U/NOS、肌肉与I/N；第5–6页N/E；第7页表1损伤（横向表）；第9–11页D/PI及限制。
sourcePages.en: PDF pp 2–4: technique, 0/U/NOS, muscle and I/N; pp 5–6 N/E; p 7 landscape Table 1 injury; pp 9–11 D/PI and limitations.

purpose.zh: 完整检查需覆盖神经病变的T1/PD及脂抑T2，至少一个垂直于神经长轴平面；高分辨率2D层厚通常2.5–3.5 mm，3D可选。
purpose.en: A complete study covers nerve pathology with T1/PD and fat-suppressed T2 in at least one plane orthogonal to the nerve; high-resolution 2D sections usually 2.5–3.5 mm, optional 3D.

purpose.zh: 结合症状、神经查体、神经传导/EMG及超声；与对侧或邻近正常神经比较信号和口径。
purpose.en: Correlate symptoms, neurologic examination, conduction/EMG and ultrasound; compare signal/caliber with contralateral or adjacent normal nerves.

zh: 缺必要序列/覆盖不完整；2周内近期补充序列可使检查完整，再赋具体类。
en: Required sequences/coverage missing; complementary imaging within 2 weeks can complete the study before assigning a specific class.

zh: 视野内神经与肌肉正常。
en: Unremarkable nerves and muscles in the field of view.

zh: 病史不足、影像不定、原因不明的神经信号/口径改变；肌肉视野未含客观无力区，或去神经与肌病不能区分。
en: Insufficient history, indeterminate imaging or unexplained nerve signal/caliber change; muscle field excludes objectively weak territory or denervation cannot be distinguished from myopathy.

zh: 水肿样信号，无明确脂肪替代/萎缩。
en: Edema-like signal without established fatty replacement/atrophy.

zh: 水肿样信号并少量脂肪替代/轻度萎缩；按主要改变和整体模式判断。
en: Edema-like signal with minimal fatty replacement/mild atrophy; interpret the dominant change and overall pattern.

zh: 部分/完全脂肪替代、中重度萎缩；完全脂肪替代即使无萎缩或有肥大也归M3。
en: Partial/complete fatty replacement and moderate/severe atrophy; complete fatty replacement belongs to M3 even without atrophy or with hypertrophy.

zh: 髓鞘损伤/神经传导阻滞，轴突连续；局灶均一T2升高，可少见，通常无肌肉去神经。
en: Myelin injury/conduction block with intact axons; focal homogeneous T2 increase, often transient/uncommon on MRI and usually without muscle denervation.

zh: 轴突变性而束结构保持；T2升高及轻度增粗（表1约<50–100%的直径变化），无内部纤维化。
en: Axonal degeneration with preserved fascicular architecture; increased T2 and mild thickening (Table 1 diameter change <50–100%), without internal fibrosis.

zh: 神经内膜损伤、束结构破坏，无神经瘤；T2升高与中重度增粗（直径>100%）、无断裂。
en: Endoneurial injury with disturbed fascicular architecture but no neuroma; higher T2 and moderate/severe thickening (diameter >100%), without discontinuity.

zh: 神经束膜损伤，部分神经残存并连续性神经瘤；局灶异质T2、神经内/周纤维化。
en: Perineurial injury, partial remaining distal nerve and neuroma-in-continuity; focal heterogeneous T2 and intra-/perineural fibrosis.

zh: 神经外膜及全层断裂，神经间隙可见液体/纤维组织及断端神经瘤。
en: Epineurial/full-thickness transection with a visible nerve gap containing fluid/fibrosis and end-bulb neuroma.

title.en: N, E, D and PI branches

zh: N1确定良性神经肿瘤：靶征/束征/尾征、清楚边界、无周围水肿/坏死；N2可能良性，缺部分典型征，可囊变/出血/不规则边缘但仍需综合判断。
en: N1 definitely benign neural tumor with target/fascicular/tail signs, clear margins and no edema/necrosis; N2 probably benign but lacking some typical signs, potentially cystic/hemorrhagic/irregular, requiring integrated assessment.

zh: N3可能恶性：快速增大、坏死、异质强化、周围水肿/出血、浸润或限制扩散；N4术后改变合并复发肿瘤。
en: N3 probably malignant with rapid growth, necrosis, heterogeneous enhancement, edema/hemorrhage, invasion or restriction; N4 postoperative change with recurrent tumor.

zh: 轻卡压：病灶/隧道处轻度局灶T2增高；轻微无症状信号也可生理。
en: Mild entrapment: mild focal T2 increase at lesion/tunnel; mild asymptomatic signal can be physiologic.

zh: 中度卡压：较高局灶/短段T2及近端增粗、卡压点变扁。
en: Moderate entrapment: higher focal/short-segment T2, proximal enlargement and flattening at entrapment.

zh: 重度卡压：近端及远端增粗、卡压点变扁，亮–黑–亮/沙漏征；神经根卡压可伴下游周围神经异常。
en: Severe entrapment: proximal and distal enlargement with focal flattening, bright–black–bright/hourglass sign; root entrapment can involve downstream peripheral nerves.

zh: 长段弥漫T2增高，可伴增粗/肌去神经：单神经D1，多神经D2；不是轻/重等级。
en: Long-segment diffuse T2 increase with optional enlargement/denervation: one nerve D1, multiple nerves D2; this is not mild/severe grading.

zh: 神经靶向干预后接近正常，轻局灶T2/增粗，较前改善。
en: Near-normal after targeted nerve intervention, mild focal T2/enlargement and improvement from prior.

zh: 可能持续神经病：持续局灶短/长段T2增高、增粗和/或走行不规则。
en: Possible persistent neuropathy: continuing focal short-/long-segment T2 increase, enlargement and/or course irregularity.

zh: 明确持续/恶化：T2/增粗增加、瘢痕性之字形，或新邻近神经/医源性损伤；可伴未完全松解、瘢痕/血肿。
en: Definite persistence/worsening: greater T2/enlargement, zig-zag scarring or new adjacent/iatrogenic nerve injury; incomplete release, scar or hematoma may support it.

steps.zh: 先判完整性与U/NOS；神经选择I/N/E/D/PI分型，另给肌肉M类；无统一总分。
steps.en: Determine completeness and U/NOS, choose I/N/E/D/PI for the nerve and a separate M class for muscle; there is no global summed score.

steps.zh: 短段一般2–6 cm，长段多>6–12 cm；神经信号相对肌肉/静脉，口径相对对侧/邻近神经。
steps.en: Short segment generally spans 2–6 cm, long segment often >6–12 cm; compare signal with muscle/veins and caliber with contralateral/adjacent nerves.

steps.zh: PI仅用于纠正神经病变的靶向干预；非神经手术导致的医源性损伤用I，神经肿瘤切除后病变可用PI。
steps.en: PI applies to interventions aimed at correcting nerve pathology; injury during unrelated surgery uses I, whereas post-neural-tumor resection neuropathy may use PI.

management.zh: 结合EMG/临床确认病因；N1可观察，N2随访或活检，N3需及时专科介入；本文未给各类固定治疗/复查日程。
management.en: Confirm etiology with clinical/EMG correlation; N1 can be observed, N2 followed or biopsied, N3 requires prompt specialist action; no fixed treatment/follow-up schedule is supplied.

management.zh: NOS可建议临床、神经生理或诊断性神经周围注射评估；本页不提供手术或注射处方。
management.en: NOS may prompt clinical, neurophysiologic or diagnostic perineural-injection assessment; this page provides no surgical/injection prescription.

cautions.zh: 原文N类ADC排印混杂：正文写1.1 mm²/s但引用研究为约1.0×10⁻³ mm²/s；本页不把疑似漏写指数的值作为可执行阈值。低ADC提示限于NF相关恶变研究，不能普遍套用于施万瘤。
cautions.en: N-category ADC typography is inconsistent: prose says 1.1 mm²/s whereas cited work uses about 1.0×10⁻³ mm²/s; this guide does not turn a likely missing exponent into an operational cutoff. Evidence concerns NF-associated malignant change and cannot be generalized to schwannoma.

cautions.zh: 肌肉非特异斑片、多灶/双侧并出血或筋膜水肿提示其他肌病；原文M2/M3脂肪替代描述有重叠，需结合整体模式。框架以专家共识为主。
cautions.en: Patchy/multifocal/bilateral muscle change with hemorrhage or fascial edema may indicate myopathy; source M2/M3 fat descriptions overlap and require pattern interpretation. The framework is largely expert consensus.

name.zh: 肿瘤相关发现报告和数据系统
name.en: Oncologically Relevant Findings Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于肿瘤筛查全身 MRI 的采集、解读和报告指南。
summary.en: Published guidance for acquisition, interpretation and reporting of whole-body MRI for cancer screening.

domain.zh: 肿瘤筛查全身 MRI

sources.title: Oncologically Relevant Findings Reporting and Data System

title.zh: ONCO-RADS：按人群风险管理全身MRI发现
title.en: ONCO-RADS: risk-contextual management of whole-body MRI findings

scope.zh: 2021年无症状一般人群及癌症高风险人群全身MRI癌筛查报告共识；类别与人群背景共同决定后续路径。
scope.en: The 2021 WB-MRI cancer-screening reporting consensus for asymptomatic general and higher-risk populations; category and population risk jointly determine management.

sourcePages.zh: PDF第3页表1协议；第5页表2假象；第6页表3报告模板；第7–8页表4–6区域示例；第11页图3全部风险管理分支。
sourcePages.en: PDF p 3 Table 1 protocol; p 5 Table 2 pitfalls; p 6 Table 3 reporting; pp 7–8 Tables 4–6 regional examples; p 11 Fig 3 all management branches.

purpose.zh: 高风险标准方案头顶至足（约50分钟），一般人群简化方案头顶至大腿中段（约30分钟）；覆盖近端上肢，按遗传风险定制。
purpose.en: Standard higher-risk protocol covers vertex to feet (~50 minutes); general-population short protocol vertex to midthighs (~30 minutes); include proximal upper limbs and customize to inherited risk.

purpose.zh: 脊柱STIR、全身T1 Dixon脂/水与FF、非脂抑T2、DWI b=50–100及800–1000 s/mm²/ADC/MIP；脑FLAIR、肺短TE<1.5 ms、<3 mm T1 GRE；全脊柱T1只在标准方案。
purpose.en: Spinal STIR, whole-body T1 Dixon fat/water/FF, non-fat-suppressed T2, DWI b=50–100 and 800–1000 s/mm²/ADC/MIP; brain FLAIR and lung T1 GRE TE<1.5 ms, sections <3 mm; whole-spine T1 in standard protocol only.

zh: 正常发现；不是检查不完整类别。
en: Normal finding; this is not an incomplete-examination category.

zh: 高度可能良性：典型肝/脾血管瘤、骨岛/愈合骨折、脂肪瘤；肺结节<6 mm。
en: Benign highly likely: typical hepatic/splenic hemangioma, bone island/healed fracture, lipoma; lung nodule <6 mm.

zh: 可能良性：无特异征骨/软组织病变；孤立肝结节≥10 mm可能FNH/腺瘤；肺结节6–8 mm；胰囊肿≤2.5 cm。
en: Benign likely: nonspecific bone/soft-tissue findings; solitary liver nodule ≥10 mm possibly FNH/adenoma; lung nodule 6–8 mm; pancreatic cyst ≤2.5 cm.

zh: 可能恶性：可疑脑/骨/软组织或实性脏器灶；肺结节>8 mm；胰囊肿有令人担忧征象（≥3 cm、厚壁、壁结节、主胰管>7 mm）。
en: Malignancy likely: suspicious brain/bone/soft-tissue or solid-organ lesion; lung nodule >8 mm; pancreatic cyst with worrisome features (≥3 cm, thick wall, mural nodule, main duct >7 mm).

zh: 高度可能恶性：侵袭性脑、甲状腺、肺、实性脏器、骨或软组织灶；胰囊肿高危征如实性成分、主胰管>10 mm或胆总管扩张。
en: Malignancy highly likely: aggressive brain, thyroid, lung, solid-organ, bone or soft-tissue lesions; pancreatic-cyst high-risk signs such as solid component, main duct >10 mm or common bile duct dilation.

zh: 与肿瘤无明确关系但对健康重要的发现另列，如主动脉瘤、气胸、出血/脑积水；可由肿瘤导致的骨折须归类。
en: List health-relevant non-oncologic findings separately, e.g. aneurysm, pneumothorax, hemorrhage/hydrocephalus; a potentially tumor-related fracture requires categorization.

zh: 癌概率低：不需针对该发现随访。
en: Low likelihood of cancer: no follow-up for that finding.

zh: 中等概率：主动随访，通过其他特定影像/检查澄清发现。
en: Intermediate likelihood: active follow-up with specific imaging/tests to clarify the finding.

zh: 高概率：进一步检查，可结合活检。
en: High likelihood: further investigation with or without biopsy.

zh: 中等风险路径：依该风险综合征指南继续随访，可适时重复全身MRI。
en: Intermediate pathway: guideline-based follow-up for the risk syndrome, including repeat WB-MRI at appropriate timing.

zh: 高风险路径：进一步检查，可结合活检；高风险类别3不是一般人群类别3的同一路径。
en: High pathway: further investigation with or without biopsy; higher-risk category 3 differs from general-population category 3.

title.zh: 区域表的其他量化示例（须按人群风险调整）
title.en: Additional quantified regional examples (adapt to population risk)

zh: 无可疑特征结节：年龄<35岁时<1 cm、≥35岁时<1.5 cm列2类；达到相应尺寸列3类；实性/可疑或侵袭征象需更高类。
en: Nonsuspicious nodules are category 2 if <1 cm at age <35 or <1.5 cm at age ≥35; reaching those sizes is category 3; solid/suspicious/aggressive findings require higher categorization.

zh: 囊肿/出血囊肿<30 mm列2类；复杂囊肿或出血囊肿>30 mm列3类；实性或有实性成分可疑4类，侵袭征5类。
en: Cyst/hemorrhagic cyst <30 mm is listed as category 2; complex cyst or hemorrhagic cyst >30 mm as 3; suspicious solid lesions/solid components as 4, aggressive features as 5.

zh: 2类：绝经后单纯囊肿≤3 cm，绝经前单纯/出血囊肿≤5 cm；超过这些阈值列3类。单纯囊肿≥10 cm、实性组织、厚不规则隔/乳头及不同信号分房等可列4类。
en: Category 2: simple cyst ≤3 cm postmenopause or simple/hemorrhagic cyst ≤5 cm premenopause; larger lesions are listed as 3. A simple cyst ≥10 cm, solid tissue, thick irregular septa/papillae or locules with differing signal may be 4.

zh: BPH、典型肌瘤/纤维瘤、旁卵巢囊肿等为良性例；子宫内膜局灶增厚、前列腺外周带限制扩散和T2低信号、结直肠可疑灶列4类，侵袭征列5类。
en: BPH, typical leiomyoma/fibroma and paraovarian cyst are benign examples; focal endometrial thickening, peripheral-zone prostate restriction/T2 hypointensity or suspicious colorectal findings are listed as 4, aggressive lesions as 5.

steps.zh: 先声明筛查指征和一般/高风险背景，再按头、颈、胸、腹、盆、骨及四肢逐灶描述和给1–5类。
steps.en: State screening indication and general/higher-risk context, then describe and categorize findings in head, neck, chest, abdomen, pelvis, bones and limbs.

steps.zh: 类别阈值须适应癌症患病率；区域表为典型示例，并非跨器官统一恶性概率公式。
steps.en: Adapt categorization to cancer prevalence; regional tables are illustrative examples, not a cross-organ malignancy formula.

steps.zh: 说明技术质量、伪影、协议偏离、与前片比较和需处理的其他重要发现；形成清晰整体结论。
steps.en: Document quality, artifacts, protocol deviations, comparisons and other actionable health findings, then provide a clear overall conclusion.

management.zh: 按上表风险分支和具体综合征指南制定后续，原文不规定所有类别通用固定月份；类别不直接开具治疗。
management.en: Use population-risk branches and syndrome-specific guidance; no fixed month interval applies universally and categories do not prescribe treatment.

cautions.zh: 本页描述已有筛查体系，不代表建议所有无症状一般人群接受全身MRI；MRI可能漏检低水信号/小病灶，DWI高信号可有良性解释。
cautions.en: This describes the screening framework without recommending WB-MRI for every asymptomatic person; low-water/small lesions may be missed and high DWI signal can have benign explanations.

cautions.zh: 针对遗传副神经节瘤/嗜铬细胞瘤综合征原文可省脑及下肢；其他特定高风险状态可能需增强脑/局部专用影像。
cautions.en: The source allows omitting brain/lower limbs for hereditary paraganglioma/pheochromocytoma syndromes; other high-risk states may need enhanced brain or dedicated regional imaging.

name.zh: 肿瘤反应报告和数据系统
name.en: Oncologic Response Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 面向肿瘤治疗反应的标准化报告建议。
summary.en: A published recommendation for standardized oncologic treatment-response reporting.

domain.zh: 肿瘤治疗反应影像报告

sources.title: Oncologic Response Reporting and Data System

title.zh: OR-RADS：肿瘤应答的定性报告词汇

scope.zh: 2022年MSK社论提出并内部试用的报告语言体系，用于明确影像疾病变化，不是RECIST数值算法。
scope.en: A reporting lexicon proposed and internally piloted in the 2022 MSK editorial, describing qualitative change rather than a numeric RECIST algorithm.

sourcePages.zh: PDF第1–2页正文；第2页应答图、表1确信度词汇和表2数量词汇。
sourcePages.en: PDF pp 1–2 prose; p 2 response diagram, Table 1 certainty lexicon and Table 2 numbering lexicon.

purpose.zh: 在可比较的连续肿瘤影像中判断整体负荷、器官间/内异质变化、新灶确定性，并清楚表述。
purpose.en: Compare serial oncologic imaging for overall burden, inter-/intra-organ heterogeneous change and certainty of new lesions.

purpose.zh: 应答类别、诊断确信度与病灶数量词汇分别说明不同维度，不彼此相加。
purpose.en: Response category, diagnostic certainty and lesion-count language represent separate dimensions and are not added.

zh: 影像无疾病证据，例如根治性术后未见肿瘤。
en: No evidence of disease at imaging, e.g. no tumor after curative-intent surgery.

zh: 疾病无变化；原文刻意不用RECIST的stable，后者可涵盖一定增减。
en: Unchanged disease; intentionally distinguished from RECIST stable disease, which allows some increase/decrease.

zh: 同一器官内和/或不同器官间同时出现明确增加和减少，为混合应答。
en: Mixed response with unequivocal increases and decreases within the same organ and/or between organs.

zh: 新影像发现可能进展但仍不确定，例如转移与脓肿不能区分；保留不确定性，不直接判明确进展。
en: Equivocal progression: new findings may represent progression but remain uncertain, e.g. metastasis versus abscess; do not declare definite progression.

title.zh: 配套确信度与数量词汇

zh: unlikely <10%；less likely约25%；possibly约50%；suspicious for/probably约75%；consistent with >90%。这是语言对应估计，不是影像模型概率。
en: Unlikely <10%; less likely about 25%; possibly about 50%; suspicious for/probably about 75%; consistent with >90%. These are lexicon estimates, not model-derived probabilities.
Few 2–5; multiple 6–20; numerous >20; the source recommends avoiding innumerable.

zh: RECIST PR/PD的−30%/+20%仅用于解释stable与unchanged的差别，不是OR-1/2/4/5的分界。
en: RECIST PR/PD thresholds −30%/+20% only explain stable versus unchanged; they do not define boundaries between OR-1/2/4/5.

steps.zh: 比较疾病范围并区分减少/轻减/不变/轻增/增加；无疾病、混合和不确定进展用专门分支。
steps.en: Compare disease extent and distinguish decreased/slightly decreased/unchanged/slightly increased/increased; use separate branches for absent disease, mixed response and equivocal progression.

steps.zh: 新病灶应排除技术或模态差异及非肿瘤解释，仍不确定时明确OR-E。
steps.en: Check new lesions for technique/modality differences and non-tumor explanations; use OR-E if uncertainty remains.

management.zh: 该词汇用于减少沟通歧义和支持肿瘤团队决策；文章未提供固定复查、活检或更换治疗算法。
management.en: The lexicon reduces communication ambiguity and supports oncology decisions; the article supplies no fixed follow-up, biopsy or treatment-switch algorithm.

cautions.zh: 轻度与明显变化没有量化阈值；不可自行补入RECIST切点。该文为社论/内部试用经验而非普适验证指南。
cautions.en: Slight versus larger change has no numeric cutoff; do not insert RECIST thresholds. This is an editorial/internal pilot, not a universally validated guideline.

name.zh: 骨性肿瘤报告和数据系统
name.en: Osseous Tumor Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于骨肿瘤 MRI 的多阅片者验证分级系统。
summary.en: A published multireader-validated MRI classification system for osseous tumors.

domain.zh: 骨肿瘤 MRI 评估

sources.title: Osseous Tumor Reporting and Data System

title.en: OT-RADS: osseous-tumor MRI classification and management

scope.zh: 2021年多阅片者回顾研究提出的MRI骨肿瘤0–VI分类，恶性概率区间是框架预设，而非各类独立验证的个体风险。
scope.en: MRI osseous-tumor classes 0–VI from the 2021 retrospective multireader study; probability ranges are framework definitions rather than individually validated personal risk estimates.

sourcePages.zh: PDF第2页表1与完整MRI定义；第3–6页表2肿瘤特征；第7页III–VI及ADC注意；第8页表3研究采集协议。
sourcePages.en: PDF p 2 Table 1 and complete-MRI definition; pp 3–6 Table 2 tumor features; p 7 III–VI and ADC caveats; p 8 Table 3 study acquisition.

purpose.zh: 至少一平面全肿瘤覆盖的T1、脂抑T2或STIR、增强脂抑T1；缺任一为不完整，可与2周内补充/近期检查合用。
purpose.en: Cover the whole tumor in at least one plane on T1, fat-suppressed T2/STIR and postcontrast fat-suppressed T1; missing any is incomplete, but complementary recent imaging within 2 weeks can complete it.

purpose.zh: 平片/CT补充骨基质、边界、皮质和骨膜；DWI/ADC及化学位移可辅助，但非必需序列。
purpose.en: Radiography/CT supplement matrix, margins, cortex and periosteum; DWI/ADC and chemical shift are helpful but not mandatory.

zh: 不完整/不可诊断；恶性概率不适用，补充检查或等待前片。
en: Incomplete/nondiagnostic; probability not applicable; obtain additional imaging or prior studies.

zh: 未见病灶，恶性概率近0%；无需影像随访。
en: No lesion; malignancy essentially 0%; no imaging follow-up.

zh: 确定良性，近0%；由临床团队决定随访/处理。典型脂肪瘤、单纯骨囊肿、无实性成分ABC、骨样骨瘤等。
en: Definitely benign, essentially 0%; follow-up/care per clinical team. Typical lipoma, simple cyst, aneurysmal bone cyst without solid tissue, osteoid osteoma, etc.

zh: 可能良性，≤2%；原文建议3、6、12、24个月随访；消失或明显消退可缩短。
en: Probably benign, ≤2%; source recommends follow-up at 3, 6, 12 and 24 months, shorter if resolved or markedly regressed.

zh: 不确定/可疑恶性，>2%且<50%；组织诊断或4–6周短期随访；取样阴性/不确定后可按III继续监测。
en: Indeterminate/suspicious, >2% and <50%; tissue diagnosis or short follow-up at 4–6 weeks; negative/indeterminate sampling may be followed as III.

zh: 高度提示恶性，≥50%；需组织诊断。
en: Highly suggestive of malignancy, ≥50%; tissue diagnosis.

zh: 活检证实或瘤床复发恶性；按病情手术或进一步治疗，概率区间不适用。
en: Biopsy-proven or recurrent tumor-bed malignancy; surgery/further care as clinically appropriate, with no probability interval.

title.zh: 辅助形态与ADC（非独立切点）
title.en: Supportive morphology and ADC (not standalone cutoffs)

zh: 典型良性脂肪/液体或基质及边界；骨软骨瘤软骨帽<1.5 cm，偶发小软骨瘤通常<4–5 cm且内膜凹陷≤皮质50%；可无强化或<2 mm薄环/隔强化。
en: Characteristic benign fat/fluid/matrix and margins; osteochondroma cap <1.5 cm; incidental small enchondroma usually <4–5 cm with scalloping ≤50% cortical thickness; absent or <2-mm thin rim/septal enhancement may occur.

zh: II低细胞/软骨样病灶常见较高ADC（>1.5–3.0×10⁻³ mm²/s）；III一般约1.2–2.0×10⁻³。GCT可仅0.8–1.4×10⁻³，良恶性黏液样灶均可高ADC。
en: II low-cellularity/chondroid lesions often have high ADC (source >1.5–3.0×10⁻³ mm²/s); III generally ~1.2–2.0×10⁻³. GCT can be 0.8–1.4×10⁻³, and benign/malignant myxoid lesions can both have high ADC.

zh: IV可混杂实性信号、深内膜凹陷>50%，包括某些低级别软骨肿瘤；V常实性强化及限制扩散，ADC往往<1.1–1.2×10⁻³，但黏液样肉瘤可例外。
en: IV can show mixed solid signal and deep scalloping >50%, including some low-grade cartilaginous tumors; V often has solid enhancement/restriction and ADC <1.1–1.2×10⁻³, with myxoid-sarcoma exceptions.

zh: 瘤床实性结节/残余或增长肿块，强化/扩散与原肿瘤类似支持复发；原文报告ADC可<1.3–1.4×10⁻³ mm²/s，仍需结合基线。
en: A solid nodule/residual or growing tumor-bed mass with enhancement/diffusion resembling the original tumor supports recurrence; source ADC can be <1.3–1.4×10⁻³ mm²/s but requires baseline comparison.

steps.zh: 先判断检查完整性和是否已证实/复发，再综合典型形态、临床及辅助扩散给予类别；没有加分公式。
steps.en: Check completeness and known/recurrent malignancy first, then combine characteristic morphology, clinical context and supportive diffusion; no additive formula exists.

steps.zh: ADC受肿瘤基质和细胞构成影响，不能以单一阈值替代组织学或形态分级。
steps.en: Matrix and cellular composition affect ADC; one cutoff cannot replace morphology or histology.

management.zh: 随访与活检路径保留原文表1，病变消退、采样结果及临床情况可改变安排；治疗由临床团队决定。
management.en: Retain Table 1 follow-up/biopsy pathways, adapted to regression, sampling and clinical context; treatment remains a clinical-team decision.

cautions.zh: 概率段由专家共识参考BI-RADS设置，需进一步验证；不同于机器学习BTI-RADS 2.0或SSR偶发单发骨病变Bone-RADS。
cautions.en: Probability bands were consensus definitions modeled on BI-RADS and require validation; distinguish from ML BTI-RADS 2.0 and SSR incidental solitary-lesion Bone-RADS.

cautions.zh: 来源部分肿瘤名称/ADC范围是示例而非穷尽规则；不能仅凭病种名称自动分类。
cautions.en: Tumor names/ADC ranges are illustrative rather than exhaustive; do not classify automatically by tumor name.

name.zh: 颈动脉斑块报告和数据系统
name.en: Carotid Plaque Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于颈动脉斑块相关脑血管事件风险分类的发表系统。
summary.en: A published classification system for carotid-plaque-related cerebrovascular-event risk.

domain.zh: 颈动脉疾病与脑血管事件风险评估
domain.en: Carotid disease and cerebrovascular-event risk assessment

sources.title: Carotid Plaque Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 2024年颈动脉斑块易损性框架，以每条血管最相关／最高风险所见报告1–4及亚类；独立补充狭窄程度，不替代NASCET。
scope.en: A 2024 carotid plaque-vulnerability framework assigning each vessel its most clinically relevant/highest-risk finding as 1–4 and subclasses; complements rather than replaces NASCET stenosis.

sourcePages.en: PDF pages 3–12 (64–73); Table 1, Central Illustration and Figures 1–9.

purpose.zh: 按模态可见性识别最大壁厚MWT、脂质坏死核心LRNC、纤维帽FC、斑内出血IPH、溃疡、帽破裂、腔内血栓。MWT在垂直长轴的轴位图测最大线性厚度，含动脉壁及钙化／非钙化斑块。
purpose.en: Assess modality-visible MWT, lipid-rich necrotic core (LRNC), fibrous cap (FC), intraplaque hemorrhage (IPH), ulceration, cap rupture and luminal thrombus. Measure maximal linear wall thickness perpendicular to the vessel long axis, including arterial wall and calcified/noncalcified plaque.

purpose.zh: 狭窄%=（正常远端ICA径−狭窄处最小ICA径）／正常远端ICA径×100；每侧另报模态、类别和MWT。
purpose.en: Stenosis % = (normal distal ICA diameter − narrowest stenotic ICA diameter) / normal distal ICA diameter ×100; separately report side, modality, category and MWT.

zh: 正常血管壁，无动脉粥样硬化；归因性同侧脑血管事件风险无。
en: Normal wall without atherosclerosis; no attributed ipsilateral cerebrovascular-event risk.

zh: MWT<3 mm；可有壁增厚、LRNC或钙化，但无溃疡、IPH、帽破裂或腔内血栓。
en: MWT <3 mm; wall thickening, LRNC or calcium may occur, but no ulceration, IPH, cap rupture or luminal thrombus.

zh: MWT≥3 mm或愈合溃疡，无4类复杂征象；可进一步细分。
en: MWT ≥3 mm or healed ulceration, without category 4 complicated features; further subclassification may be possible.

zh: MWT≥3 mm，中到大LRNC及厚、完整FC，无复杂征象。
en: MWT ≥3 mm, moderate/large LRNC and thick intact FC without complicated features.

zh: MWT≥3 mm，中到大LRNC及薄而完整FC，无复杂征象；可直接看见薄帽，或有LRNC而看不到厚完整帽时推断。
en: MWT ≥3 mm, moderate/large LRNC and thin intact FC, without complicated features; a thin cap can be visualized or inferred when LRNC is present without a visible thick intact cap.

zh: 溃疡不论壁厚，但无IPH、可见FC破裂或腔内血栓；此处指既往内容物排出后愈合的表面凹腔。
en: Ulceration regardless of wall thickness, with no IPH, visible FC disruption or luminal thrombus; refers here to a surface cavity following extrusion/healing.

zh: 不论壁厚，只要IPH、FC破裂或腔内血栓任一存在。
en: Any IPH, FC rupture or luminal thrombus, independent of wall thickness.

zh: 4a：IPH；4b：FC破裂，常伴腔面附近出血；4c：腔内血栓，可伴IPH或帽破裂。
en: 4a: IPH; 4b: ruptured FC, often with juxtaluminal hemorrhage; 4c: intraluminal thrombus, possibly with IPH or cap rupture.

zh: 分别列钙化、新生血管、炎症、正性重构、负荷及狭窄进展；可选，不改主类别。
en: List calcium, neovascularization, inflammation, positive remodeling, burden and stenosis progression; optional and do not determine the main category.

zh: L：诊断受限，如运动、金属或钙化blooming；Stent：支架；CEA：既往颈动脉内膜剥脱。
en: L: limited diagnostic study, e.g. motion, metal or calcium blooming; Stent: carotid stent; CEA: prior carotid endarterectomy.

steps.zh: 优先识别4类复杂征象，再判断3c溃疡和MWT<3／≥3 mm；每侧报告狭窄／模态 Plaque-RADS类别／MWT／辅助征象／修饰符。多模态时均列出，产生最高分的模态在前。
steps.en: Identify category 4 complications first, then 3c ulceration and MWT <3/≥3 mm. Report each side as stenosis / modality Plaque-RADS grade / MWT / ancillary findings / modifiers. List all modalities, with the one producing the highest grade first.

steps.zh: CT的低衰减核心不等于已排除IPH；若所用模态不能排除相关升级，注明考虑MRI等进一步检查，而不是假定没有复杂斑块。
steps.en: A low-attenuation core on CT does not exclude IPH. If the modality cannot exclude a relevant upgrade, recommend consideration of further MRI or other assessment rather than assuming no complication.

management.zh: 原文没有按Plaque-RADS级别规定手术、抗栓或复查间隔；需结合症状、狭窄、其他风险因素与模态可靠性。该分级提供补充风险信息。
management.en: The paper does not prescribe grade-specific surgery, antithrombotic treatment or surveillance intervals; integrate symptoms, stenosis, other risks and modality reliability. The score supplies additional risk information.

cautions.zh: 薄FC成像准确性的证据有限；所有模态并不能识别所有亚类，无法细分时保留主类别并说明。体系初始研究含各模态100条血管的一致性评估，不是治疗阈值验证。
cautions.en: Evidence for accurate thin-FC imaging is limited. Not every modality resolves every subclass; retain the main category with an explanation if subclassification is unavailable. Initial work included agreement assessment of 100 vessels per modality, rather than validation of treatment thresholds.

name.zh: 前列腺特异膜抗原影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Prostate-Specific Membrane Antigen Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于 PSMA 靶向 PET 影像解读和临床决策框架的修订版本。
summary.en: A revised published framework for PSMA-targeted PET interpretation and clinical decision-making.

domain.zh: PSMA 靶向 PET 影像

sources.title: Prostate-Specific Membrane Antigen Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: PSMA靶向PET/CT前列腺癌病灶确信度，包括治疗后5T；依据所附综述2.0，保留其临床背景升级规则。
scope.en: Lesion confidence on PSMA-targeted PET/CT for prostate cancer, including treated category 5T, following version 2.0 in the supplied review and its contextual upgrades.

sourcePages.zh: PDF第3–8页：2.0改变、表2及1–5T；第10页表3常规影像相关与示踪剂局限。
sourcePages.en: PDF pp 3–8: version 2.0 changes, Table 2 and categories 1–5T; p 10 Table 3 conventional correlates and tracer limitations.

purpose.zh: 比较摄取、CT结构及前列腺癌分布；记录示踪剂、PSA/分期、既往治疗和对比检查。
purpose.en: Correlate uptake, CT anatomy and prostate-cancer distribution; document tracer, PSA/stage, prior therapy and comparison studies.

purpose.zh: 不确定病灶结合局部MRI、活检或随访；阴性摄取不排除低PSMA表达或其他肿瘤。
purpose.en: Use targeted MRI, biopsy or follow-up for indeterminate lesions; absent uptake does not exclude low-PSMA disease or another malignancy.

zh: 组织学或典型解剖表现确定良性，不论摄取；原1A/1B合并。包括生理神经节、典型血管瘤/腺瘤。
en: Definitively benign by histology or pathognomonic anatomy regardless of uptake; former 1A/1B are merged. Includes physiologic ganglia and typical hemangioma/adenoma.

zh: 非典型转移部位低水平摄取，倾向良性但无组织学或特异结构证实；例如对称非典型淋巴结、退变/愈合骨折。
en: Low-level uptake in an atypical metastatic site, likely benign without histologic or definitive anatomic proof; e.g. symmetric atypical nodes, degeneration/healing fracture.

zh: 前列腺癌典型软组织（主要淋巴结）不确定摄取；进一步检查或随访。
en: Equivocal uptake in typical prostate-cancer soft tissue, primarily nodes; further evaluation or follow-up.

zh: 骨病灶摄取不确定，未确诊但位置/影像不排斥前列腺癌，亦可无CT对应。
en: Equivocal bone-lesion uptake without definite diagnosis but a site/pattern compatible with prostate cancer, including no CT correlate.

zh: 强摄取而分布对前列腺癌高度非典型；考虑其他恶性或良性病，优先考虑组织学确认。
en: Intense uptake in a highly atypical prostate-cancer distribution; consider another malignant or benign process and preferably tissue confirmation.

zh: CT异常/可疑但无高于背景的PSMA摄取，需进一步表征；2.0不再限于形态明确可疑恶性，感染等也可属于此分支。
en: Abnormal/suspicious CT finding without uptake above background that needs characterization; version 2.0 is not restricted to morphologically suspicious malignancy and includes other causes such as infection.

zh: 典型部位强摄取，缺乏确定常规影像证据；也允许根据广泛疾病背景将3A/3B升级。
en: Intense uptake in a typical site without a definitive conventional correlate; contextual upgrading of 3A/3B is also allowed in widespread disease.

zh: 典型部位强摄取并有确定解剖对应，例如短轴>1 cm淋巴结或典型硬化骨灶。
en: Intense uptake in a typical site with a definitive anatomic correlate, such as a node >1 cm in short axis or typical sclerotic bone lesion.

zh: 既往4/5灶接受治疗后重新评价，既包括残余摄取也包括完全消退；T表示treated，并不单独证明活肿瘤。
en: Reassessed previously category 4/5 lesion after treatment, including residual uptake or complete resolution; T means treated and does not independently establish viable tumor.

zh: 综述描述不确定摄取为高于血池但低于靶器官，强摄取高于靶器官；不是统一SUVmax切点，需结合示踪剂。
en: The review describes equivocal uptake as above blood pool but below a target organ, and intense uptake as above the target organ; this is not one universal SUVmax cutoff and depends on tracer.

zh: 初诊/首次复发多为盆腔；晚期可累及髂总、腹膜后、膈脚后、纵隔、肺门和锁骨上结节，典型性需结合分期。
en: Pelvic spread predominates at initial staging/first recurrence; advanced disease can involve common iliac, retroperitoneal, retrocrural, mediastinal, hilar and supraclavicular nodes; typicality depends on stage.

zh: 多于5个转移灶/广泛疾病背景可提高对3A/3B的确信度，由阅片者酌情升级为4；不是自动按个数加分。
en: More than five metastatic lesions/widespread disease may increase confidence in 3A/3B, permitting reader-directed upgrade to 4; this is not automatic numerical addition.

zh: 一般由最高病灶分数决定；治疗后仅有单一5T灶时整体也为5T。
en: Generally determined by the highest lesion score; when only one lesion is identified on a follow-up 5T scan, the overall score is also 5T.

steps.zh: 先排除确定良性和典型生理摄取，再结合摄取强度、分布、CT对应及治疗状态给病灶分数。
steps.en: Exclude definitive benign/physiologic uptake, then combine uptake intensity, distribution, CT correlate and treatment state.

steps.zh: 3A–3D均需按影响临床决策的程度制定进一步检查；3D在低PSMA表达原发癌背景下亦可酌情升级4。
steps.en: Plan additional assessment for 3A–3D according to clinical impact; 3D may also be upgraded to 4 in the context of low-PSMA primary cancer.

management.zh: 3A/B可活检或影像随访；3C偏向活检以鉴别非前列腺癌；3D可活检或紧密随访。
management.en: 3A/B may undergo biopsy or imaging follow-up; 3C favors biopsy to identify non-prostate disease; 3D may undergo biopsy or close follow-up.

management.zh: 5T应同时描述摄取和结构相对基线的变化；该类别本身不是完整疗效算法或治疗处方。
management.en: Describe uptake and structural changes relative to baseline with 5T; the category itself is not a complete response algorithm or treatment prescription.

cautions.zh: 综述表2的3B措辞与正文/示例不完全一致；此处按正文及图3保留典型/不排斥前列腺癌骨灶含无CT对应。
cautions.en: Table 2 wording for 3B differs from the prose/examples; this guide follows prose and Fig 3, retaining compatible/typical bone lesions including absent CT correlates.

cautions.zh: 摄取受示踪剂、重建和肝背景影响；研究中的SUVmax切点及RECIP/PPP应答标准不应误当PSMA-RADS分级算法。
cautions.en: Tracer, reconstruction and liver background influence uptake; cited study SUVmax cutoffs and RECIP/PPP response criteria are not PSMA-RADS grading algorithms.

name.zh: 生长抑素受体影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Somatostatin Receptor Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于生长抑素受体 PET 影像报告和潜在 PRRT 候选者选择的标准化框架。
summary.en: A published standardized framework for SSTR PET reporting and selection of potential PRRT candidates.

domain.zh: 生长抑素受体 PET 影像

sources.title: Somatostatin Receptor Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 2018年SSTR-PET病灶确信度框架，兼顾NET分布、解剖对应与PRRT候选评估。
scope.en: The 2018 SSTR-PET lesion-confidence framework, combining NET distribution, anatomic correlates and consideration of PRRT eligibility.

sourcePages.zh: PDF第2页表1全部类别及PRRT脚注；第3页表2摄取；第4–6页病例、整体分数与局限。
sourcePages.en: PDF p 2 Table 1 all categories and PRRT notes; p 3 Table 2 uptake; pp 4–6 cases, overall score and limitations.

purpose.zh: 同时审阅SSTR摄取、CT/MRI和NET原发、Ki-67/分级；认清钩突、生理内分泌器官及脾组织摄取。
purpose.en: Review SSTR uptake, CT/MRI and NET primary, Ki-67/grade; recognize uncinate-process, endocrine-organ and splenic-tissue physiologic uptake.

purpose.zh: SSTR阴性但形态可疑的3D灶考虑FDG及组织学，以识别去分化或其他癌。
purpose.en: For SSTR-negative but anatomically suspicious 3D lesions, consider FDG and histology for dedifferentiation or another cancer.

title.zh: 病灶类别与原文下一步
title.en: Lesion categories and source next steps

zh: 确定良性、无异常摄取（水平1）；不考虑PRRT。
en: Definitively benign without abnormal uptake (level 1); PRRT not considered.

zh: 组织学/典型影像确定良性但有摄取（水平2–3）；不考虑PRRT。
en: Biopsy/pathognomonic imaging establishes benignity despite uptake (levels 2–3); PRRT not considered.

zh: 不典型NET软组织部位低摄取，或更像退变的骨灶（水平1）；倾向良性，不考虑PRRT。
en: Low uptake in atypical NET soft-tissue sites or degenerative-appearing bone (level 1); likely benign, no PRRT.

zh: 典型NET软组织部位不确定摄取（1–2）；可活检或约3个月SSTR-PET/全身MRI，结合Ki-67；不以此考虑PRRT。
en: Equivocal uptake (1–2) in typical NET soft tissue; consider biopsy or SSTR-PET/WB-MRI at about 3 months with Ki-67 context; no PRRT on this basis.

zh: 不排斥NET的骨灶不确定摄取（1–2）；约3个月复查、结合Ki-67。单灶可局部治疗，多灶可讨论PRRT，但须满足常规条件。
en: Equivocal uptake (1–2) in bone not atypical for NET; follow-up about 3 months with Ki-67 context. A single lesion may favor local treatment; increasing/multiple lesions may support considering PRRT, subject to standard eligibility.

zh: 高度非典型NET部位强摄取（3），可为非NET良性或恶性SSTR表达病；考虑组织确认，不凭此考虑PRRT。
en: Intense uptake (3) in a highly atypical NET site, potentially a non-NET benign/malignant SSTR-expressing process; consider tissue confirmation, not PRRT based on this finding.

zh: 形态高度提示恶性但无SSTR摄取；考虑FDG/活检，去分化NET或非NET癌。此灶本身不支持PRRT。
en: Highly suspicious anatomy without SSTR uptake; consider FDG/biopsy for dedifferentiated NET or non-NET cancer. The lesion itself does not support PRRT.

zh: 典型NET部位强摄取（3）而无确定解剖对应；NET高度可能，PRRT可考虑，未必需另行活检。
en: Intense uptake (3) in a typical NET site without definitive anatomy; NET highly likely and PRRT may be considered; further biopsy may not be necessary.

zh: 典型NET部位强摄取（3）且有常规影像对应；NET几乎确定，明确应讨论PRRT资格。
en: Intense uptake (3) in a typical NET site with conventional-imaging correlate; NET almost certain, with strong consideration of PRRT eligibility.

zh: 摄取>血池且≤生理肝摄取。

steps.zh: 每灶分别分类，可选最多5个高摄取/较大靶灶；整体分数取最高病灶分数，不能省略更低分但可能去分化的灶。
steps.en: Classify individual lesions, optionally selecting up to five avid/large targets; use the highest lesion score overall without omitting lower-scored possible dedifferentiation.

steps.zh: 后续病理可改变分类，例如3C甲状腺灶证实腺瘤后改1B。
steps.en: Subsequent histology can change category, e.g. a 3C thyroid lesion proven adenoma becomes 1B.

management.zh: PRRT仍需满足原文引用的实践指南，结合分级、总负荷、肾/骨髓功能及整体SSTR表达；不能由单一分数直接处方。
management.en: PRRT still requires the referenced practice-guideline criteria, considering grade, burden, renal/marrow function and overall SSTR expression; one score does not prescribe treatment.

management.zh: 3D孤立去分化灶与其余SSTR阳性多灶并存时，原文允许讨论局部治疗联合PRRT；不是排除整名患者的一刀切规则。
management.en: With an isolated dedifferentiated 3D lesion among SSTR-positive disease, the source allows discussion of local therapy plus PRRT rather than automatic exclusion of the entire patient.

cautions.zh: 这是初始提案，需要验证；类别反映NET确信度，摄取并非NET特异，3D也可代表其他癌。
cautions.en: This initial proposal requires validation; categories describe confidence in NET, uptake is not NET-specific and 3D may be another malignancy.

name.zh: 胃超声报告和数据系统
name.en: Stomach Ultrasound Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于胃癌超声评估类别的初步意见。
summary.en: A published preliminary framework for stomach-ultrasound assessment categories in gastric cancer.

domain.zh: 胃癌超声评估

sources.title: Stomach Ultrasound Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 用于口服纤维素造影剂后经腹超声（TUS-OCCA）所见的胃壁增厚；原研究排除孤立肿块形式的胃息肉与黏膜下肿瘤。此为初步单中心研究分类。
scope.en: Classifies wall thickening on transabdominal ultrasound after oral cellulose contrast (TUS-OCCA); solitary gastric polyps and submucosal masses were excluded. This is a preliminary single-center framework.

sourcePages.zh: 第2–3页检查步骤与测量；第4–5页分类、表1–2；第6–7页处理及表3。
sourcePages.en: Pages 2–3, examination and measurements; pages 4–5, criteria and Tables 1–2; pages 6–7, management and Table 3.

purpose.zh: 原研究口服50 g纤维素制剂加水至500 mL，能耐受时完整饮用，不使用解痉药；分别扫描贲门、胃底、全胃连续横断／冠状切面和胃窦幽门。
purpose.en: The source used 50 g cellulose preparation in 500 mL water, taken as tolerated without antispasmodics; scan cardia, fundus, serial whole-stomach transverse/coronal sections, and antrum/pylorus.

purpose.zh: 保存9个标准切面，测贲门附近小弯及胃角、胃窦等重点位置；分层清楚时优先测黏膜，分层不清时使用相应部位全层厚度。
purpose.en: Store nine standard views and measure key lesser-curvature/cardia, angle and antral sites; use mucosal thickness when layers are visible and region-specific full-wall thickness otherwise.

title.zh: 胃壁厚度标准（原文近似区间）

zh: 全层：胃窦／贲门、胃体、胃底

title.zh: 不完整检查、形态分支及已知恶性
title.en: Incomplete examination, morphology and known malignancy

zh: 肥胖、高膈位、残胃、气体干扰或充盈不足导致无法判断是否有病变；需补充胃镜等检查。
en: Poor body habitus, high diaphragm, gastric remnant, gas or insufficient filling prevents assessment; additional evaluation such as gastroscopy is needed.

zh: 4类增厚无表面溃疡为4A、有溃疡为4B；即使厚度未达4类，低回声打断黏膜下层连续性也可归4。
en: Category 4 without/with surface ulceration gives 4A/4B; disrupted submucosal continuity by a hypoechoic area can give 4 even below its thickness thresholds.

zh: 5类无／有表面黏膜溃疡分别为5A／5B。
en: Category 5 without/with mucosal surface ulceration gives 5A/5B.

zh: 已由活检证实恶性；不是单靠超声厚度升至6。
en: Known biopsy-proven malignancy; thickness alone does not establish 6.

steps.zh: 先判断检查充分性，不能评估为0；完成检查后依据黏膜或相应部位全层厚度分1–5。
steps.en: Assess completeness first and use 0 when unevaluable; otherwise assign 1–5 using mucosal or regional full-wall thickness.

steps.zh: 核对黏膜下层破坏和溃疡，分别进入4类特殊升级和A／B亚类；已知活检恶性用6。
steps.en: Check submucosal disruption and ulceration for the special route to 4 and A/B subcategories; reserve 6 for biopsy-proven malignancy.

management.zh: 0补充胃镜；1／2继续常规健康检查，出现症状体征仍需进一步检查；低类别不排除早期胃癌。
management.en: Obtain gastroscopy for 0; for 1/2 continue routine screening and investigate interval symptoms; low categories do not exclude early cancer.

management.zh: 3可行胃镜；拒绝胃镜者原文建议3个月短期复查。4需胃镜与活检，5需胃镜并多处活检，6进入手术或其他治疗。
management.en: Consider gastroscopy for 3; the source suggests 3-month follow-up if declined. Categories 4 and 5 require gastroscopy with biopsy and multiple biopsies respectively; 6 proceeds to surgery or other treatment.

cautions.zh: 厚度区间使用“约”且共享端点，原文未提供每个边界的唯一闭开区间；不能自行制造精确数学分界。
cautions.en: Intervals are approximate and share endpoints; the source does not define unique open/closed boundaries for every value.

cautions.zh: 表2恶性比例来自经胃镜选择的2738例研究人群，并非所有筛查人群的固定风险；炎症与溃疡也会明显增厚。
cautions.en: Table 2 proportions derive from an endoscopy-selected cohort of 2738 rather than universal screening risk; inflammation and ulcers can also markedly thicken the wall.

name.zh: 影像不良事件放射学评分系统
name.en: Adverse Events Radiological Scoring System

summary.zh: 用于诊断放射学与远程放射学不良事件记录和严重程度评估的已发表评分框架。
summary.en: A published scoring framework for recording and assessing adverse events in diagnostic radiology and teleradiology.

domain.zh: 影像科不良事件质量评价
domain.en: Quality assessment of radiology adverse events

sources.title: Adverse Events Radiological Scoring System

title.zh: AE-RADS：2025影像不良事件判定框架

scope.zh: 用于诊断影像和远程影像的不良事件登记与分析。原表2含90项决策网格，依事件来源、类型和实际后果分支；不是把90项加成总分。
scope.en: Adverse-event registration and analysis in diagnostic radiology and teleradiology. The 90-item Table 2 grid branches by source, event type and consequences rather than summing 90 items.

sourcePages.zh: 第3页表1；第4页框架说明；第5–7页表2及脚注；第8–9页图2；第12–14页讨论。
sourcePages.en: Page 3, Table 1; page 4, framework; pages 5–7, Table 2 and footnote; pages 8–9, Figure 2; pages 12–14, discussion.

purpose.zh: 重建申请、方案、采集、判读及后续行动时间线；收集实际辐射／注射、身份／侧别、对患者后果和责任环节，同一患者可有多个事件。
purpose.en: Reconstruct request, protocol, acquisition, interpretation and subsequent actions; document actual exposure/injection, identity/laterality, patient consequences and the responsible step. A patient can have multiple events.

title.zh: 表2事件分支速查（同类条目合并概述）

zh: 申请医生：身份错误但未成像
技师纠正，未做影像检查；本不需检查的错误患者若无额外辐射风险且无禁忌证，原文亦归G1。
en: Corrected by the radiographer before acquisition; a wrong patient not needing the examination also falls under G1 if there is no over-radiation risk and no contraindication.

zh: 申请医生／技师：本应同模态检查的患者被误扫
完成相同方案为G1；CT多做采集为G3；未要求的注射且无患者影响为G2。
en: Requester/radiographer: wrong patient who needed the same modality
Same protocol: G1; additional CT acquisitions: G3; unrequested injection without patient impact: G2.

zh: 申请医生：不应接受检查的患者被误扫
未要求注射且无临床影响，原表列G3；有影响则依HAS评估；无注射分支需结合额外辐射。
en: Requester: wrong patient who did not need imaging
Unrequested injection without clinical impact is G3 in this requester branch; impact requires HAS assessment; noninjected cases depend on excess radiation.

zh: 绕过提醒／必填项，申请单不完整或错误：无影响G1，有影响依HAS。
en: Bypassed alerts/mandatory fields or incomplete/incorrect requests: G1 without impact, HAS grading with impact.

zh: 对额外未申请部位加做CT造成额外辐射，或错误侧别实际采集为G3；侧别书写错但采集正确为G1。
en: Extra CT of an unrequested region causing overexposure or acquisition on the wrong side: G3; laterality error with correct acquisition: G1.

zh: 错误协议需依对比剂等实际影响评估；漏扫且有临床影响依HAS。
en: Assess an inappropriate protocol according to actual contrast-related or other impact; omitted coverage with clinical consequences uses HAS.

zh: 医师：RIS提醒与建议未执行
妊娠提醒造成辐射按具体影响；方案修改未执行、肾功能／甲亢／过敏提醒或建议未遵从，无临床影响G1，有影响依HAS。
en: Radiologist: missed RIS alerts or recommendations
Assess pregnancy-related exposure by its impact; ignored protocol changes, renal/thyroid/allergy alerts or recommendations: G1 without impact, HAS with impact.

zh: 必需紧急电话、RIS记录缺失，无影响G1；有医疗影响的修订未记录或未通知医生，依HAS。
en: Missing required urgent calls or RIS documentation: G1 without impact; clinically consequential unrecorded or uncommunicated amendments use HAS.

zh: 医师：患者／图像／日期错误关联
读错患者或正确患者的错误检查，原表直接列需按临床后果最终评定。
en: Reading the wrong patient or the wrong examination for the correct patient is listed for final clinical-consequence grading.

zh: 由临床／技师、内部质控或AI发现的诊断错误；漏描述、复核不足及报告侧别错误：无影响G1，有影响依HAS。
en: Diagnostic errors found clinically, by internal QA or AI, incomplete descriptions, inadequate rereading or report laterality errors: G1 without impact, HAS with impact.

zh: 技师：本不应成像的错误患者
无注射且非电离检查G1，电离检查G3；无患者影响的未要求注射在非电离检查为G2、在电离检查为G3。
en: Radiographer: wrong patient not needing imaging
Without injection: nonionizing G1, ionizing G3; unrequested injection without impact: nonionizing G2, ionizing G3.

zh: 无临床影响G1，有临床影响依HAS。
en: G1 without clinical impact; HAS grading with impact.

zh: 无理由追加G3；发现异常后及时合理补扫或因运动／设备故障的技术问题为G1；再次注射或至少2次额外采集按实际影响。
en: Unjustified addition: G3; justified prompt acquisition for a detected abnormality or a technical movement/equipment issue: G1; reinjection or at least two extra acquisitions requires impact assessment.

zh: 技师：临床绕过医师提出追加
方案适当G1，不适当按后果评估。
en: Appropriate protocol: G1; inappropriate protocol: consequence-based grading.

zh: 技师：注射、采集、重建及通知
未要求却注射、要求但未注射、漏序列／部分采集、重建遗漏导致PACS传输缺失、必需电话未打：无影响G1，有影响依HAS。此注射分支与错误患者分支不同。
en: Radiographer: injection, acquisition, reconstruction and calls

Unrequested/performed or requested/omitted injection, missing/partial acquisitions, reconstruction omissions affecting PACS transfer, and missed required calls: G1 without impact, HAS with impact. This injection branch differs from wrong-patient branches.

zh: 新增影响方案／判读的信息未传达、影像临床不符未沟通、紧急信息未记录、组织规则未执行、医师技师误解及行政沟通失误：按有无临床影响分支。
en: Uncommunicated new information or clinical-imaging discordance, undocumented urgent information, organizational failures, protocol/telephone misunderstandings and administrative communication failures: branch by clinical impact.

zh: 图像传输失败／延迟，网络、电话、RIS或PACS故障，无影响G1，有影响依HAS。
en: Failed/delayed image transfer or network, telephone, RIS/PACS outage: G1 without impact, HAS with impact.

title.zh: 临床后果与G+的最终评定
title.en: Clinical consequences and final grading of G+

zh: 轻微后果、无患者损害；但须先排除表2指定的额外辐射／注射等G2／G3分支。
en: Minor consequences without patient harm, after checking Table 2 branches assigning G2/G3 for particular exposures or injections.

zh: 临床影响尚在汇集时的临时标识，待后果明确后参照HAS表1定G2–G5。
en: Temporary label while clinical consequences are being established; finalize G2–G5 using HAS Table 1.

zh: HAS：暂时损害，例如延误导致诊疗流程受影响。
en: HAS: temporary injury, such as delay disrupting care.

zh: HAS：住院延长、非计划转运或暂时功能丧失等影响。
en: HAS: prolonged hospitalization, unplanned transfer or temporary functional loss.

zh: HAS：严重后果，如再次干预、日常生活受影响或部分永久残疾。
en: HAS: serious consequences, such as reintervention, impact on daily life or partial permanent disability.

zh: HAS：死亡、严重后遗症或永久残疾等极严重后果。
en: HAS: very serious consequences such as death, major sequelae or permanent disability.

steps.zh: 逐个事件从来源→类型→具体操作／影响条件→等级查表，不把“无立即症状”一律归G1。
steps.en: For each event follow source → type → action/consequence conditions → grade; absence of immediate symptoms does not universally imply G1.

steps.zh: 如存在临床影响，记录G+并继续收集结局，再依据HAS严重程度给最终等级；分别记录事件数及最严重事件。
steps.en: With clinical impact, record G+ while collecting outcomes, then finalize by HAS severity; retain event count and the most serious event separately.

steps.zh: 对同一种注射或辐射错误，核对是错误患者、方案错误还是技师执行错误分支，不能互换表2条件。
steps.en: For apparently similar injection/exposure errors distinguish wrong-patient, protocol and execution branches rather than exchanging their conditions.

management.zh: 原文质量流程由未参与事件的专门团队调查，与相关机构确认总结，制定教育、组织和预防措施并追踪落实。
management.en: The source quality process uses an uninvolved review team, an agreed incident summary, educational/organizational/preventive measures and implementation follow-up.

management.zh: 等级用于事件管理与改进，不代替对患者伤害的即时处理；严重事件报告按适用机构与地区规则执行，本文法国路径不能视为通用法规。
management.en: Grades support incident management and improvement rather than immediate harm treatment; reporting follows applicable institutional/jurisdictional rules, and the French pathway is not universal law.

cautions.zh: 这里将90项重复的有／无后果条件按事件组概述，具体争议仍需回到表2对应行；不同错误患者注射分支不能合并成统一分数。
cautions.en: This reference groups repeated impact/no-impact items from the 90-item grid; disputed cases require the corresponding Table 2 row, and wrong-patient injection branches cannot be collapsed into one score.

cautions.zh: 100例研究中一致性改善但仍不完美；培训与完整后果调查重要，不能将等级等同责任裁定。
cautions.en: Agreement improved but remained imperfect in the 100-case study; training and outcome ascertainment matter, and grades do not adjudicate responsibility.

name.zh: 脑肿瘤影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Brain Tumor Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于治疗后胶质瘤 MRI 的结构化报告与反应评估框架；已有同行评议研究，但 ACR 当前仍将其列为开发中项目。
summary.en: A structured reporting and response-assessment framework for post-treatment glioma MRI; it has peer-reviewed studies, while ACR currently lists the program as in development.

organization: BT-RADS program authors / American College of Radiology (ACR)

domain.zh: 治疗后胶质瘤 MRI 评估

sources.title: Brain Tumor Reporting and Data System

title.en: BT-RADS: 2018 posttreatment brain tumor MRI classification

scope.zh: 采用本地2018年发表框架评估治疗后脑肿瘤（重点为胶质瘤）的MRI变化，联合影像、临床和治疗时间；此处不代表正在开发的其他ACR版本。
scope.en: Use the locally retained 2018 framework for posttreatment brain tumor MRI, chiefly glioma, combining imaging, clinical status and treatment timing. This section does not represent a different ACR system under development.

sourcePages.zh: 第2页表1；第3页表2；第4页表3及模板说明。
sourcePages.en: Page 2, Table 1; page 3, Table 2; page 4, Table 3 and reporting template.

purpose.zh: 比较增强T1、FLAIR、新病灶及占位效应；记录肿瘤病理／突变、手术、放疗完成日期、激素剂量及贝伐珠单抗治疗，并参考临床状态。
purpose.en: Compare postcontrast T1, FLAIR, new lesions and mass effect; record histology/mutations, surgery, RT completion, steroid doses, bevacizumab and clinical status.

purpose.zh: 灌注和扩散可在报告中描述，但2018分类不以灌注作为必需计分项目，也不要求每种变化均可量化。
purpose.en: Perfusion and diffusion can be described, but perfusion is not a required scoring variable in the 2018 scheme and not every change needs to be measurable.

title.zh: 分级、影像／临床条件与处理

zh: 初次诊断／最近术后基线、非肿瘤异常干扰或检查不能判读。
en: Initial diagnostic or latest postoperative baseline, obscuring nontumor findings, or an unclassifiable study.
Continue follow-up without a management change.

zh: 强化减少；FLAIR和占位效应不变或减少，无新灶，临床稳定／改善；贝伐珠单抗使用者需4周复查证实反应。
en: Less enhancement; stable/decreased FLAIR and mass effect, no new lesions and stable/improved clinical state; response on bevacizumab requires confirmation at 4 weeks.

zh: 上述改善可能与增加激素剂量或首次贝伐珠单抗后仅强化下降有关。
继续随访，区分药物效应。
en: Improvement may reflect increased steroids or enhancement-only reduction on the first post-bevacizumab study.
Continue follow-up and account for medication effects.

zh: 强化、FLAIR、占位效应均无明显变化，无新灶，临床稳定。
en: Stable enhancement, FLAIR and mass effect, no new lesions and clinical stability.

zh: 最近放疗完成后12周内，强化和／或FLAIR增加、占位效应增加，临床稳定且放疗范围外无新灶；倾向治疗效应。
en: Within 12 weeks after latest RT, increased enhancement and/or FLAIR with mass effect, clinical stability and no new lesion outside the RT field; treatment effect favored.

zh: 放疗后超过12周，强化增加或FLAIR增加伴占位效应增加；临床稳定，放疗区外无新灶；治疗与进展混合可能。
en: Beyond 12 weeks after RT, increased enhancement or increased FLAIR with mass effect, stable clinical state and no new lesion outside the field; mixed treatment effect and progression.

zh: 强化及FLAIR成分增加均<25%，占位效应增加且临床变差、放疗区外无新灶；或区外出现新的不确定病灶。
考虑改变处理或缩短复查。
en: Both enhancing and FLAIR components increase <25%, with greater mass effect and clinical worsening but no new lesion outside the field; alternatively a new indeterminate out-of-field lesion.
Consider a management change or shorter follow-up.

zh: 多次检查持续增加的强化／FLAIR、占位效应和临床恶化；或强化及FLAIR均增加>25%并占位与临床恶化；或放疗区外新发明确病灶。
en: Serially progressive enhancement/FLAIR, mass effect and clinical deterioration; or >25% increases in both enhancement and FLAIR with mass effect and clinical worsening; or a new definite out-of-field lesion.

steps.zh: 先识别新基线或不可判读检查为0；可比较时依次判断改善、稳定或恶化。
steps.en: First identify new-baseline or unclassifiable studies as 0; otherwise assess improvement, stability or worsening.

steps.zh: 改善结合激素／贝伐珠单抗区分1a／1b；恶化结合放疗后12周时间窗、临床和放疗区外病灶区分3a–4。
steps.en: For improvement distinguish 1a/1b using medication history; for worsening integrate the 12-week RT window, clinical state and out-of-field lesions to distinguish 3a–4.

steps.zh: 报告需描述导致等级的变化及对照日期；等级不是完整／部分缓解的临床试验分类。
steps.en: Describe the changes and comparison date supporting the grade; this is not a complete/partial response classification for clinical trials.

management.zh: 0、1、2继续随访而不改变处理；3a／3b缩短复查；3c可改变处理或缩短复查；4考虑改变处理。原文未为所有类别规定统一月数。
management.en: Continue follow-up for 0, 1 and 2; shorten intervals for 3a/3b; consider a change or shorter interval for 3c and a management change for 4. The source does not specify fixed months for every grade.

cautions.zh: 表2采用3c的<25%与4的>25%，未单独规定恰好25%的归类，不能自行改写为≥25%。
cautions.en: Table 2 uses <25% for 3c and >25% for one route to 4, leaving exactly 25% unspecified; do not silently replace > with ≥.

cautions.zh: 放疗与药物效应会改变强化和FLAIR；类别须综合临床，不能单凭强化减少判断肿瘤缩小。
cautions.en: RT and medication alter enhancement and FLAIR; incorporate clinical context rather than equating less enhancement with tumor shrinkage.

name.zh: 中国肺结节报告和数据系统
name.en: Chinese Lung Nodules Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 基于中国人群胸部 CT 队列建立的肺结节恶性风险分层与精准管理框架。
summary.en: A published framework for malignancy-risk stratification and precision management of pulmonary nodules in Chinese chest-CT cohorts.

domain.zh: 中国人群肺结节 CT 风险分层
domain.en: Chest-CT risk stratification of pulmonary nodules in Chinese cohorts

sources.title: Chinese Lung Nodules Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 2024年中国肺癌筛查研究的两阶段风险分层：首先以结节类型／尺寸形成1–4，再以训练得到的影像、临床及随访模型调整2–3类；0表示钙化阴性所见。
scope.en: A 2024 Chinese screening research pipeline: initial type/size-based categories 1–4, followed by trained imaging/clinical/follow-up model refinement of 2–3; 0 denotes negative calcification findings.

sourcePages.en: PDF pages 2, 4–6, 8–9 and 12–15; Figures 1, 3 and 5, Table 1 and Methods.

purpose.zh: 提取结节类型和平均直径；混合GGO（mGGN，即部分实性）另外测实性成分SC。以下表1阈值为初始分类。
purpose.en: Extract nodule type and mean diameter; also measure the solid component (SC) of mixed GGO (mGGN/part-solid nodules). Table 1 thresholds below define initial categories.

purpose.zh: 2–3类进入DCNN和多维回归：影像恶性预测、年龄、性别、吸烟、既往癌症、家族史及随访增长。模型使用标准化特征与训练系数，不能以人工相加替代。
purpose.en: Categories 2–3 enter DCNN and multidimensional regression using imaging malignancy prediction, age, sex, smoking, cancer history, family history and serial growth. Trained coefficients and normalized features are required; manual point addition is not equivalent.

zh: 钙化所见；12个月LDCT继续年度筛查。
en: Calcifications; continue annual LDCT at 12 months.

zh: 实性、部分实性或纯GGO平均径均<6 mm；12个月LDCT。
en: Solid, part-solid or pure GGO mean diameter <6 mm; LDCT at 12 months.

zh: 实性≥6且<10 mm；mGGN总径≥6 mm且SC<6 mm；纯GGO≥6且<20 mm；6个月CT。
en: Solid ≥6 to <10 mm; mGGN total diameter ≥6 mm with SC <6 mm; pure GGO ≥6 to <20 mm; CT at six months.

zh: 实性≥10且<18 mm；mGGN总径≥6 mm且SC≥6、<10 mm；纯GGO≥20 mm；3个月CT，可考虑HRCT或PET/CT。
en: Solid ≥10 to <18 mm; mGGN total diameter ≥6 mm with SC ≥6 to <10 mm; pure GGO ≥20 mm; CT at three months, with HRCT or PET/CT considered.

zh: 实性≥18 mm；mGGN SC≥10 mm；或初始2／3类经多维模型预测恶性概率≥0.5。立即临床评估。
en: Solid ≥18 mm; mGGN SC ≥10 mm; or initial 2/3 with multidimensional model malignancy probability ≥0.5. Immediate clinical assessment.

title.zh: 随访量与模型应用边界

zh: SGR=ln(V2/V1)/ΔT；VDT=ln2/SGR；V为分割体积，ΔT为扫描间隔。分别建立增长SGR+及缩小SGR−候选特征，最终模型选入SGR+。
en: SGR = ln(V2/V1)/ΔT; VDT = ln2/SGR, using segmented volumes and scan interval. Positive SGR+ and negative SGR− were candidate features; SGR+ entered the final model.

zh: 多维模型概率<0.5保持原类别；表1写≥0.5升级4。原文没有为手工阅片提供代替训练模型的简易总分。
en: Probability <0.5 retains the original grade; Table 1 upgrades ≥0.5 to 4. No simple manual score substitutes for the trained model.

steps.zh: 先按表1给每个结节尺寸级。仅2–3类进入恶性辨别与再分级，不能在没有原模型输出时凭临床印象称完成第二阶段。
steps.en: Assign size/type categories first. Only 2–3 undergo malignancy discrimination/refinement; without the original model output, clinical impression does not constitute completion of phase 2.

steps.zh: 模型包含随访时，应以可比扫描和分割体积计算增长；扫描次数、模型校准与特征标准化会影响预测。
steps.en: With longitudinal inputs, compute growth from comparable scans and segmented volumes; scan availability, calibration and normalization affect predictions.

management.zh: 4类的即时评估可含诊断胸CT（可增强或不增强）、PET/CT（尤其结节或SC≥8 mm）、取样及其他临床评估；检查组合按临床、患者偏好及估计恶性可能性决定。
management.en: Immediate category 4 assessment can include diagnostic chest CT with/without contrast, PET/CT especially for nodule/SC ≥8 mm, tissue sampling and other workup, selected according to clinical findings, preferences and estimated malignancy probability.

cautions.zh: 这是特定中国训练、内部及独立测试队列的研究系统；表中风险率／人群比例为队列估计，不是对个体的固定概率。表1规则可复述，但完整系统需研究模型。
cautions.en: This is a research system developed and tested in specific Chinese cohorts; risk/prevalence estimates are cohort results rather than fixed individual probabilities. Table 1 can be applied descriptively, but the full pipeline requires the research model.

cautions.zh: 图3示意中的开区间与表1精确不等号可能不同，本节以表1为准；纯GGO≥20 mm初始为3，并非仅凭总径达到4。
cautions.en: Figure 3 interval artwork and Table 1 inequalities differ in presentation; this guide follows Table 1. Pure GGO ≥20 mm initially remains 3 rather than reaching 4 from total size alone.

name.zh: 中国甲状腺影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Chinese Thyroid Imaging Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 中华医学会超声医学分会发布的甲状腺结节超声恶性风险分层中国指南。
summary.en: Chinese guidelines published by the Chinese Medical Association for ultrasound malignancy-risk stratification of thyroid nodules.

domain.zh: 甲状腺结节超声恶性风险分层
domain.en: Ultrasound malignancy-risk stratification of thyroid nodules

sources.title: 2020 Chinese guidelines for ultrasound malignancy risk stratification of thyroid nodules: the C-TIRADS

scope.zh: 2020中国甲状腺影像报告和数据系统英文原文；五项阳性征象各+1，彗尾−1，并保留典型模式与临床修正。
scope.en: 2020 English original of Chinese TIRADS; five positive features each +1, comet tail −1, with characteristic-pattern and clinical refinements.

sourcePages.zh: PDF第6–15页；表1、图1–3、分类与管理建议（印刷页261–270）。
sourcePages.en: PDF pages 6–15; Table 1, Figures 1–3 and category/management recommendations (printed pages 261–270).

purpose.zh: 横纵切面测三个径线，最大径含晕；描述位置、组成、方向、边缘、回声、亮点及与包膜/气管/喉返神经关系，系统评估颈结节。
purpose.en: Measure three dimensions in transverse/longitudinal planes including halo; describe site, composition, orientation, margin, echogenicity, foci and proximity to capsule/trachea/recurrent laryngeal nerve; systematically assess cervical nodes.

zh: 任一横或纵切面前后径大于该切面的横径或纵径（高于宽）。
en: AP diameter exceeds width in transverse or length in longitudinal imaging (taller than wide) in either plane.

zh: 完全由实性组织组成，无囊性成分；仅“主要实性”不是相同定义。
en: Entirely solid without cystic components; predominantly solid is not the same definition.

zh: 实性回声低于颈带状肌；仅等于肌肉而低于甲状腺仍是低回声。
en: Solid echo lower than strap muscle; equal to muscle but lower than thyroid remains hypoechoic.

zh: 约<1 mm点状高回声，可有或无声影。
en: Punctate foci less than about 1 mm, with or without shadowing.

zh: 不清、毛刺/角状/微分叶，或甲状腺外侵犯；多个同时存在仍只算这一项。
en: Ill-defined, spiculated/angular/microlobulated, or extrathyroidal extension; multiple findings still count as this one component.

zh: 密集胶质等导致的后方逐渐变细短尾；有微钙化时优先仅记录微钙化，不同时减1。
en: Tapering reverberation tail from dense colloid and related material; if microcalcification coexists, record it preferentially and do not also subtract one.

zh: 同4B；典型甲状腺来源转移结节时最可疑同侧结节不论大小FNA
en: As 4B; with typical thyroid-origin metastatic nodes, FNA the most suspicious ipsilateral nodule regardless of size

zh: 据病理及临床选择管理
en: Management by pathology and clinical context

zh: 纯囊/海绵样；桥本背景均匀高回声“白骑士”
2；海绵样必须微囊遍布、无聚集实性组织。
en: Cystic/spongiform; uniform hyperechoic white-knight nodule in Hashimoto thyroiditis
2; spongiform requires tiny cysts throughout without aggregated solid tissue.

zh: 多个外观相似的主要实性/囊性结节，结节性甲状腺肿模式
en: Multiple similar predominantly solid/cystic nodules, nodular-goiter pattern

zh: 粗/周边钙化声影遮挡内部
en: Macro/peripheral calcification shadows obscuring internal assessment

zh: 雪暴样微钙化；不依附结节的大量微钙化
雪暴样结节可5；不依附结节微钙化合并典型甲状腺来源转移结节为5，无可疑结节时原文允许凭经验归高于4B甚至5，不能一概自动5。
en: Snowstorm nodules may be 5; extensive nodule-independent microcalcification with typical thyroid-origin metastatic nodes is 5. Without suspicious nodes the source permits an experienced category above 4B or even 5, not automatic 5.

zh: 囊肿吸收/抽吸后退化；亚急性甲状腺炎
结合明确病史或连续缩小可下调2/3；病史不清的疑似亚急性炎症可4A短期观察而非立即FNA。
en: Degeneration after cyst resorption/aspiration; subacute thyroiditis
Confirmed history or serial shrinkage may permit downgrade to 2/3; uncertain subacute-inflammatory history may warrant 4A short follow-up rather than immediate FNA.

zh: 无增强/少量点线增强的疑似退化实性结节
CEUS全/大部分无增强可2，少量点线增强可3；须结合病史及大小，不把CEUS一般性纳入计数。
en: Suspected degenerated solid nodule without/with scant enhancement
CEUS absent enhancement throughout/most may allow 2, scant punctate-linear enhancement 3; consider history/size and do not generally add CEUS to the count.

steps.zh: 逐项数五个阳性征象，并在没有微钙化时按彗尾减1；先给计数类别，再检查原文临床/典型模式修正，记录修正理由。
steps.en: Count five positives, subtract for comet tail only if microcalcification is absent; assign a count-based category then check source clinical/characteristic-pattern refinements and document reasons.

steps.zh: 若典型颈部甲状腺转移结节与同侧可疑甲状腺结节同现，将该结节归5；未见可疑甲状腺结节时在报告提出隐匿原发可能，而不是虚构甲状腺病灶。
steps.en: With typical thyroid-origin cervical metastasis and an ipsilateral suspicious thyroid nodule, assign that nodule 5. If no thyroid nodule is found, report possible occult primary rather than inventing a lesion.

management.zh: 4A多发或紧邻气管/喉返神经时>10 mm可FNA；4B/4C/5多发或紧邻包膜、气管、喉返神经时>5 mm可FNA；<5 mm同类情形综合操作能力与患者焦虑决定。
management.en: For multiple 4A nodules or those immediately adjacent to trachea/recurrent nerve, FNA may be considered >10 mm. For 4B/4C/5, multiplicity or immediate proximity to capsule/trachea/recurrent nerve allows consideration >5 mm; for <5 mm, consider operator feasibility and patient anxiety.

management.zh: 孤立≤10 mm且不紧邻包膜/气管/喉返神经者可知情主动监测。未达到FNA条件者随访6–24个月，依类别、大小、部位及偏好调整；原则每叶最多取1个达到条件的结节。
management.en: A solitary ≤10 mm nodule away from capsule/trachea/recurrent nerve may undergo informed surveillance. Follow-up when FNA criteria are unmet is 6–24 months tailored to category, size, site and preference; in principle sample no more than one eligible nodule per lobe.

management.zh: 2/3因压迫或外观问题可考虑治疗，但需良性病理前提；已确诊恶性6类依据病情选择手术或知情主动监测。原文热消融仅针对严格筛选的低危微小乳头癌：活检证实PTC、孤立结节≤10 mm、不累及气管、距甲状腺背内侧包膜>1–2 mm（取决于术者经验）、无颈部淋巴结或远处转移证据，并充分知情同意；原文强调长期疗效尚需观察。家族癌/童年辐射史可降低FNA界值，温/热显像结节通常不FNA。
management.en: Symptomatic/cosmetic 2/3 nodules may be treated with benign-biopsy prerequisites; confirmed-malignant category 6 is managed with surgery or informed surveillance according to disease context. The source limits thermal ablation to strictly selected low-risk papillary microcarcinoma: biopsy-confirmed PTC, solitary nodule ≤10 mm, no tracheal involvement, >1–2 mm from the dorsal medial thyroid capsule depending on operator experience, no evidence of cervical nodal or distant metastasis, and full informed consent. Long-term efficacy still requires observation in this source. Familial cancer/childhood irradiation may lower FNA cutoffs; scintigraphically warm/hot nodules generally avoid FNA.

cautions.zh: ≥与>不可混换：本原文4A>15 mm，4B/4C/5>10 mm。原文<5与>5分支没有单列恰为5 mm；临床决策需承认此边界未定义。
cautions.en: Do not interchange ≥ and >: this source uses >15 mm for 4A and >10 mm for 4B/4C/5. Its <5 and >5 branches do not separately define exactly 5 mm; acknowledge that boundary gap.

cautions.zh: 分级目的是选择FNA，不应仅凭超声类别自动手术；CEUS/弹性修正依条件及经验，不能加成未验证分数。
cautions.en: Classification selects FNA and should not automatically trigger surgery from US alone; conditional CEUS/elastography refinements are not extra validated points.

name.zh: 患者信息提示报告系统
name.en: Information Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于在放射学报告中向患者传达值得关注信息的已发表沟通框架。
summary.en: A published communication framework for adding patient-facing messages about pertinent information to radiology reports.

domain.zh: 放射学报告中的患者沟通

sources.title: Information Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 用于常规非肿瘤门诊患者在门户或报告副本中阅读的通俗结果说明；原文排除肿瘤患者及危急结果，只研究两种讯息，不是完整病灶评分体系。
scope.en: Plain-language explanations for routine nononcologic outpatients reading portal results or report copies. The source excludes cancer patients and critical results and studies two messages rather than a complete lesion-scoring system.

sourcePages.zh: 第1–2页背景、实施及表1；第3页表3；第4页讨论与局限。
sourcePages.en: Pages 1–2, rationale, implementation and Table 1; page 3, Table 3; page 4, discussion and limitations.

purpose.zh: 放射科医师先完成专业报告和随访建议，再选择与结果一致的患者说明；此框架不要求额外影像序列。
purpose.en: Complete the professional interpretation and follow-up recommendation before choosing a matching patient explanation; no additional imaging sequence is required.

title.zh: 原文研究的两种讯息（概述，非逐字模板）
title.en: The two studied messages (paraphrases, not verbatim macros)

zh: 没有令人担忧的影像发现。
说明检查未见需担忧的结果；除非临床医生另有要求，不因本次结果安排额外随访。
en: Explain that the result is reassuring and does not itself require additional follow-up unless the clinician advises otherwise.

zh: 非严重发现，但需要与转诊医生随访讨论。
建议在常规门诊／办公时间联系医生讨论；不能写成必须立即联系或无须理会。
en: A nonserious finding requires follow-up with the referring provider.
Advise discussing the finding with the provider during normal office hours; neither immediate emergency contact nor dismissal is the intended message.

steps.zh: 将专业报告中的结论和推荐行动与通俗讯息逐项匹配；保留个体化临床安排优先。
steps.en: Match the plain-language message to the report conclusion and recommended action, retaining individualized clinical instructions.

steps.zh: 这两条讯息不覆盖严重或急症发现；不能为此自行推导“讯息3”或把所有报告强行归入1／2。
steps.en: The two messages do not cover serious or emergency findings; do not invent a message 3 or force every report into 1 or 2.

management.zh: 讯息1保留医生另有指示的例外；讯息2引导常规时间联系医生，具体检查或随访间隔仍由专业报告规定。
management.en: Message 1 retains the exception for other clinician instructions; message 2 directs routine contact, with specific tests or intervals supplied by the professional report.

cautions.zh: 原文表3显示讯息2有58%受访者认为需立即联系，而正文叙述为42%；两处矛盾，不能据此设定临床紧急程度。
cautions.en: Table 3 reports 58% interpreting message 2 as requiring immediate contact, whereas the narrative states 42%; this conflict cannot define clinical urgency.

cautions.zh: 受访者主要作为真实患者的替代样本；约半数从未读过影像报告，门户使用和人群差异限制外推。
cautions.en: Respondents largely served as patient surrogates, about half had never read a report, and portal access and demographic differences limit generalization.

name.zh: 肾脏影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Kidney Imaging Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 面向肾肿块影像分类的循证研发倡议；2025 年论文明确其为未来系统，ACR 当前列为开发中。
summary.en: An evidence-based development initiative for renal-mass imaging classification; its 2025 article describes a future system and ACR currently lists it as in development.

domain.zh: 肾肿块影像分类研发

sources.title: Kidney Imaging Reporting and Data System

title.zh: KI-RADS：2025假设性肾肿块分类框架

scope.zh: 原文提出将肾肿块癌症可能性与侵袭性联合表达的未来KI-RADS设想；表3是教学性假设算法，原文明确不适合立即临床使用。
scope.en: A proposed future framework combining kidney cancer likelihood with aggressiveness. Table 3 is a hypothetical teaching algorithm explicitly not intended for immediate clinical use.

sourcePages.zh: 第2–4页现有分类与表1–2；第6页图4；第8页图5、表3及脚注；第9页表4。
sourcePages.en: Pages 2–4, current classification and Tables 1–2; page 6, Figure 4; page 8, Figure 5 and Table 3 including its note; page 9, Table 4.

purpose.zh: 需要适当肾肿块协议评价囊性／实性成分、强化、宏观脂肪及局部范围；研究中还需标准化扩散、灌注和减影配准。
purpose.en: Appropriate renal mass protocols characterize cystic/solid tissue, enhancement, macroscopic fat and local extent; research also requires standardized diffusion, perfusion and subtraction registration.

title.zh: 假设性最终等级的含义

zh: 侵袭性癌的可能性不确定。

steps.zh: 先识别肾肿块并排除炎症、感染和血管性原因，再设想评价癌症可能性；不能把已确立的Bosniak等级直接当作KI-RADS总分。
steps.en: Identify the mass and exclude inflammatory, infectious and vascular etiologies before conceptual cancer-likelihood assessment; Bosniak classes are not interchangeable with final KI-RADS scores.

steps.zh: 表3把癌可能性与惰性／不确定／侵袭性组合：惰性特征使最高最终分为2；癌可能性3或4伴侵袭性分别升至4或5；癌可能性5但侵袭性不确定降为4。
steps.en: Table 3 combines cancer likelihood and behavior: indolent features cap the final score at 2; aggressive features raise likelihood 3/4 to final 4/5; likelihood 5 with indeterminate behavior becomes 4.

steps.zh: 尚需将标准化影像与分级、分期进展、转移及生存关联验证后，才能建立可用的预测和处理流程。
steps.en: Standardized imaging must be validated against grade, stage progression, metastases and survival before a usable prediction/management pathway can be established.

management.zh: 表3设想未来辅助选择观察、监测、活检或治疗，但没有经验证的等级对应时间或干预阈值；临床处理仍需既有肾肿块路径与患者整体情况。
management.en: Table 3 envisages future assistance with observation, surveillance, biopsy or treatment, without validated grade-specific intervals or intervention thresholds; clinical care still requires established renal mass pathways and holistic assessment.

cautions.zh: 假设性分数不可作为现成临床决策规则。癌症可能性与侵袭性是不同维度，不能把高癌可能性直接等同高侵袭性。
cautions.en: Hypothetical scores are not ready clinical decision rules. Cancer likelihood and aggressiveness are separate dimensions.

cautions.zh: 实性肿块整体大小／增长与侵袭性的关系不能直接套到囊性肿块；应研究强化组织而不是仅整体囊肿直径。
cautions.en: Relationships of size/growth and aggressiveness in solid masses cannot simply be transferred to cystic masses; enhancing tissue merits separate study.

name.zh: 肌肉骨骼外院影像会诊报告系统
name.en: Musculoskeletal Outside Interpretation Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于前瞻性追踪肌肉骨骼影像第二意见解读差异的已发表质量保证工具。
summary.en: A published quality-assurance tool for prospectively tracking discrepancies in second-opinion musculoskeletal image interpretations.

domain.zh: 肌肉骨骼影像第二意见质量评价
domain.en: Quality assessment of second-opinion musculoskeletal imaging

sources.title: Musculoskeletal Outside Interpretation Reporting and Data System

title.zh: MOI-RADS：2021外院骨肌影像复阅差异分级

scope.zh: 用于骨肌专科对外院影像的正式第二意见复阅，比较初次报告与复阅报告的一致性及潜在临床影响；等级描述报告差异，不是肿瘤风险评分。
scope.en: Formal subspecialist second-opinion review of outside musculoskeletal examinations, describing agreement with the primary report and potential clinical impact rather than tumor risk.

sourcePages.zh: 第2–3页方法与表1；第4页临床处理变化；第5–7页局限讨论。
sourcePages.en: Pages 2–3, methods and Table 1; page 4, changes in management; pages 5–7, limitations.

purpose.zh: 需获得外院原始图像和原报告；仅上传PACS供参考不等于正式复阅。记录复阅时新增临床、病理或随访信息。
purpose.en: Obtain the outside images and original report; archival upload alone is not a formal reinterpretation. Document new clinical, pathology or follow-up information available at review.

title.zh: 一致性、差异及新增信息编码

zh: 病变已被发现但解释不同，预计不影响临床处理。
en: Interpretation discrepancy unlikely to affect management.

zh: 病变检出存在差异，预计不影响临床处理。
en: Detection discrepancy unlikely to affect management.

zh: 病变解释存在差异，预计具有临床相关性。
病变检出存在差异，预计具有临床相关性。
复阅时获得原解读时可能没有的附加信息；D之后仍列对应一致性／差异子类。
en: Additional information likely unavailable at primary interpretation; append the applicable agreement/discrepancy category after D.

zh: 无法取得原报告，不能比较。
en: Original report is unavailable, preventing comparison.

steps.zh: 先核对原报告是否可用，不可用为X；如有新增信息记录D，然后比较具体影像所见和解释。
steps.en: First establish report availability: use X if absent; flag new information with D before comparing findings and interpretation.

steps.zh: 存在差异时区分检出d或解释i，再判断预计是否会改变诊断、预后、取材／随访、治疗或专科转诊，分别归B或C。
