steps.en: For discrepancies distinguish detection d from interpretation i, then assign B or C according to likely effects on diagnosis, prognosis, work-up, treatment or referral.

steps.zh: 报告末尾采用可检索的MOI-RADS编码，并描述差异依据；对新增信息情形不把D误当作更严重的风险级别。
steps.en: Append a searchable MOI-RADS code and the basis for discrepancy; D is a context flag rather than a higher-risk severity grade.

management.zh: 原文列举降阶（避免不必要活检／手术）、升级（新发现促使取材／手术）和改用针对性治疗；这些是复阅影响实例，编码本身不规定统一治疗。
management.en: The source describes de-escalation, escalation and diagnosis-directed treatment as observed review impacts; the codes do not dictate a universal treatment.

cautions.zh: C表示预计相关性，不保证实际处理已经改变；D提示信息不对等，X不代表原报告错误。
cautions.en: C indicates anticipated relevance rather than proven management change; D indicates unequal information and X does not imply primary-report error.

cautions.zh: 单中心三级转诊研究有病例选择、主观影响评价和长期模板使用下降等限制。
cautions.en: The single-center referral study is limited by case selection, subjective impact assessment and declining long-term template use.

name.zh: 检查指征影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Reason for Exam Imaging Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于标准化评估影像检查申请单中临床信息质量的已发表分级系统。
summary.en: A published grading system for standardized assessment of clinical-information quality in imaging requisitions.

domain.zh: 影像检查申请单质量评价

sources.title: Reason for Exam Imaging Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 评估影像申请单本身的临床信息充分性，适用于不同转诊群体；不评价病灶恶性风险，也不评价检查选择的适宜性。2019年提出的框架尚需内容效度、可靠性及效果验证。
scope.en: Assess the sufficiency of clinical information on imaging requisitions across referring groups, rather than lesion risk or test appropriateness. This 2019 proposal requires content-validity, reliability and outcome studies.

sourcePages.zh: 第2页表1及正文第4节，第3页实施与验证讨论。
sourcePages.en: Page 2, Table 1 and section 4; page 3, implementation and validation discussion.

purpose.zh: 只使用申请单上已提供的信息；医生后来从病历或电话获得的信息不能补入原申请单等级。
purpose.en: Grade only information supplied on the requisition; later chart review or telephone communication does not upgrade that original requisition.

zh: 临床印象／鉴别诊断、临床所见、具体诊断问题三类信息全部充分。
en: All three information domains are adequate: working/differential diagnosis, clinical findings and a specific diagnostic question.

zh: 三类均提供，但临床所见等部分信息不充分；属勉强充分。
en: All three domains are present but some clinical information is missing; barely adequate.

zh: 仅提供三类中的两类；信息明显有限。
en: Only two of the three domains are present; considerably limited information.

zh: 仅一类或完全没有相关信息；信息缺乏。
en: Only one domain, or none, is provided; deficient information.

zh: 症状体征、病程、部位、相关既往内外科史、实验室结果及可用既往影像。
en: Signs and symptoms, chronicity, location, relevant medical/surgical history, laboratory findings and available prior imaging.

zh: 明确此次检查用于确诊／排除、分期、术前计划、进展随访或疗效评价。
en: Specify confirmation/exclusion, staging, preoperative planning, progression surveillance or treatment-response assessment.

steps.zh: 先检查三类信息是否存在，再判断每类是否足够具体；三类全部充分为A，三类存在但不完整为B，只有两类为C，一类或无信息为D。
steps.en: Check presence and adequacy separately: all three adequate gives A; all three present but incomplete gives B; two gives C; one or none gives D.

steps.zh: 在报告中独立记录等级及缺失信息，用同一规则进行持续反馈和机构质量分析。
steps.en: Record the grade and missing information separately in the report and apply consistent criteria for feedback and quality analysis.

management.zh: 原文建议把等级作为报告独立部分，持续向转诊医生反馈并汇总申请单质量；未规定按等级取消检查或固定临床处理。
management.en: The source proposes a separate report section, ongoing feedback and aggregate requisition-quality review; it does not prescribe cancelling tests or fixed clinical management by grade.

cautions.zh: 这是信息质量框架，A并不保证申请单信息真实、检查适宜或影像诊断正确；不能转换为恶性概率。
cautions.en: A measures information completeness and does not guarantee accuracy, appropriateness or diagnostic correctness; it is not a malignancy probability.

cautions.zh: 本文是提案，预期收益不能视作已经完成前瞻性临床验证。
cautions.en: This is a proposal; expected benefits are not evidence of completed prospective clinical validation.

name.zh: 软组织影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Soft Tissue Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于软组织肿瘤及肿瘤样病变 MRI 的结构化报告框架；ACR 当前明确列为进行中项目。
summary.en: A structured MRI reporting framework for soft-tissue tumors and tumor-like lesions; ACR currently explicitly lists it as a works-in-progress program.

domain.zh: 软组织肿块 MRI 风险评估
domain.en: MRI risk assessment of soft-tissue masses

version: Accepted manuscript 2025; ACR works in progress

sources.title: Soft Tissue-RADS: An ACR Work-in-Progress Framework for Standardized Reporting of Soft-Tissue Lesions on MRI

title.en: Soft Tissue-RADS: MRI classification in the 2025 accepted manuscript

scope.zh: 根据本地AJR 2025接受稿，评估MRI所见软组织肿瘤与瘤样病变，涵盖未治疗分类及既往／正在治疗病灶的6A–6C；原文称ACR进行中框架，不能标为已正式定稿版本。
scope.en: Based on the local AJR 2025 accepted manuscript for MRI soft-tissue tumors and tumor-like lesions, including untreated categories and6A–6C for previously/currently treated lesions. The source describes an ACR work-in-progress, not a finalized release.

sourcePages.zh: 第5–7页技术；第8–12页分类；第16页表2；第17–18页表3；第19–20页报告模板；第21–25页图1与图2全部分支。
sourcePages.en: Pages5–7, technique; pages8–12, categories; page16, Table 2; pages17–18, Table3; pages19–20, template; pages21–25, Figures1–2 including all tissue branches.

purpose.zh: 最低协议为轴位T1、液体敏感序列及增强前后脂抑T1；组织信号分析需非脂抑T2。DWI／ADC可选，表2样例b=5、400、800 s/mm²，正文为50、400、800。典型脂肪瘤等可由监测医师决定免增强；约2周内的既往MRI可补齐缺失序列。
purpose.en: The minimum protocol is axial T1, fluid-sensitive imaging and pre/postcontrast fat-suppressed T1; non-fat-suppressed T2 aids tissue characterization. DWI/ADC is optional: sample Table 2 b-values are 5, 400, 800 s/mm² versus 50, 400, 800 in the text. A monitoring radiologist may omit contrast for certain classic benign lesions; prior MRI within approximately 2 weeks can supply missing sequences.

purpose.zh: 标记症状位置，描述三径、组织成分、间室、血管神经／骨关系、扩散与强化；已治疗病灶与治疗前影像对照并直接进入6。
purpose.en: Mark the clinical site and document three dimensions, composition, compartment, neurovascular/bone relations, diffusion and enhancement; treated lesions are compared with pretreatment images and directly enter6.

title.zh: 类别、治疗后子类与处理

zh: 检查不完整，无法可靠判读。
补缺失MRI／既往片；可用US查血流或X线／CT查矿化。
en: Obtain missing MRI/prior studies, US for flow or radiography/CT for mineralization.

zh: 没有真正软组织肿瘤／瘤样病灶，可仅为解剖或脂肪骨性突起。
en: No true soft-tissue tumor/tumor-like lesion, including anatomic fatty/osseous prominence.

zh: 典型确定良性病变，风险近零。
按临床需要治疗或随访；血管畸形可请介入专科。
en: Classic definitely benign lesion, nearly zero risk.
Treatment/follow-up as clinically needed; consider vascular intervention consultation for malformations.

zh: 倾向良性，或典型良性但对组织类型仍有疑问。
可于6周–3个月、6个月、1年、2年复查，消退后可停止；血肿随访至消退。
en: Probably benign, or classic benign with residual histologic doubt.
Consider imaging at 6 weeks–3 months, 6 months, 1 year, 2 years, stopping after resolution; follow hematomas to resolution.

zh: 活检或4–6周复查后持续至2年；≥5 cm或某些小解剖区域病灶应取材／转诊；阴性活检需影像病理一致性讨论。
en: Suspicious for malignancy or local aggressiveness.
Biopsy or imaging at 4–6 weeks followed through 2 years; ≥5 cm or selected smaller-region lesions warrant tissue diagnosis/referral; review negative biopsy for imaging-pathology concordance.

zh: 高度疑肉瘤／其他恶性肿瘤。
组织学诊断并转诊肉瘤中心。
已治疗病灶，无残留证据；可有预期水肿／强化，但无肿块或明显受限扩散。
恶性可按6周–3个月、6个月、1年、2年随访；良性可症状时或6–12个月复查。
en: Treated lesion without residual tumor, allowing expected edema/enhancement without a mass or substantial restriction.
Malignant lesions: consider 6 weeks–3 months, 6 months, 1 year, 2 years; benign: symptomatic or 6–12-month follow-up.

zh: 有残留病灶，最大径较治疗前增幅≤20%，ADC相似或升高。
按临床选择切除／治疗；不干预者可按上述周期随访。
en: Residual lesion with ≤20% maximum-dimension increase from pretreatment and similar/increased ADC.
Surgery/other treatment as clinically appropriate, or follow-up on the stated schedule if not treated.

zh: 复发／进展，例为最大径较治疗前增加>20%或受限扩散增加，可伴转移。
按临床选择切除／治疗或随访。
en: Recurrent/progressive lesion, e.g. >20% maximum-dimension growth or increased restriction, possibly with metastases.
Further surgery/treatment or surveillance according to clinical context.

title.zh: 图1–2组织与间室判定分支

zh: 宏观脂肪→脂肪性；无脂肪而T2明显高且增强<20%→囊样／高水；其余走不确定实性。
en: Macroscopic fat → lipomatous; without fat, markedly high T2 with <20% enhancement → cyst-like/high water; otherwise indeterminate solid.

zh: 与皮下脂肪相似且无结节／仅<2 mm细隔→2；细隔或增强<10%时，显著血管多→3、少→4；≥2 mm厚隔或增强>10%→4。
en: Matching subcutaneous fat without nodules or with <2 mm septa →2; thin septa OR <10% enhancement: many prominent vessels →3, few prominent vessels →4; ≥2 mm septa or >10% enhancement →4.

zh: 无强化结节或脂肪部分大于非脂肪组织→4；有强化结节或脂肪部分相对小→5。先识别可典型良性混合脂肪病灶。
en: No enhancing nodules or proportionately dominant fat →4; enhancing nodules or proportionately smaller fat →5, after excluding classic benign mixed-fat entities.

zh: 与关节／腱鞘／滑囊交通、皮肤／皮下或神经内位置，或以流空／液液平为主的血管相关模式可2；血肿特征→3并随访消退。
en: Communication with joint/sheath/bursa, cutaneous/subcutaneous or intraneural location, or a vascular flow-void/fluid-level pattern can yield2; hematoma features →3 with follow-up to resolution.

zh: 囊样／高水：深部复杂结构
无交通／深部且不以流空／液液平为主：无厚强化隔且壁结节<1 cm为3或4；厚强化隔、壁结节≥1 cm或大实性部分→5。
en: Noncommunicating/deep lesions without dominant flow voids/fluid levels: no thick enhancing septa and mural nodules <1 cm →3 or4; thick enhancing septa, ≥1 cm mural nodules or a large solid component →5.

zh: 肌肉特征性信号→2；无此特征但既往损伤、周围水肿及成熟周边矿化→3；否则4或5。
en: Muscle signature →2; without it, prior injury plus edema and mature peripheral mineralization →3; otherwise4 or5.

zh: 增粗腱伴钙化、囊变、脂肪或相关淀粉样／自身免疫背景→2；正常大小腱、GRE含铁血黄素晕染→3；无晕染→4或5。
en: Enlarged tendon with calcification/cystic change/fat or relevant systemic history →2; normal-sized tendon with GRE hemosiderin blooming →3; no blooming →4 or5.

zh: 筋膜结节<2 cm→2；≥2 cm且多灶／融合→3；≥2 cm且不多灶／融合→4或5。
en: Fascial nodule <2 cm →2; ≥2 cm with multifocal/conglomerate nodules →3; ≥2 cm without that pattern →4 or5.
T2-bright and diffusely enhancing: <1 cm →3, ≥1 cm →4.

zh: T2高小叶伴低信号静脉石和液液平→2；无静脉石／液液平的实性血管相关病灶→4或5，先排血栓／血栓静脉炎等。
en: T2-bright lobules with dark phleboliths and fluid levels →2; solid vessel-related lesions without these →4 or5 after excluding thrombus/thrombophlebitis and other specified mimics.

zh: CT／X线骨化钙化或明显T2高灶→2；否则GRE晕染→3；无晕染但T2高且周边强化→3，T2低且无周边强化→4。
en: Calcification/ossification on CT/radiographs or prominent high-T2 foci →2; otherwise GRE blooming →3; without blooming, high T2 with peripheral enhancement →3, low T2 without peripheral enhancement →4.

zh: 靶征→2；无靶征且ADC>1.1（按×10−3 mm²/s语境）→3；ADC≤1.1→4或5。
en: Target sign →2; without target sign, ADC >1.1 (in the ×10−3 mm²/s context) →3; ADC ≤1.1 →4 or5.

zh: 向外生长→4；向内生长且仅周边强化→2；内部强化→4或5。
en: Exophytic →4; endophytic with peripheral-only enhancement →2; internal enhancement →4 or5.

zh: 实性强化结节、筋膜尾或跨筋膜间室、坏死／出血、周围水肿、低ADC、迅速增大／症状、区域或远处转移。
en: Solid enhancing nodules, fascial tail/crossed compartments, necrosis/hemorrhage, edema, low ADC, rapid growth/symptoms or regional/distant metastases favor5.

steps.zh: 先核对有无既往／正在治疗的已知病灶，有则进入6A–6C；否则完整性不足为0，无真病灶为1。
steps.en: Known previously/currently treated lesions enter6A–6C; otherwise incomplete imaging gives0 and absence of a true lesion gives1.

steps.zh: 未治疗真实病灶按脂肪、囊样／高水、不确定实性分流；实性必须按病灶中心所在解剖间室选对应分支。
steps.en: Route untreated lesions by fat, cyst-like/high-water or indeterminate-solid composition; choose solid branches according to the epicenter compartment.

steps.zh: 有4／5双选出口时综合侵袭征象和临床背景，不以一个ADC值替代完整判定；报告理由并保持影像病理对应。
steps.en: At4/5 alternatives integrate aggressive features and context rather than replacing the assessment with one ADC value; document rationale and imaging-pathology concordance.

management.zh: 按类别表建议选择补影像、随访、活检或肉瘤中心转诊；疑恶性活检阴性需多学科一致性复核，不自动降至良性。
management.en: Use the category table for additional imaging, surveillance, biopsy or sarcoma-center referral; a negative biopsy in a suspicious lesion needs multidisciplinary concordance review, not automatic benign downgrading.

cautions.zh: 接受稿部分ADC阈值漏印×10−3：表3同时有>1.5×10−3和1.1–1.5 mm²/s，图2写1.1 mm²/s，附录报告单位为×10−3 mm²/s。本页标明此单位不一致，不按字面错误数量级使用。
cautions.en: Some accepted-manuscript ADC thresholds omit ×10−3: Table3 mixes >1.5×10−3 with1.1–1.5 mm²/s, Figure2 prints1.1 mm²/s, and the appendix uses ×10−3 mm²/s. This unit inconsistency must not be interpreted literally at the wrong magnitude.

cautions.zh: 图2的10%强化分支采用<／>、未说明恰好10%；表3良性脂肪瘤还提≤10 cm，而流程图未将大小单独设闸。本页保留差异，不能补造统一边界。
cautions.en: Figure2 uses </>10% without defining exactly10%; Table3 also describes benign lipomatous lesions up to10 cm without a separate size gate in the flowchart. Retain these differences rather than inventing a unified boundary.

cautions.zh: 图2C／D的图注与实际图中间室组合顺序不一致，本页按真实图内的解剖间室名称呈现；原文框架尚需可靠性与临床实施验证。
cautions.en: Figure2C/D captions and actual compartment group order differ; this reference uses the anatomical labels inside the diagrams. Reliability and implementation require validation.

cautions.zh: 正文DWI低b值为50，表2为5 s/mm²；属于示例协议差异，不据此设置统一强制采集参数。
cautions.en: The text uses a low b-value of50 while Table 2 uses5 s/mm²; these are example-protocol differences, not a universal mandatory acquisition parameter.

name.zh: 膀胱影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Vesical Imaging Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 用于膀胱癌多参数 MRI 的标准化方案与肌层浸润可能性评分系统。
summary.en: A standardized multiparametric-MRI protocol and scoring system for assessing the likelihood of muscle invasion in bladder cancer.

organization: International expert group / American College of Radiology (ACR)

domain.zh: 膀胱癌多参数 MRI 局部分期
domain.en: Multiparametric-MRI local staging of bladder cancer

sources.title: Vesical Imaging Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 2018年膀胱癌多参数MRI肌层侵犯风险框架：T2结构SC、DCE增强CE、DWI/ADC弥散DW各1–5，再合成整体1–5。优先在TURBT前评估，不替代病理。 原文明确包括未治疗患者uVI-RADS，以及仅接受诊断性TURBT、准备再TURBT的tVI-RADS。
scope.en: The 2018 bladder-cancer mpMRI framework grades T2 structure (SC), DCE enhancement (CE) and DWI/ADC (DW) from 1–5 and integrates an overall 1–5. Prefer pre-TURBT assessment; pathology remains essential. The source explicitly covers untreated uVI-RADS and tVI-RADS after diagnostic-only TURBT before re-TURBT.

sourcePages.zh: PDF第3–9页；表1–2，图1–4，特别第7–8页评分矩阵。
sourcePages.en: PDF pages 3–9; Tables 1–2 and Figures 1–4, especially the scoring matrix on pages 7–8.

purpose.zh: MRI最好在TURBT／活检／膀胱内治疗前或至少2周后；条件允许时距膀胱镜或导尿管移除2–3天。保持适度充盈（约300 mL），充盈不足可补水后30–60分钟复扫，过度充盈可部分排空。
purpose.en: Prefer MRI before or ≥2 weeks after TURBT, biopsy or intravesical therapy; allow 2–3 days after cystoscopy/Foley removal when feasible. Aim for appropriate filling (~300 mL), repeat after fluids in 30–60 minutes if underfilled, or partially empty if overfilled.

purpose.zh: 1.5或3 T、多通道体线圈；T2至少两个平面、3–4 mm层厚；DWI高b约800–1000 s/mm²并配ADC；DCE早期约注射后30秒开始，间隔30秒重复4–6次。覆盖膀胱、近端尿道、盆腔结及邻近器官；T1另识别血液／血块。
purpose.en: Use 1.5/3 T with a multichannel surface coil; T2 in ≥2 planes at 3–4 mm, high-b DWI around 800–1000 s/mm² with ADC, and early DCE beginning ~30 seconds after injection then repeated 4–6 times every 30 seconds. Cover bladder, proximal urethra, nodes and adjacent organs; T1 identifies hemorrhage/clot.

title.zh: 三个序列的独立子评分

zh: SC：<1 cm外生肿瘤，有或无蒂／增厚内层，肌层低T2线连续。CE：肌层无早期强化。DW：肿瘤高DWI、低ADC，但中等DWI信号肌层连续；可有低信号蒂／内层。
en: SC: <1 cm exophytic tumor with/without stalk/thickened inner layer and uninterrupted low-T2 muscle line. CE: no early muscle enhancement. DW: high-DWI/low-ADC tumor with continuous intermediate-DWI muscle; low-signal stalk/inner layer may occur.

zh: SC：>1 cm，低T2肌层连续；外生肿瘤有蒂和／或高T2增厚内层，或广基／无蒂肿瘤伴高T2增厚内层。CE：内层早期强化但肌层无。DW：>1 cm肿瘤，肌层连续；低DWI蒂／增厚内层，广基者内层低／中DWI。
en: SC: >1 cm with uninterrupted muscle line and stalk/high-T2 thickened inner layer, or sessile/broad-based tumor with high-T2 thickened inner layer. CE: early inner-layer but not muscle enhancement. DW: >1 cm tumor with continuous muscle and low-DWI stalk/inner layer, or low/intermediate-DWI inner layer in sessile tumors.

zh: SC：无2类保护性征象，外生肿瘤无蒂或广基肿瘤无高T2内层，但肌层线无明确中断。CE／DW：无2类内层征象，仍无明确肌层破坏。
en: SC: absence of category 2 protective findings, e.g. stalkless exophytic or broad-based tumor without high-T2 inner layer, but no clear muscle-line disruption. CE/DW: no category 2 inner-layer findings and no clear muscle disruption.

zh: SC：肌层低T2线中断，中等信号肿瘤进入肌层。CE：早期肿瘤强化局灶进入肌层。DW：高DWI／低ADC肿瘤局灶进入肌层。
en: SC: interrupted low-T2 line with intermediate-signal tumor entering muscle. CE: early tumor enhancement focally enters muscle. DW: high-DWI/low-ADC tumor focally enters muscle.

zh: SC：中等信号肿瘤穿透全壁进入膀胱外脂肪。CE：早期强化延伸穿全壁至外脂肪。DW：高DWI／低ADC穿全壁至外脂肪。
en: SC: intermediate-signal tumor traverses the entire wall into extravesical fat. CE: early enhancement traverses wall into fat. DW: high-DWI/low-ADC tumor extends through the wall into fat.

title.zh: 整体评分组合（按原文，不取简单最高子分）
title.en: Overall combinations (not a simple maximum subscore)

en: All 2, or SC3 with CE2 and DW2.
All 3, or SC3 with one of CE/DW3 and the other 2.

zh: SC和／或DW及CE4，剩余3或4；或SC3但DW和／或CE4；或SC5但DW和／或CE4。图4允许SC4由CE4或DW4支持。
en: SC and/or DW and CE4 with remaining 3/4; or SC3 with DW and/or CE4; or SC5 with DW and/or CE4. Figure 4 permits SC4 supported by CE4 or DW4.

zh: 至少SC5并DW和／或CE5，剩余4或5；反映肌层及膀胱外侵犯。
en: At least SC5 plus DW and/or CE5, with remaining 4/5, indicating muscle and extravesical invasion.

steps.zh: T2先判断形态与肌层，尤其1–3；明确肌层侵犯主要由质量良好的DWI、其次DCE确认。T2与DCE差两级时用合格DWI解读分歧；DWI差时更依赖DCE。
steps.en: Use T2 first for morphology and muscle, especially 1–3; definitive invasion relies primarily on adequate DWI and then DCE. With a two-category T2/DCE discrepancy, use good-quality DWI to resolve it; place greater weight on DCE if DWI is poor.

steps.zh: 报告病灶位置、数量、最大／最侵袭指数病灶、形态／尺寸、三个子分及整体分；另报穿壁、邻近器官、盆腔结和骨。
steps.en: Map lesions and record number, largest/most invasive index lesion, morphology/size, three subscores and overall score; separately document transmural extension, adjacent organs, pelvic nodes and bones.

management.zh: 原文讨论MRI如何辅助TURBT及治疗规划，但未给各VI-RADS分数固定复查、切除或化疗算法；组织学确认仍为诊断基础，分期治疗由泌尿团队结合病理制定。
management.en: MRI may assist TURBT and treatment planning, but the paper gives no fixed surveillance, resection or chemotherapy algorithm for each score. Histologic confirmation remains fundamental and urologic management incorporates pathology.

cautions.zh: 原始共识需进一步验证；炎症、治疗后改变、充盈不足和DWI伪影可高估或妨碍分期，MRI对原位癌识别较不可靠。
cautions.en: The original consensus requires further validation; inflammation, post-treatment changes, poor filling and DWI artifacts can overstage or impair staging, and MRI is less reliable for carcinoma in situ.

cautions.zh: 原文SC/DW1使用<1 cm、2使用>1 cm，恰1 cm未单独规定。本节不擅改成≥1 cm；其余序列组合以图4及正文共同说明，不用任意最高子分规则。
cautions.en: The source uses <1 cm for SC/DW1 and >1 cm for 2, leaving exactly 1 cm unspecified. This guide does not silently change it to ≥1 cm and follows Figure 4/prose integration rather than an arbitrary maximum-score rule.

name.zh: 病毒性肺炎影像报告和数据系统
name.en: Viral Pneumonia Imaging Reporting and Data System

summary.zh: 基于 COVID-19 病例经验提出的胸部 CT 病毒性肺炎报告系统。
summary.en: A published chest-CT viral-pneumonia reporting system based on COVID-19 experience.

domain.zh: 病毒性肺炎 CT 评估

sources.title: Viral Pneumonia Imaging Reporting and Data System

scope.zh: 2020年病毒性肺炎报告框架的COVID-19版本，以CT、临床及流行病学共同分0–4，另用F表示确诊病例随访。
scope.en: The COVID-19 version of the 2020 viral-pneumonia framework combines CT, clinical and epidemiologic information into 0–4, with F for follow-up of confirmed cases.

sourcePages.en: PDF pages 2–4 and 6–10 (1429–1431 and 1433–1437); Table 1 and Figures 1–6.

purpose.zh: 评估急性肺渗出、非解剖分布的周边多叶GGO、实变及其他病因；核对接触／流行史、症状、细菌感染证据、RT-PCR或病原血清学，不是单一CT可能性分。
purpose.en: Assess acute exudation, nonanatomic peripheral multilobar GGO, consolidation and alternative causes; verify exposure/epidemiology, symptoms, bacterial evidence, RT-PCR or serology. This is not a CT-only suspicion score.

zh: CT全部或部分不能识别／评估；技术人员立即判断补扫必要性，无法去除伪影须在报告说明。
en: CT cannot be fully recognized/assessed; immediately determine need for additional scanning and explain unavoidable artifacts.

zh: 无急性渗出；或GGO超过2周无变化。不明确排除感染；有明确流行史时建议短期随访，其他检查／治疗依据临床。
en: No acute exudation, or GGO unchanged for >2 weeks. Infection is not definitively excluded; recommend short-term follow-up with confirmed epidemiology and tailor tests/treatment to clinical data.

zh: 急性渗出有明确其他病因：单叶／段肺炎伴黄痰和细菌血检，或水肿、出血、挫伤、梗死、放射性肺炎等。按病因处理，治疗后考虑近期LDCT。
en: Acute exudation with clear alternative cause: single-lobe/segment pneumonia with yellow sputum and bacterial blood findings, or edema, hemorrhage, contusion, infarction, radiation pneumonitis, etc. Treat the cause and consider recent post-treatment LDCT.

zh: 急性渗出，既不像明确细菌肺炎也不具典型COVID-19影像：散在多叶、非解剖分布／周边GGO，无明确细菌或其他病因，且无已知流行史；COVID-19不能排除。
en: Acute exudation neither typical bacterial pneumonia nor characteristic COVID-19: scattered multilobar nonanatomic/peripheral GGO, no clear bacterial/other cause and no known epidemiologic history; COVID-19 remains possible.

zh: 急性渗出＋明确流行史且无细菌／其他病因；或具有COVID-19特征性影像，不论有无流行证据。提示高度可能。
en: Acute exudation plus definite epidemiology without bacterial/alternative evidence, or characteristic COVID-19 imaging with or without epidemiologic evidence. High possibility.

zh: 确诊COVID-19随访，报告进展、白肺、稳定、部分吸收、完全吸收及并发／继发病变；不是第5级概率。
en: Follow-up of confirmed COVID-19: describe progression, white lung, stability, partial/complete resolution and complications/secondary disease; not a fifth probability grade.

steps.zh: 先确定CT可评估性与急性渗出，再排明确替代病因；3类需联合上述全部条件，4类正文允许典型影像即使无已知流行史。不能机械按表1的简短描述漏掉这个分支。
steps.en: Check adequacy and acute exudation, then definite alternatives. Category 3 requires the combined conditions above; the category 4 prose permits characteristic imaging without known epidemiology, a branch omitted from the short Table 1 description.

management.zh: 疫情暴发场景下3需警示性／危急值通报、紧急专科会诊、病原检测及LDCT复查；4启动危急值通报和院内预防治疗专家组多学科响应。
management.en: During an outbreak, 3 warrants critical-value communication, urgent specialist review, virologic testing and repeat LDCT; 4 activates critical reporting and hospital prevention/treatment multidisciplinary response.

management.zh: F持续评估疗效，病情变化可用CT；严重／危重病例可按需用连续胸片代CT监测。原文将24–48小时病灶进展>50%列为按重症处理的情况。
management.en: Continue response assessment in F, using CT when condition changes; serial radiographs may replace CT as clinically needed in severe/critical cases. The paper identifies >50% lesion progression within 24–48 hours as requiring severe-case management.

cautions.zh: 1–2作为病毒肺炎阴性CT、3–4作为阳性CT只是该版用法，阴性仍不排除COVID-19；作者要求更多数据评估体系。
cautions.en: The version treats 1–2 as negative and 3–4 as positive CT for viral pneumonia, but negativity does not exclude COVID-19; the authors call for further evaluation.

cautions.zh: 管理建议限定在原文2020年疫情场景；本节不把它声明为现行院感或治疗政策。
cautions.en: Management suggestions belong to the paper’s 2020 outbreak setting and are not presented as current infection-control or treatment policy.

name.zh: Bone-RADS（骨肿瘤）
name.en: Bone-RADS (Bone Tumor)

summary.zh: 用于骨肿瘤风险分层的 ACR 骨病变评分框架。以下教学性类别仅适用于该骨肿瘤来源。
summary.en: An ACR bone-tumor risk-stratification framework. The teaching categories below apply only to this bone-tumor source.

domain.zh: 骨肿瘤风险评估

meaning.zh: 现有资料不足以可靠预测风险，需进一步评估。
meaning.en: Available information cannot reliably predict risk and requires further evaluation.

meaning.zh: 表现符合良性骨病变类别。
meaning.en: Findings fall in the benign bone-lesion category.

meaning.zh: 表现倾向良性。
meaning.en: Findings favor a benign lesion.

meaning.zh: 风险未定，需要进一步表征或随访。
meaning.en: Risk remains indeterminate and needs further characterization or follow-up.

meaning.zh: 存在提示恶性或需专科处理的可疑特征。
meaning.en: Suspicious features may indicate malignancy or need specialist management.

explanation.zh: 可能为肿瘤性的骨病变；需结合病史、影像表现及必要的进一步检查判断。
explanation.en: A bone lesion that may be neoplastic and requires assessment in clinical and imaging context.

explanation.zh: ACR 对该项目的当前分类，表示尚不足以支持常规临床使用。
explanation.en: ACR's current program classification, indicating insufficient evidence for routine clinical use.

sources.title: Bone Tumor Risk Stratification and Management System

scope.zh: 用于X线发现的潜在肿瘤性骨病变，以影像危险征象和原发癌病史的分值之和分层。此处是ACR骨肿瘤体系，不是SSR 2022偶发孤立骨病灶CT/MRI的Bone-RADS 1–4处理算法。
scope.en: For potentially neoplastic bone lesions identified on radiographs, summing risk features and primary-cancer history. This is the ACR bone-tumor system, distinct from the SSR 2022 incidental solitary CT/MRI bone-lesion Bone-RADS 1–4 management algorithm.

sourcePages.zh: 第2–7页风险评估、表1–2及征象定义，第9–10页表3与处理，第11–13页实例
sourcePages.en: Pages 2–7, risk assessment/Tables 1–2/definitions; pages 9–10, Table 3/management; pages 11–13, examples

purpose.zh: 用正交X线评估边缘、骨破坏方式、骨膜反应、皮质侵蚀、骨折和骨外肿块；另记录位置、数量、大小、密度和基质，并结合年龄及原发癌病史。
purpose.en: Use orthogonal radiographs to assess margin/destruction, periosteal response, endosteal erosion, fracture and extraosseous mass. Also record location/count/size/density/matrix and review age/primary-cancer history.

purpose.zh: 边缘用修订Lodwick-Madewell分型；多种边缘取最高危险表现。侵蚀深度相对皮质厚度：轻度<1/3、中度1/3至2/3、深度>2/3。不能充分定性则0类，不把缺失观察当作0分。
purpose.en: Use modified Lodwick-Madewell margin grading, prioritizing the highest-risk pattern. Grade erosion relative to cortex: mild <1/3, moderate 1/3–2/3, deep >2/3. Inadequate characterization is category 0, not a zero score for unassessed features.

title.zh: 六项计分：每项选对应值后累加
title.en: Six scoring inputs: select applicable points then sum

zh: IA：地图样、边界清、硬化缘=1；IB：地图样、边界清、无硬化缘=3；II：地图样、边界不清=5；IIIA–C：变化的边缘、虫蚀／渗透样或其他影像显示的X线隐匿病变=7。
en: IA: geographic, well defined, sclerotic rim=1; IB: geographic, well defined without sclerosis=3; II: geographic ill-defined=5; IIIA–C: changing margin, moth-eaten/permeative or radiographically occult lesion shown on other imaging=7.

zh: 无=0；非侵袭性（连续、实性等）=2；侵袭性（断续、针状、Codman三角等）=4。
en: None=0; nonaggressive, such as solid uninterrupted response=2; aggressive, such as interrupted/spiculated/Codman reaction=4.

title.en: Point total → Bone-RADS category → source management

zh: 追加X线体位或断层影像；尚不能可靠估计风险。
en: Additional views or cross-sectional imaging; risk cannot yet be reliably assigned.

zh: 无症状可完成评估或年度随访；有症状／症状改变考虑进一步影像与骨肿瘤专科。
en: If asymptomatic, complete workup or annual surveillance; symptoms/change may warrant advanced imaging and orthopedic oncology.

zh: 3–6个月复查稳定性；可进一步影像、必要时确认良性的活检或骨肿瘤专科。
en: Surveillance in 3–6 months; consider advanced imaging, biopsy to confirm benignity when needed or orthopedic oncology.

zh: 骨肿瘤专科评估，通常考虑活检及治疗规划，CT／MRI／骨扫描进一步定性。
en: Orthopedic oncology for probable biopsy/planning; further CT/MRI/bone scan characterization.

zh: 骨肿瘤专科、建议活检及治疗规划；进一步影像分期和寻找其他病灶。
en: Orthopedic oncology, recommended biopsy/planning and advanced imaging for staging/additional disease.

steps.zh: 判断是否能充分表征；不能则0并补充影像。能表征时按六项选值：边缘、骨膜反应、侵蚀、骨折、骨外肿块和癌病史。
steps.en: Establish adequate characterization first; otherwise assign 0 and obtain further imaging. For characterized lesions select points for all six inputs.

steps.zh: 总分相加后按1–2、3–4、5–6、≥7转换为1–4类。部位、大小、基质及肿瘤具体鉴别诊断用于解释，不另加未经原文规定的分数。
steps.en: Sum points and map 1–2, 3–4, 5–6 and ≥7 to categories 1–4. Site, size, matrix and histologic differential inform interpretation but receive no extra points outside the source.

steps.zh: 例如IB边缘3分+中度侵蚀1分+其余0分=4分→2类；IA边缘1分+侵袭性骨膜反应4分=5分→3类。报告同时给危险征象、总分和类别。
steps.en: Example: IB margin 3 plus moderate erosion 1 and all other inputs 0 yields four points/category 2. IA margin 1 plus aggressive periosteal response 4 yields five points/category 3. Report features, total and category together.

management.zh: 按表结合症状与骨折风险处理，活检路径和后续治疗由骨肿瘤团队规划；典型良性但症状明显的病变也可能需要治疗。
management.en: Use the table together with symptoms/fracture risk; the orthopedic tumor team plans biopsy and treatment. A typical benign lesion with significant symptoms may still require care.

management.zh: 3／4类风险增加不等于已经病理确诊；原文建议进一步影像和专科转诊以安排诊断与分期。
management.en: Categories 3/4 increase concern but are not pathologic proof; the source recommends further imaging and referral for diagnosis/staging.

cautions.zh: 侵袭性骨膜反应也可见于骨髓炎等良性病因，计分描述危险性而非直接判定组织学。
cautions.en: Aggressive periosteal reaction can occur in benign processes such as osteomyelitis; scoring expresses risk rather than histology.

cautions.zh: 原文分值由专家共识制定，仍需进一步验证；不要把ACR分数与SSR同名类别的管理建议交叉套用。
cautions.en: Point weights are expert consensus and need further validation. Do not cross-apply ACR scoring and management from identically named SSR categories.

name.zh: Bone-RADS（孤立骨病变）
name.en: Bone-RADS (Incidental Solitary Bone Lesion)

summary.zh: 用于成人偶发孤立骨病变的 CT/MRI 管理算法；未转录原文算法前仅提供来源。
summary.en: A CT/MRI management algorithm for incidental solitary bone lesions in adults; source-only until the original algorithm is transcribed.

domain.zh: 偶发孤立骨病变 CT/MRI 管理
domain.en: CT/MRI management of incidental solitary bone lesions

sources.title: Guidelines for the diagnostic management of incidental solitary bone lesions on CT and MRI in adults

title.en: Bone-RADS: SSR 2022 incidental solitary bone lesions in adults

scope.zh: 用于成人CT或MRI偶然发现、与此次检查目的无关的单个骨病灶；不适用于儿童或多发病灶。与ACR 2023骨肿瘤六项积分体系不同，本体系输出处理类别。
scope.en: Adult solitary bone lesions found incidentally on CT/MRI performed for an unrelated indication; excludes children and multiple lesions. Unlike the ACR 2023 six-item bone tumor score, this SSR framework yields management categories.

sourcePages.zh: 第2–7页定义与表1；第3–4页图1A–D；第8–13页CT/MRI算法；第14页骨岛HU与增长限制。
sourcePages.en: Pages 2–7, definitions and Table 1; pages 3–4, Figure 1A–D; pages 8–13, CT/MRI algorithms; page 14, enostosis HU and growth limitations.

purpose.zh: 按周围骨小梁密度分透亮（>90%体积透亮）或硬化／混合；ROI置于代表区域，尽量使用平扫，避免增强抬高HU。
purpose.en: Classify lucent (>90% lucent volume) versus sclerotic/mixed relative to trabecular bone; place a representative ROI and use noncontrast measurements where possible.

purpose.zh: 首先需要T1，再看T2、脂肪抑制、化学位移与增强；无T1需补充。结合疼痛归因、癌史和可用X线。
purpose.en: T1 is essential before T2, fat suppression, chemical shift and contrast; obtain missing T1. Integrate attributable pain, cancer history and available radiographs.

title.en: Four management categories, not an additive score

zh: 换用不同模态或补充所需序列。
en: Use a different modality or required additional sequences.

zh: 不确定，但无须立即取材的明确危险征象。
间隔6、6、12个月复查，共2年（初次后6、12、24个月）。
en: Indeterminate without a definite immediate biopsy indication.
Follow-up at intervals of 6, 6 and 12 months over 2 years (6,12,24 months from baseline).

zh: 疑恶性或良性病变仍需要治疗／防骨折。
活检和／或骨肿瘤专科转诊。
en: Suspicious for malignancy or needs treatment, including some benign fracture-risk lesions.

zh: 病灶所致疼痛、皮质受累（隧道样、内膜扇贝样、重塑／膨胀、增厚）、软组织扩展、病理骨折、侵袭性骨膜反应任一项→4。
en: Pain attributable to the lesion, cortical involvement (tunneling, scalloping, remodeling/expansion, thickening), soft-tissue extension, fracture or aggressive periosteal reaction → 4.

zh: 无危险征象但有易骨转移癌史
考虑FDG-PET、骨显像或MRI（2），或影像随访（3）；癌史包括肾、前列腺、乳腺、肺、甲状腺等。
en: Consider PET, bone scan or MRI (2), or follow-up (3), for relevant kidney, prostate, breast, lung or thyroid cancer history.

zh: 宏观脂肪或典型纤维异常增殖、非骨化性纤维瘤、内生软骨瘤、软骨下囊肿、血管瘤且无危险征象→1。
en: Lucent: fat or classic benign appearance
Macroscopic fat or unequivocal fibrous dysplasia, NOF, enchondroma, subchondral cyst or hemangioma without concerning features → 1.

zh: 皮质病灶符合骨样骨瘤／骨母细胞瘤／皮质转移，或明确骨髓囊肿、巨细胞瘤、软骨母细胞瘤、骨髓瘤／转移等需4；未能明确类型可2或3。
en: Characteristic cortical osteoid osteoma/osteoblastoma/metastasis or definite medullary cyst, giant cell tumor, chondroblastoma, myeloma/metastasis requires 4; otherwise uncharacterized lesions can be 2 or 3.

zh: 典型骨岛、骨瘤、硬化性骨发育异常或非骨化性纤维瘤→1；纯硬化平均>885 HU支持骨岛，但不能对所有硬化病灶套用。骨岛可增长，原文预期6个月增长<25%或1年<50%。
en: Sclerotic/mixed: enostosis and other benign entities

Classic enostosis, osteoma, sclerosing dysplasia or NOF → 1; mean >885 HU supports an enostosis in a purely sclerotic lesion but is not a universal rule. Enostoses can grow; expected growth is <25% over 6 months or <50% over 1 year.

zh: 病灶内脂肪或典型纤维异常增殖磨玻璃→1。
en: Internal fat or classic ground-glass fibrous dysplasia → 1.

zh: 内膜扇贝样侵蚀超过皮质厚度或病灶长轴的2/3、膨胀重塑、突破皮质、骨膜反应、软组织肿块、轴骨／骨骺位置等危险征象→4；无征象可按内生软骨瘤处理。
en: Scalloping >2/3 of cortical thickness or lesion length, expansion, cortical breach, periosteal reaction, soft-tissue mass or axial/epiphyseal location is concerning → 4; absent concerns, consider enchondroma.

zh: 高T1且所有序列随皮下脂肪
良性脂肪性病变→1；T1参照骨骼肌／椎间盘，而不是周围高脂骨髓。
en: High T1 matching subcutaneous fat on all sequences
Fat-containing benign lesion → 1; assess T1 relative to muscle/disc, not merely surrounding fatty marrow.

zh: 无或薄周边强化可为囊肿／骨内腱鞘囊肿→1；中心／实性肿块样强化→4；缺乏增强则2补增强或化学位移。
en: High T1 not matching fat: enhancement
No/thin peripheral enhancement supports cyst/ganglion → 1; central/solid mass-like enhancement → 4; without contrast use 2 for contrast or chemical-shift characterization.

zh: 化学位移信号降低>20%支持良性；≤20%不能区分良恶性，继续低T1路径；未做化学位移为2补检查。
en: Chemical-shift drop >20% supports benignity; ≤20% is indeterminate and proceeds through low-T1 assessment; absent chemical shift gives 2 for further imaging.

zh: 出血可掩盖病变，按低T1／高T2路径判断。
en: Hemorrhage can obscure an underlying lesion; use the low-T1/high-T2 pathway.

zh: 易骨转移癌史、病灶疼痛、皮质受累、软组织扩展、骨折、周围骨髓水肿、实性肿块样强化、乳腺癌患者胸骨灶或PSA升高任一→4。
en: Relevant cancer history, attributable pain, cortical involvement, soft-tissue extension, fracture, marrow edema, solid enhancement, a sternal lesion with breast cancer or elevated PSA → 4.

zh: 符合典型良性病变→1；否则CT检查基质（2）或MRI随访（3）。
en: Classic benign appearance → 1; otherwise CT for matrix (2) or MRI follow-up (3).

zh: 高T2周边晕环、实性强化、乳腺癌胸骨灶或PSA升高→4；无这些但有相关癌史→2或3；均无则多为骨岛等→1。
en: High-T2 halo, solid enhancement, sternal lesion with breast cancer or elevated PSA → 4; no concerns but relevant cancer history → 2/3; neither → usually benign enostosis or similar → 1.

steps.zh: 先确认成人、偶发、孤立病灶；CT按透亮或硬化／混合进入流程，MRI按T1高／低及T2进入流程。
steps.en: Confirm adult, incidental and solitary scope; choose the lucent or sclerotic/mixed CT pathway, or T1/T2 MRI pathway.

steps.zh: 危险征象优先，随后考虑相关癌史与明确良性特征；不要用脂肪或HU阈值掩盖明显危险征象。
steps.en: Prioritize concerning features, then relevant cancer history and unequivocal benign patterns; fat or HU thresholds must not conceal clear concerns.

steps.zh: 输出1–4处理类别及证据，而不是按各征象累积分数；同为MRI不同信号分支对癌史的处理并不完全相同。
steps.en: Report the 1–4 management category and rationale rather than a summed feature score; cancer-history handling differs between MRI signal branches.

management.zh: 1无需进一步处理；2补充不同影像或必要序列；3按6、6、12个月间隔随访；4活检和／或骨肿瘤专科评价，包含需要治疗的良性病灶。
management.en: Leave category 1 alone; characterize 2 with other imaging/sequences; follow 3 at 6,6,12-month intervals; biopsy and/or refer 4, including benign lesions requiring treatment.

cautions.zh: 原文图1B对无侵袭征象软骨病灶设>5 cm为3、<5 cm为1，而正文第10页强调大小不能单独鉴别侵袭性并认为无症状长骨软骨灶无需常规随访；应保留此图文差异，5 cm边界也未明确。
cautions.en: Figure 1B assigns nonaggressive cartilage lesions >5 cm to 3 and <5 cm to 1, while page 10 states size alone cannot distinguish aggressiveness and asymptomatic long-bone lesions need no routine follow-up; retain this conflict and the unspecified exact 5 cm boundary.

cautions.zh: 图1脂肪用−120至−30 HU，正文局部分支用平均<−10 HU；885／1060 HU只为骨岛与未治疗成骨转移鉴别，不应泛化。
cautions.en: Figure 1 uses −120 to −30 HU for fat whereas some text uses mean <−10 HU; 885/1060 HU distinguishes enostosis from untreated osteoblastic metastasis and is not universal.

cautions.zh: 类别4不等于确诊恶性，算法不覆盖手术、放疗、化疗等完整治疗选择，也不取代临床判断。
cautions.en: Category 4 does not prove malignancy; algorithms do not prescribe definitive surgery, RT or systemic treatment and do not replace clinical judgment.
